metadata.description: Lists the destinations of Japanese raw silk exports for 1915 to 1917, giving quantity in 1000 kin and value in 1000 yen for each country.

metadata.title: Area of Tea Plantations and Number of Tea Manufacturers
metadata.description: Shows tea plantation area and the number of tea manufacturers for 1913-1916, illustrating the stagnation of the tea industry described in the text.

metadata.title: Output of Various Kinds of Teas
metadata.caption: (Kwan)
metadata.description: Gives the annual output in kwan of green, black and oolong teas from 1913 to 1916, supporting the text's point that tea output has remained stationary.

metadata.title: Leading Districts of Tea Production (1916)
metadata.description: Shows the leading tea-producing prefectures and their output and value in 1916, listed in two side-by-side groups.

metadata.title: Export of Tea
metadata.caption: (in unit of 1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the quantities in kin and values in yen of tea exports by kind for 1914 to 1916, the bulk going to North America.

metadata.title: Number of Horses in Japan
metadata.description: The table gives the number of horses in Japan by type (native, cross and foreign breeds) for 1914 to 1916, following the discussion of breed improvement and castration.

metadata.title: Number of Cattle in Japan
metadata.description: Shows the number of native, cross and foreign cattle in Japan with totals, calving and deaths for 1914 to 1916, illustrating the decline of the native breed.

metadata.title: Number of Sheep, Goats and Swine
metadata.description: Gives the number of sheep, goats and swine in Japan for 1914 to 1916, shown as part of the agriculture statistics before the section on sheep.

metadata.title: Slaughtering Returns
metadata.description: Shows the number of animals slaughtered and slaughter-houses operating in Japan from 1914 to 1916, supporting the discussion of livestock rearing.

metadata.title: Families Keeping Poultry and Output
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the number of families keeping poultry and the resulting fowl stock and egg output from 1914 to 1917, illustrating the growth of poultry farming.

metadata.title: Leading Dairy Districts (1915)
metadata.description: Lists the number of dairy farms, milk cows and milk output for the leading dairy districts in 1915, with national totals for 1912 to 1915.

metadata.title: [Outbreaks of Contagious Animal Diseases and Hydrophobia, 1913–1916]
metadata.description: Records of livestock diseases such as glanders, farcy, anthrax and hydrophobia, with cattle and horses affected, died or destroyed, shown to illustrate the losses from disease.

metadata.title: Output of Fruits
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 kan)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly output of major fruits such as plums, peaches, pears, persimmons, apples, grapes and oranges, illustrating the growth of fruit culture discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Distribution of Strata
metadata.description: The table gives the relative percentage of sedimentary and igneous rock formations existing in Japan, classified by geological period, introducing the section on metal veins and strata.

metadata.title: [Mineral Production, 1913–1916]
metadata.description: The table gives Japan's annual output and value of gold, silver, copper, lead, iron, sulphur, coal and other minerals from 1913 to 1916, as background to the section on gold.

metadata.title: Demand of Pig Iron and Steel
metadata.description: Shows past average and estimated future consumption of pig-iron and steel in Japan, from the Economic Investigation Commission's study of iron demand and supply.

metadata.title: Production at Present and Prospective of Pig-iron and Steel Materials in Japan and China
metadata.description: Compares present and projected annual pig-iron and steel material output in Japan Proper, Korea, Manchuria and China, with totals, to show the expected expansion of East Asian iron production.

metadata.title: Annual Output at Leading Foundries in Japan Proper
metadata.description: The table gives present and future annual output of pig-iron and steel materials at the leading foundries in Japan proper, supporting the preceding remarks on the iron industry.

metadata.title: Principal Metal Mines
metadata.caption: (figures in unit of 1,000)
metadata.description: The table gives 1915 output of the leading metal mines, each producing at least ¥500,000 a year, in gold, silver, copper and total value of all ores.

metadata.title: [Output of Kamaishi and Senninyama Iron Mines, 1915]
metadata.description: Gives the 1915 output of pig iron, steel and iron ore from the two principal iron mines, Kamaishi and Senninyama in Iwate-ken, with a note on Kamioka's lead and zinc output.

metadata.title: [Estimated Available Coal Resources by Region]
metadata.description: The printed text distributes the estimated available coal resources of Japan among the main coal regions, Kyushu, Hokkaido and Iwaki, Ibaraki and Nagato.

metadata.title: Output of the Chief Coal-Fields in Japan Proper
metadata.description: The table lists the output in million tons of the chief coal-fields of Japan Proper for 1916 and 1915, with the operating company of each field.

metadata.title: Analysis of Coals from the Principal Coal-Fields
metadata.description: The page gives an analysis of coals from the principal coal-fields, showing moisture, volatile matter, coke, ash, sulphur, caking quality, specific gravity and calorific power, as a background to the mining industry.

metadata.title: [Output of Crude Oil in Echigo and Akita, 1914 and 1915]
metadata.description: The output of oil in Echigo and Akita over the last two years is set out by oil-field, with the lessee company for each field, according to the Mining Bureau's reports.

metadata.title: [Petroleum Production by Classes]
metadata.description: Shows the annual output of petroleum by product class (volatile, lamp, solar, heavy and machine oil) for 1912 to 1914, illustrating the oil production described above.

metadata.title: Investment in Mining Business
metadata.caption: (Capital paid up in ¥1000)
metadata.description: Gives the number of mining companies and their paid-up capital by group (metal, coal, both, petroleum, others) for 1912 to 1915, showing the growth of mining investment.

metadata.title: Leading Concessionaires of Mines
metadata.caption: (Production in 1914 exceeding ¥1,000,000 in value)
metadata.description: Lists the mining concessionaires whose 1914 production exceeded about ¥1,000,000 in value, with their figures in thousands of yen.

metadata.title: [Output of Leading Mining Companies (Continued)]
metadata.description: A continuation list of leading mining companies ranked by their output value in thousands of yen, showing the principal producers of the period.

metadata.title: Condition of Mine-Workers
metadata.caption: Mine-workers as classified by the mines they are working at and by their age and sex, at the end of June, 1915
metadata.description: A breakdown of mine-workers at the end of June 1915 by type of mine, age group and sex, split between underground and above-ground work.

metadata.title: Accidents at the Mines
metadata.description: Gives yearly counts of mine accidents and the resulting casualties, classed as deaths, severe and slight injuries, from 1912 to 1916.

metadata.title: Import and Export of Mineral Production
metadata.description: Lists the quantities and values of copper, coal, sulphur, iron and steel, and petroleum exported or imported, 1912 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Applications for Mining Rights]
metadata.description: Compares applications for mining rights in 1915 and 1916 by type, with the percentage increase, amid the wartime boom in mining.

metadata.title: Fishing Boats (1916)
metadata.description: Summarises the number of fishing boats in 1916, split between motorless and motor-driven boats, as the opening figures of the fishing-boat section.

metadata.title: Fishing Population (1916)
metadata.description: Gives the 1916 fishing population by sex, with a total, following the fishing-boat figures.

metadata.title: Accidents to Fishing Boats and Casualties of Fishermen (1916)
metadata.description: Shows the number of fishing boats wrecked or otherwise lost and the resulting crew killed, wounded, missing and total casualties, for 1916 with comparison years 1913 to 1915.

metadata.title: Catches and Marine Production
metadata.description: Summarises the value of fish and other marine catches and of marine products in Japan for 1913 to 1916, giving the totals for each group.

metadata.title: Principal Catches
metadata.description: Lists the principal fish caught in Japan in 1915 and 1916, with quantities in thousand kwan and values in thousand yen.

metadata.title: Principal Marine Products
metadata.description: Gives quantities and values of principal processed marine products such as dried squid, salted fish and fish manure for 1915 and 1916.

metadata.title: [Marine Products, 1914-1916]
metadata.description: Shows the value of marine products, canned goods and fish and whale oil for 1914 to 1916, illustrating the scale of Japan's fishery output.

metadata.title: Aquiculture
metadata.description: Gives the yearly value of aquaculture products such as snapping-turtle, oyster, carp, eel and porphyra, with totals, for the period before 1916.

metadata.title: [Deep Sea Catches in 1916]
metadata.description: Deep-sea fishing catches in Japan for 1916, broken down by fishing method, showing boats, crews and yen value of catches.

metadata.title: Coral Fishery, 1913
metadata.caption: (in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: The page gives the 1913 coral collection from waters around Kyushu, by prefecture and by colour, with a total of 890 thousand yen.

metadata.title: [Area of Forests by Ownership, End of March 1912–1915 and December 1915]
metadata.description: Shows the forest area of Japan Proper by ownership category (Crown, State, Communal, Temple, Private) at successive year-ends, with totals and a further column, to illustrate how the forest estate was held.

metadata.title: [Prefectures Containing Not Less Than 500,000 Cho of Forest, End of December 1915]
metadata.description: Lists the prefectures of Japan Proper that held not less than 500,000 cho of forest at the end of December 1915, showing the area of each.

metadata.title: Forest Yield of Principal Timbers, Japan Proper (1915)
metadata.description: Shows the 1915 forest yield of the principal timber trees in Japan Proper by quantity and value, illustrating that forestry revenue had not yet grown markedly.

metadata.title: Financial Yield of Forests (Dec. 1915)
metadata.description: Gives the December 1915 financial yield of forests, split into timber and fagots by State, Crown, and public and private ownership, showing the revenue base of forestry.

metadata.title: [State Forest Receipts, Expenses and Balance, 1912-13 to 1915-16]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000), excluding Hokkaido and the Bonin
metadata.description: Presents recent years' receipts, expenses and balance for State forests, showing that the rate of profit is comparatively small.

metadata.title: [Timber Trade Progress, 1913–1916]
metadata.description: The page shows how exports of timber and related forest products changed over the four years 1913 to 1916, by category.

metadata.title: [Imports of Teak and Other Timber, 1913–1916]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1000)
metadata.description: The page notes that teak imports were gradually replaced by pine, fir and cedar, and this table gives the yearly teak and other timber import values.

metadata.title: [Classification of State Forests by Management System]
metadata.description: Based on data ascertained so far, this gives the share of State forest area under each management system and the barren area, as of March 1912.

metadata.title: [Rotation Periods of Principal Tree Species]
metadata.description: Lists the approximate rotation periods in years for the principal forest tree species, given before the discussion of planting in civic communities.

metadata.title: [Afforestation Effected in State, Crown and Other Forests]
metadata.description: Shows the approximate area and number of trees planted in state, crown and other forests for each year ended March, as evidence of the government's encouragement of planting since 1907.

metadata.title: Total Volume of Felling (in 1,000)
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the total volume of timber and fagots felled for each year from 1912 to 1915, showing the scale of forestry output discussed in the wood industry section.

metadata.title: Principal By-Products (1915 in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: This list gives the value of the principal forestry by-products in Japan in 1915, supporting the text's point that subsidiary products formed a large share of forestry output.

metadata.title: Output of Refined Camphor (Japan Proper)
metadata.description: Gives the recent annual output of refined camphor in Japan Proper, in quantity and value, to illustrate the growth of the refining business described in the preceding text.

metadata.title: Number of Licenses Granted
metadata.description: The table shows how many shooting licences of each class (A for firearms, B for other methods) and grade were granted in 1914-15 and 1915-16, illustrating the scale of game-hunting permits.

metadata.title: [Data on Manufacturing Companies, 1912-1916]
metadata.description: Introduces the figures on manufacturing companies for 1912 to 1916, given before the breakdown of paid-up capital by kind of industry at the end of December 1916.

metadata.title: [Industrial Companies by Kind, with Number, Paid-up Capital and Reserves]
metadata.description: The table lists the number of companies, paid-up capital and reserves for each kind of industrial activity in Japan, showing the scale of each industry.

metadata.title: [Number of Companies and Capital by District]
metadata.caption: Capital p.u. in ¥ 1,000
metadata.description: Lists the number of companies and paid-up capital in each prefecture, showing where industrial enterprises were concentrated.

metadata.title: Factories and Employees
metadata.description: Gives yearly counts of factories by power type and the number of male and female operatives from 1912 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Motive Powers Used in Factories, 1916]
metadata.description: Shows the number of engines and horse power for each kind of motive power used in factories in 1916, including water wheels.

metadata.title: Principal Factories (at the End of 1916)
metadata.description: Lists the principal factories by industry at the end of 1916, with power sources, horse power and employee numbers.

metadata.title: [Factories Classified by Kind of Enterprise]
metadata.description: The table gives the number of factories and workshops by kind of enterprise, showing power sources, horsepower and employee numbers, as a statistical survey of Japanese industry.

metadata.title: [Progress of the Cotton Spinning Industry, 1910–1917]
metadata.description: Figures from the Spinner's Association of Japan showing the marked growth of the cotton spinning industry in companies, mills, capital, spindles and looms from 1910 to 1917.

metadata.title: [Output of Yarns, Export and Home Consumption, 1913–1917]
metadata.description: Shows the yarn output, export abroad, home consumption and conversion into textile, with textile output in yards, for 1913 to 1917 in the cotton industry.

metadata.title: [Leading Cotton Spinning Companies at the End of 1917]
metadata.description: Lists the five leading cotton spinning companies with their mills, capital, reserves, and spindles and looms at the end of 1917.

metadata.title: [Hempen Spinning Mills Statistics, 1912–1916]
metadata.description: Statistics for the hemp spinning industry over 1912–1916, showing mills, capital, spindles, raw material consumed and output, presented after the account of the hempen spinning factories.

metadata.title: Statistics of Textile Industry
metadata.description: Summarises the number of factories or families, looms, operatives and total output of the textile industry for 1913 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Output of Fabrics by Kind]
metadata.description: Shows the annual output of textile fabrics by kind, from silk and cotton goods to woollens and miscellaneous fabrics, with a grand total for 1913 to 1916.

metadata.title: Returns of Exported Fabrics
metadata.description: Gives the value of exported silk, cotton and woollen fabrics, with totals, for 1913 to 1916, as a companion to the domestic output figures.

metadata.title: Factories & Operatives
metadata.description: The table gives the number of chemical-industry factories and operatives by branch, from the Agriculture and Commerce Department report, summarising the industry's size.

metadata.title: Production (in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.caption: (in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows annual production values of pottery, shippo enamel ware, fire-proof and ordinary bricks, and tiles, illustrating the trade trends discussed in the text on these industries.

metadata.title: Exports (in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.caption: (in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: Gives export values of potteries and shippo for 1914 to 1917, showing the effect of the war on the enamel ware trade.

metadata.title: [Portland Cement Production and Exports]
metadata.description: Presents yearly output and export figures for Portland cement, showing the industry's recovery during the European war period.

metadata.title: [Production of Lacquer-Juice and Lacquered Wares]
metadata.description: Gives the yearly output of lacquer-juice and lacquered wares from 1914 to 1916, presented to show production trends in the lacquer industry.

metadata.title: [Production of Sake, Beer and Soy]
metadata.description: The table gives annual output of sake, beer and soy in thousand koku for fiscal years 1913 to 1916, following the text on the brewing industries.

metadata.title: [Export of Sake, Beer and Soy]
metadata.description: Shows the export of Japanese sake, beer and soy in 1915–1917, indicating the overseas trade in these products and their destinations.

metadata.title: [Leading Breweries — Paid-up Capital, Receipts, Expenditure and Dividend]
metadata.caption: Latest condition of the above mentioned companies are as follows:—
metadata.description: Gives the latest paid-up capital, receipts, expenditure and dividend rate of the four leading Japanese beer-brewing companies.

metadata.title: [Japanese Match Production, Value, Exports and Export Value, 1913–1916]
metadata.description: Shows Japanese match production and exports with their values for 1913–1916, illustrating the marked rise in value in 1915 owing to higher prices.

metadata.title: [Match Exports by Destination, 1917]
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 gross)
metadata.description: Distributes the 44,160,011 gross of matches exported in 1917 among the principal destination countries and regions.

metadata.title: Amount and Value of Papers Produced in 1916
metadata.caption: (in unit of 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the quantity and value of paper produced, exported and imported in 1916, by paper type, with pulp imports, as background to the paper industry discussion.

metadata.title: [Output and Foreign Trade of Soaps]
metadata.caption: (in ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japanese soap output for home use (toilet and other soaps) and foreign trade in soaps for 1914–1917, illustrating the soap industry discussed in the text.

metadata.title: [Artificial Fertilizer Production, 1914–1916]
metadata.description: Official statistics showing how the value of Japan's artificial fertilizer production grew from 1914 to 1916, broken down by origin of the fertilizer.

metadata.title: [Fish-Oil and Whale-Oil Output, 1914–1916]
metadata.description: Output of sardine, herring and whale oil in quantity and value for 1914–1916, presented to show the fish-oil industry's production.

metadata.title: [Representative Machine Construction Companies, Second Half of 1917]
metadata.description: The text describes representative machine construction firms, and this table gives each company's paid-up capital, receipts, expenditure and dividend for the second half of 1917.

metadata.title: [Gas Industry: Lamps, Heating and Motor Installations, and Gas Production]
metadata.description: Shows the growth of gas lamps, heating and motor installations and gas volume produced, illustrating how gas holds its place against electricity for different purposes.

metadata.title: [Gas Industry: Number of Works, Paid-up Capital and Extension of Pipes]
metadata.description: Gives the number of gas works, paid-up capital and length of pipes, showing the situation of the gas industry over four years.

metadata.title: [Gas Companies: Capital, Receipts, Expenditure and Dividend]
metadata.description: Shows capital, receipts, expenditure and latest dividend of several gas companies in Japan, given as a comparison of the gas industry alongside the electric industry section.

metadata.title: [Electric Power Installations in Operation, by Year (Kilowatts)]
metadata.description: Gives the yearly growth of electric installations in Japan from 1912 to 1916, by type of enterprise, to illustrate the rapid expansion of electric power.

metadata.title: [Electric Plants Under Construction, 1916]
metadata.description: Lists the electric power plants under construction at the end of 1916, by category, following the operating-plant figures.

metadata.title: [Kilowatt Capacity Classified by Enterprise and Generation, End of 1916]
metadata.description: Classifies Japan's hydro-electric kilowatt capacity by type of enterprise and generation, in operation and in preparation, as at the end of 1916.

metadata.title: Electric Power Undertakings (Continued)
metadata.description: The table gives the continued breakdown of electric power undertakings in Japan by type of plant (steam, gas, total, other) and by operating status, showing supply capacity.

metadata.title: Latest Situation of the Leading Electric Companies
metadata.caption: (second half, 1917)
metadata.description: The table lists leading Japanese electric companies with paid-up capital, receipts, expenditure and latest dividend for the second half of 1917.

metadata.title: [Sugar Production and Consumption in Japan Proper]
metadata.caption: (unit in 1,000 kin)
metadata.description: Sugar refining's production and consumption estimates for Japan Proper, shown to illustrate the growing role of imports from abroad and Formosa during 1912–1916.

metadata.title: [Native and Imported Wheat and Flour Production]
metadata.description: Shows annual output and value of native and imported wheat used as stuff, and the resulting flour production, in the years 1912 to 1916.

metadata.title: Peppermint
metadata.caption: (in value ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of peppermint produced (crude, menthol, crystal oil) and exported in Japan from 1912 to 1916, illustrating the growth of the industry in Hokkaido.

metadata.title: [Crude and Refined Production and Exports]
metadata.description: The text describes a declining and then reviving industry, and this table gives its crude and refined production and exports for 1914 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Vegetable Oil Outputs, 1914–1916]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: This table gives the annual outputs of vegetable oils from rape seed, sesame, yemola, cotton seed and other plant seeds for 1914 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Dye-stuff Import Returns]
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 kin)
metadata.description: The text notes that imports of dye-stuffs have fallen since domestic production began, and this table shows the import returns by dye type from the five-year average to 1917.

metadata.title: [Productions of Straw, Chip and Hemp Braid]
metadata.description: Shows the yearly production value of straw, chip, mixed and hemp braid, illustrating the rapid growth of the braid industry from 1913 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Exports of Straw, Chip and Hemp Braid]
metadata.description: Gives the export values of straw, chip, mixed and hemp braid for 1914 to 1917, showing the marked growth of overseas sales.

metadata.title: [Fancy Matting Production and Exports]
metadata.description: Describes the fancy matting industry and gives annual production and export values of fancy mattings and floor mats from 1913 to 1917.

metadata.title: [Leather Output]
metadata.description: Shows the annual output of leather from cows and calves, horses and other sources, with totals, from 1912 to 1916, illustrating the growth of the leather industry.

metadata.title: [Hosiery Production]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japanese hosiery output from 1912 to 1916 by product type, illustrating the rapid growth of the Osaka-centred industry during the war years.

metadata.title: Production
metadata.description: Gives the value of Japan's canned production from 1913 to 1916, broken down into beef, fish and shellfish, and fruit, to show the growth of the canning industry.

metadata.title: [Production of Isinglass]
metadata.description: Lists the quantity and value of Japanese isinglass (kanten) produced for the years ended March 1914 to 1917, the export article used mainly for jam-making in Europe and America.

metadata.title: Budget for the Year 1918-19
metadata.caption: (Figures being in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The 1918-19 budget, passed with a retrenchment of ¥2,360,000, is compared with the 1917-18 budget figures for revenue and expenditure, showing the increases in each.

metadata.title: [Revenue Estimate, Actual Yield and Increase, 1917-18]
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1000)
metadata.description: Gives the estimated and actual yields for the three main revenue divisions in 1917-18, showing the record increase over the budget estimate.

metadata.title: [Taxes, Excises and Other Revenue Items, 1917-18]
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1000)
metadata.description: Breaks down the 1917-18 revenue estimates and actual yields by individual tax and excise items, showing which items rose or fell against the estimate.

metadata.title: The 1918-19 Budget Revenues
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The page shows the detailed breakdown of Japan's 1918-19 budget revenues, ordinary and extraordinary, supporting the preceding discussion of rising taxation and stamp and sake receipts.

metadata.title: Revenue (Continued)
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The top rows are the closing items of the revenue account, showing extraordinary revenue items and the grand total of revenue for the year.

metadata.title: Expenditures
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The page lists the ordinary and extraordinary state expenditures by department for 1918–19, with the grand total of national expenditure.

metadata.title: Growth of National Expenses
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Quinquennial returns show how main divisions of state expenditure (general account) grew from 1898 to 1917, to introduce the discussion of continuing expenditures.

metadata.title: [Ordinary and Special Account Totals, Disbursements and Remaining Balances]
metadata.description: Summarises total amounts, disbursements, allotments and remaining balances of the Ordinary and Special Accounts, as the opening of the Finance section.

metadata.title: [Principal Items of Disbursements in Ordinary and Special Accounts]
metadata.description: Lists the largest disbursement items under the Ordinary and Special Accounts, showing where the public money was spent.

metadata.title: [Special Account Items in the Budget for 1918–19]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows revenue and expenditure of the principal Special Account items in the 1918–19 Budget, which nominally inflate the national totals.

metadata.title: [Revenue Surplus, 1912–13 to 1918–19]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the revenue surplus for each fiscal year from 1912–13 onward, noting the single year in which expenditure exceeded revenue.

metadata.title: [Deposit Department of the Treasury, 1916–17]
metadata.caption: (in unit of ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the amounts held by the Deposit Department of the Treasury in 1916–17, with brought-over sums, receipts, payments and balances.

metadata.title: Tobacco Leaf
metadata.description: Shows the yearly area of tobacco plantation and the quantity and value of new, old and total leaf tobacco produced in Japan proper, illustrating the tobacco monopoly's output.

metadata.title: Salt
metadata.description: Gives the area of salt fields and the production and value of salt under the salt monopoly for four fiscal years.

metadata.title: Camphor
metadata.description: Shows the quantity and value of crude camphor, camphor oil and refined camphor handled under the camphor monopoly over four years.

metadata.title: Profit and Loss Account (Yen)
metadata.description: Summarises the revenue, expense and profit of the state monopolies (tobacco, salt, camphor) for four fiscal years.

metadata.title: Collection Expenses
metadata.description: Shows the national tax revenue, collection expense and expense percentage for the last four fiscal years, since collection costs must be considered when determining net revenue.

metadata.title: Land Tax
metadata.description: The page sets out the national land tax rates, per 100 of registered value, for ordinary land and for Hokkaido, as part of the discussion of Japan's tax system.

metadata.title: Income Tax (as Revised in 1918), 1st Kind (Income of Juridical Persons)
metadata.description: The page gives the revised 1918 income tax rates per 1000 of income for juridical persons, classed by type of company, illustrating the tax burden on business organisations.

metadata.title: Income Tax Rates
metadata.description: Lists the income tax rates for the second and third kinds of income, with the rate changes introduced for the 1916-17 year.

metadata.title: Income Tax Payers, Income and Tax, 1915-16 and 1916-17
metadata.description: Shows the number of taxpayers, their income and tax under the first, second and third kinds of income tax for 1916-17, with 1915-16 totals for comparison.

metadata.title: Business Tax Assessment Rates
metadata.description: Explains the business tax assessment method for sale of goods, giving the rate of assessment for each basis, as amended in 1914.

metadata.title: [Business Tax Rates]
metadata.description: Shows the rates of the business tax by category of business, with capital, rent and number of persons as the bases of assessment.

metadata.title: [Registration Fee Rates]
metadata.description: Gives example rates of the registration fees, which are based on value, for several categories of registrable objects.

metadata.title: [Sake and Shochu Tax Rates]
metadata.caption: (Tax assessed by koku, approx. 40 imp. gal.)
metadata.description: Lists the graded tax on sake and shochu by alcohol strength, assessed per koku.

metadata.title: [Medicine Tax Rates]
metadata.description: Shows the license fee and stamp duty rates applied to medicine, with the graded compounding tax explained below.

metadata.title: Sugar Excise
metadata.description: Lists the excise rates on sugar by refining class and on molasses and syrup, expressed per picul, as part of the review of national taxes.

metadata.title: Excise on Woolen and Silk Textiles or Mixtures
metadata.description: Gives the excise rate charged on woolen and silk textiles and their mixtures, a single rate bracketed across both articles.

metadata.title: Travelling Tax
metadata.description: Shows the travelling tax charged by journey distance and passenger class, with the rate in sen for each band.

metadata.title: Arrears in National and Local Taxes
metadata.description: Reports the number of defaulters, unpaid amounts and losses to the Treasury for national and local taxes in arrears for the years ended March 1914 to 1916.

metadata.title: [Second Adjustment: Tax Reduction and Administrative Savings]
metadata.description: Lists the measures of tax reduction and administrative economy adopted in the 30th session, with the amount of each, under the Second Adjustment.

metadata.title: [Third Adjustment: Disencumbering Program of 1915-16]
metadata.description: Lists the disencumbering program adopted in the 31st session (1913-14), with the amount and percentage reduction of each tax, to take effect from 1915-16.

metadata.title: Average Amount of Taxes per Capita
metadata.description: Shows the average per-capita amounts of national, prefectural and communal taxes with totals and ratios for the years 1913 to 1915, illustrating the tax burden under discussion.

metadata.title: National Debts, Raised, Redeemed, Outstanding and Interest thereof; Ratio per Capita
metadata.description: Shows how national debt was raised, redeemed and outstanding each year to March 1917, with interest and per-capita burden, illustrating the growth of state debts.

metadata.title: National Loans Outstanding (Dec. 31, 1917)
metadata.description: Lists the national loans outstanding at 31 December 1917, split into domestic and foreign loans, with totals, as background to the conditions of loans raised abroad.

metadata.title: [Japanese Government Loans: Interest, Issue Price, Commission and Net Proceeds]
