metadata.description: Shows the number of patent applications filed and patents registered in each fiscal year over the past six years, as reported by the Patent Office.

metadata.title: Registration of Designs
metadata.chapter: Patents, Designs, Trade-marks and Utility Models
metadata.description: Shows the number of design applications filed and designs registered in each fiscal year over the past six years, as reported by the Patent Office.

metadata.title: Registration of Trade-Marks
metadata.chapter: Patents, Designs, Trade-marks and Utility Models
metadata.description: Shows the number of trade-mark applications filed and trade-marks registered in each fiscal year over the past six years, as reported by the Patent Office.

metadata.title: Registration of Utility-Models
metadata.chapter: Patents, Designs, Trade-marks and Utility Models
metadata.description: Shows the number of utility-model applications filed and utility models registered in each fiscal year over the past six years, as reported by the Patent Office.

metadata.title: [Statistics of Insurance Companies by Class of Business]
metadata.description: The table gives, for each class of insurance business by year ended March, the number of companies, capital, reserves, premiums, claims and policies in force, showing the growing combination of fire and marine business.

metadata.title: [Minor Insurance Businesses: Engine & Boiler, Automobile and Burglary Insurance, Continued]
metadata.description: Shows the yearly business of minor insurance kinds (engine and boiler, automobile, burglary) by capital, reserves, premiums, claims and policies in force, 1920–1922.

metadata.title: Life Insurance Companies (Year Ended March 31st 1922)
metadata.description: Lists the leading life insurance companies with their nominal capital, policies in force, premiums received and claims paid for the year ended March 1922.

metadata.title: Property Insurance Companies (Year Ended March 31st 1922)
metadata.description: The table lists Japanese property insurance companies with their capital, policies in force, premiums and claims for the year ended March 31, 1922.

metadata.title: Deaths, Claims Paid and Policies in Force for the Last Three Years
metadata.description: Shows the yearly deaths, claims paid, and policies in force of the Post Office insurance business over the three years ended March 1921.

metadata.title: [Mortality Rate of Assured in Japan and England per 100,000]
metadata.description: Compares the number of cases and deaths per 100,000 assured by age in England and Japan, showing Japanese mortality differs from the English 17 Cos' table.

metadata.title: Rates in Tokyo, %
metadata.description: The table gives the minimum fire insurance premium rates in Tokyo, by district class, for wooden and fire-proof buildings under the new tariff agreement.

metadata.title: [Foreign Insurance Business Statistics]
metadata.description: The table gives statistics of foreign insurance companies operating in Japan for 1918 to 1920, covering life, fire and marine business as reported to the Japanese authorities.

metadata.title: Amount of Issue of the Three Banks
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the note issue, specie reserve, government bonds and excess issue of the Bank of Japan, Bank of Taiwan and Bank of Chosen at successive years ending September, illustrating the special banks' circulation.

metadata.title: [Exchange Firms and Brokerage in Tokyo, Yokohama, Osaka and Kobe]
metadata.description: Shows the number of Japanese and foreign firms in four port cities and the brokerage rates charged, as a preface to the banks' transaction volumes.

metadata.title: [Volume of Transactions by Japanese Banks, 1919–1921]
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥ million)
metadata.description: Gives the sold and bought volumes of the Specie Bank, Taiwan Bank and other banks for 1919 to 1921, in yen million.

metadata.title: [Banks in Japan: Number, Capital, Reserves, Deposits and Debentures, 1919–1921]
metadata.caption: (Amount of money in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the number of banks, branches, capital, reserves, deposits and debentures of each bank class in Japan for 1919–1921, as gathered by the Bankers' Association of Tokyo.

metadata.title: [Loans, Deposits, Bonds and Cash of Banks, 1919–1921]
metadata.description: Continuation of the table of bank balance items by bank class for 1919 to 1921, showing loans, deposits, securities and cash held by each group of banks.

metadata.title: [Ordinary Loans and Loans on Immovables]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Inquiries by the Tokyo Clearing House show the growth of ordinary loans and loans on immovables by banks throughout Japan from 1918 to 1921.

metadata.title: Loans on Immovables Classified
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000,000)
metadata.description: Breakdown of loans on immovables by type of bank from the end of 1917 to 1921, showing how the security-covered lending grew.

metadata.title: Liabilities of Banks
metadata.caption: (Dec. 31st 1921; in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Balance sheet liabilities items (capital, reserves, notes and debentures) for the main banks at the end of December 1921.

metadata.title: [Liabilities of Banks, 1921]
metadata.description: Shows the liabilities side of each bank group's balance sheet, with deposits, debts, reserves and totals, as a continuation of the bank statistics.

metadata.title: Assets of Banks
metadata.caption: (Dec. 31st 1921; in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the specie, bullion and loan assets held by each bank group at the end of 1921, following the liabilities figures.

metadata.title: [Balance Sheet Items of Banks, Continued]
metadata.description: The table continues the balance sheet items of the Japanese banks, showing each bank's assets and liabilities across the banking institutions, with totals for the year and the previous year.

metadata.title: Leading Ordinary and Savings Banks
metadata.caption: (As existing at the end of Oct. 1922; in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the leading ordinary and savings banks in Tokyo and Osaka at the end of October 1922, giving paid-up capital, reserves, deposits and loans for each bank.

metadata.title: [Licensed Pawnbrokers in Japan Proper, 1916-1920]
metadata.description: According to Home Office inquiries, the number of licensed pawnbrokers in Japan proper for each year from 1916 to 1920 is given, illustrating the pawnbroking institutions serving poorer classes.

metadata.title: [Pawnbroking Business Statistics, 1917–1920]
metadata.description: Statistics of pawns accepted, advanced, redeemed, repaid and forfeited, shown to illustrate the general situation of the pawnbroking business from 1917 to 1920.

metadata.title: Rate of Interest — The Bank of Japan
metadata.description: Shows the Bank of Japan's interest rates on loans, discounts, bills, overdrafts and fixed deposits at each year-end from 1919 to 1922.

metadata.title: Associated Banks, Tokyo
metadata.description: Gives the high, low and average rates on loans, discounts and overdrafts charged by associated banks in Tokyo at year-end, 1919 to November 1922.

metadata.title: Associated Banks, Tokyo (Continued)
metadata.description: Continues the Tokyo associated banks table with interest paid on current accounts and fixed deposits for the same years.

metadata.title: Associated Banks, Osaka
metadata.description: Gives high, low and average rates on loans, discounts and overdrafts charged by associated banks in Osaka at year-end, 1919 to November 1922.

metadata.title: Associated Banks, Osaka (Continued)
metadata.description: Continues the Osaka associated banks table with interest paid on current accounts and fixed deposits for the same years.

metadata.title: Average Rate in Japan Proper
metadata.description: Shows the average interest rates on loans, discounts and overdrafts in Japan Proper at year-end from 1919 to February 1922.

metadata.title: Average Rate in Japan Proper
metadata.description: Continues the rate table, giving interest rates on current and fixed deposit accounts in Japan Proper for 1919 to February 1922.

metadata.title: [Average Rate on Real Estate, 1918–1921]
metadata.description: Gives the average interest rate on immovables in Japan for 1918 to 1921, with and without Okinawa and Hokkaido, from Hypothec Bank inquiries.

metadata.title: Amount Cleared By Clearing Houses In Principal Places
metadata.caption: Amount Cleared (¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the amounts cleared by clearing houses in the principal Japanese cities from 1919 to 1922, illustrating the scale of banking business in each place.

metadata.title: Regulation Fineness Of The Coins
metadata.description: Lists the regulation fineness, or metal composition, of each coin type under the currency system as amended in 1922.

metadata.title: Amount of Coins and Paper Currency in Circulation
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the year-end amounts of gold, silver, nickel and copper coins and of bank notes in circulation, giving the grand total of currency in Japan from 1918 to 1922.

metadata.title: Bank Notes in Circulation Classified
metadata.description: Breaks down the bank notes in circulation at the end of each year by denomination, from 1918 to 1921, with the total for each year.

metadata.title: Coin Turned Out by the Mint
metadata.description: Shows the number of gold, silver, nickel and copper coins struck by the Japanese Mint in 1919, 1920 and 1921, by denomination and in total.

metadata.title: Bulletins of the Bank of Japan
metadata.description: Gives the Bank of Japan's year-end note issue, specie reserve, government and other securities held, and excess note issue for 1917 to 1921.

metadata.title: [Foreign Banks in Japan by Nationality of Head Office]
metadata.description: Lists the foreign banks operating branches in Japan by nationality of their head offices, with the number of branches and their locations.

metadata.title: [Business Situation of Foreign Banks in Japan in Recent Years]
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the capital, deposits, loans and net profits of the foreign banks in Japan for 1918 to 1920, as the business situation in recent years.

metadata.title: [Revenue and Expenditure Before and After the War]
metadata.description: Compares Japan's national expenditure and revenue for fiscal years 1913 to 1922, showing how wartime spending expanded before and after the European War.

metadata.title: General Budget for 1922-23 as Passed by the 45th Session of the Diet
metadata.description: Sets out the revenue and expenditure of the general budget for 1922-23 as passed by the Diet, split into ordinary and extraordinary accounts.

metadata.title: No. 2 (for the Entertainment of the Prince of Wales, and Other Items)
metadata.description: Shows the revenue and expenditure of Supplementary Budget No. 2, approved by the Diet for the Prince of Wales entertainment and other items in 1922-23.

metadata.title: No. 4 (for South Sea Islands Administration Office)
metadata.description: Shows the balanced revenue and expenditure allotted to the South Sea Islands Administration Office in the 1922-23 Budget.

metadata.title: No. 5 (for Communications Department)
metadata.description: Shows the balanced revenue and expenditure allotted to the Communications Department in the 1922-23 Budget.

metadata.title: Budget Comparison for 1922-23 and 1921-22
metadata.description: Compares the revenue and expenditure estimates of the 1922-23 Budget with the preceding year's Budget, showing increases or decreases.

metadata.title: Revenue for 1922-23
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the ordinary revenue items of the 1922-23 Budget by source, in thousands of yen.

metadata.title: [Government Revenue for 1922-23, Continued]
metadata.description: The continued list of ordinary and extraordinary government revenue items for 1922-23, with subtotals and the grand total of receipts.

metadata.title: Expenditures for 1922-23 (In ¥1,000)
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Ordinary government expenditures for 1922-23 by department, shown in thousands of yen, following the revenue figures.

metadata.title: [Ordinary and Extraordinary Expenditure by Department]
metadata.description: Continues the page's listing of ordinary and extraordinary government expenditure by department, giving departmental amounts and the totals for each category and the grand total.

metadata.title: Revenue Surplus
metadata.caption: (Given in ¥ million)
metadata.description: Shows the revenue surplus for each fiscal year from 1917-18 to 1921-22, illustrating the recent decrease noted in the text.

metadata.title: Continuing Expenditures
metadata.description: Shows the continuing extraordinary expenditures under the General Account by department, with total amounts, amounts disbursed by 1920-21, and allotments for 1921-22 and 1922-23.

metadata.title: Special Account
metadata.description: Continuation of a table of Special Account receipts and expenditure by government department, with the column headings printed on the previous page.

metadata.title: [Principal Special Account Items in the Budget for 1922-23]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the principal Special Account items in the 1922-23 Budget, showing revenue and expenditure of each, to illustrate the scale of the special accounts.

metadata.title: [Postal, Ordinary and Custody Deposits, 1920-21]
metadata.caption: (in unit of ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the amounts in the possession of the Deposit Department of the Treasury in 1920-21, broken down into brought-over, received, paid and balance.

metadata.title: [National Wealth at End of 1913 and End of 1919]
metadata.description: Compares Japan's national wealth in lands and mines before the European war (end of 1913) with the end of 1919, split into government or public and private holdings.

metadata.title: Yield of Leaf
metadata.description: Shows the area of tobacco plantation and the yield of new and old leaf, with totals, for each year from 1916-17 to 1920-21 in Japan proper.

metadata.title: Manufacture
metadata.description: Gives the quantities manufactured and sold, and the sale value, of cigarettes, cigars and cut tobacco in 1919-20 and 1920-21.

metadata.title: Foreign Leaf Tobacco Bought
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Records the value in thousands of yen of foreign leaf tobacco bought by the monopoly, by origin, for the years 1918-19 to 1920-21.

metadata.title: Foreign Manufactured Tobacco Bought
metadata.description: Continuation of a table listing foreign manufactured tobacco bought by the Monopoly Bureau in recent fiscal years, by type.

metadata.title: Salt
metadata.description: Shows the salt monopoly's production area, output and value for five fiscal years, before the text on purchase price grading.

metadata.title: Classes of Purchased Salt by Sodium Chloride Content
metadata.description: Lists the five purchase grades of salt by percentage of sodium chloride, which determine the price paid to manufacturers.

metadata.title: Camphor
metadata.description: Gives the quantity and value of crude camphor and camphor oil produced for five fiscal years.

metadata.title: Acreage and Manufacture of Crude Camphor and Oil
metadata.description: Gives the camphor-tree acreage under state, communal and individual ownership, and refinery output, for the last few years available.

metadata.title: Land Tax
metadata.description: Lists the national land tax rates on dwelling land, cultivated land, and the separate Hokkaido rates for cultivated and other land, as a fraction of registered value.

metadata.title: Income Tax (As Revised in 1920 and Enforced from Aug. 1 of the Year), 1st Kind: Income of Juridical Persons
metadata.caption: (As revised in 1920 and enforced from Aug. 1 of the year)
metadata.description: Gives the income tax rates for juridical persons, grouped by excess income, reserve income, dividend income and liquidation income, as revised in 1920.

metadata.title: 3rd Kind (Incomes of Individuals Other Than 2nd Kind)
metadata.description: Gives the graduated income tax rates for individuals' incomes other than the second kind, showing the rate rising with each income bracket, as set by the revision.

metadata.title: [Number of Income Tax Payers, Income and Tax Collected, 1920-21]
metadata.description: Shows the number of juridical and individual income tax payers, their income and the tax collected in 1920-21, broken down by kind and class of income.

metadata.title: [Income Tax Payers, Income and Tax by Kind, 1919-20]
metadata.description: Continuing the income tax statistics, this table gives the number of payers, income and tax by kind of income, with grand totals and the 1919-20 breakdown.

metadata.title: [Taxation of Foreign Corporations on Excess Profit]
metadata.description: The text explains how foreign corporations are taxed on profit above 10 per cent of invested capital, and the rates are listed here.

metadata.title: [Business Tax Rates as Amended in 1914]
metadata.description: This table sets out the business tax assessment bases and the rates applied to each occupation group as amended in 1914.

metadata.title: [Registration Fee Rates]
metadata.description: The registration fee rates, which depend on value, are given for a few examples of registrable objects of general interest.

metadata.title: [Fees for Company Registration Matters]
metadata.description: This short list of fees charged for company registration and office matters appears at the head of the page, under the Finance heading, before the liquor tax sections begin.

metadata.title: [Rates of Tax on Sake and Other Liquors]
metadata.caption: The tax on sake is assessed by koku (ab. 40 imp. gal.) as follows:
metadata.description: This list sets out the graduated sake and liquor tax rates per koku by alcohol strength and kind, with glossary notes on the terms used.

metadata.title: Sugar Excise
metadata.caption: Per picul (yen)
metadata.description: Lists the excise rates per picul on sugar, by class, plus molasses and syrup, as levied under the sugar excise.

metadata.title: Excise on Woolen and Silk Textiles or Mixtures
metadata.description: Shows the excise rate, a tenth of value, applied to woolen and silk textiles and their mixtures.

metadata.title: Travelling Tax
metadata.caption: Sen
metadata.description: Gives the travelling tax charged by distance travelled, for first to third class passengers.

metadata.title: [Succession Tax Rates by Value of Estate]
metadata.description: Shows the succession tax rates per 1000 applied to estates of increasing value, by the heir's grade of relationship to the deceased family head.

metadata.title: [Bequest Tax Rates by Value of Bequeathment]
metadata.description: Gives the bequest tax rates per 1000 for bequests of rising value, according to the beneficiary's relationship to the testator.

metadata.title: Collection Expenses
metadata.description: Lists national tax revenue, collection expenses and the resulting expense percentage for recent fiscal years, since collection costs must be deducted to find net proceeds.

metadata.title: Arrears in National and Local Taxes
metadata.description: Shows the number of tax defaulters, the amounts in arrears, and the losses to the Treasury for national and local taxes for 1918 to 1921.

metadata.title: Average Amount of Taxes per Capita
metadata.description: Gives the average per-capita amounts of national, prefectural, communal and total taxes, with the rate on national tax, for the years ended March 1917 to 1921.

metadata.title: National Debts, Raised, Redeemed, Outstanding and Interest Thereof; Ratio per Capita
metadata.description: Shows the yearly amounts of national debt redeemed, issued and outstanding, with debt and interest per head of population, for each year ended March 1916 to 1921.

metadata.title: National Loans Outstanding (March 31, 1921)
metadata.description: Lists the domestic national loans still outstanding on March 31, 1921, with years of issue and redemption and amounts issued and outstanding in yen.

metadata.title: Foreign Loans
metadata.description: Lists the foreign sterling loans outstanding, with years of issue, redemption dates and amounts issued and outstanding.

metadata.title: [Government and Other Loans Outstanding (Continued)]
metadata.description: This continued table lists Japan's government and other loans still in force abroad, with issue years, redemption dates, and amounts issued and outstanding, followed by totals.

metadata.title: Condition of Loans Raised Abroad
metadata.description: This table gives the terms of Government and other loans raised abroad recently: interest rate, issue price, commission and net proceeds per loan.

metadata.title: [Foreign Loans Contracted by Japan]
metadata.description: Lists Japan's foreign loans by country, with issue dates, descriptions, issue prices, interest rates, redemption dates and amounts, followed by subtotals and a grand total.

metadata.title: Loans to China
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows how Japan's loans to China are classified by advancement status and borrowing body, noting that Japan was among China's largest creditors.

metadata.title: [Outstanding Items of Public Undertakings, Telephone to Roadmaking]
metadata.description: The table lists yearly outlays on telephone, telegraph, education and roadmaking undertakings, with totals, under the temporary war account items carried forward.

metadata.title: [Outstanding Items of Public Undertakings, Korean to Grand Total]
metadata.description: The table gives the corresponding outstanding amounts for Korean, Formosan, Saghalien and railway undertakings, with grand totals, matching the year rows of the table above.

metadata.title: [Amount of Bonds Outstanding by Holder, 1916–1922]
metadata.description: Following the text on the balance of trade turning adverse, this table shows how the total amount held at half-year ends fell from its 1920 peak, split by treasury, Bank of Japan, and domestic and foreign holders.

metadata.title: Finance of Hokkaido, Prefectures & Civic Corporations
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: This table gives the revenue and expenditure of Hokkaido, the prefectures and civic corporations (cities, towns and villages) for the years 1918-19 to 1921-22.

metadata.title: Revenue Items
metadata.description: The table gives the national government's revenue items for fiscal years 1919–20 to 1921–22, showing how the national treasury's income was made up by tax and other sources.

metadata.title: Expenditure Items
metadata.description: The table shows national government expenditure by item for fiscal years 1919–20 to 1921–22, as a companion to the revenue figures printed just above it.

metadata.title: Cities — Revenue Items
metadata.description: Shows municipal revenue of cities by year, split into taxes and rates and other sources, supporting the discussion of local special taxes and central grants.

metadata.title: Cities — Expenditure Items
metadata.description: Shows how city governments spent their funds by category across four fiscal years, from 1917-18 to 1920-21.

metadata.title: Towns and Villages — Revenue Items
metadata.description: Gives the revenue of towns and villages for four fiscal years, separating taxes and rates from revenue drawn from other sources.

metadata.title: Towns and Villages — Expenditure Items
metadata.description: Shows how towns and villages spent their funds by category over four fiscal years, with a grand total including other items.

metadata.title: Local Loans Outstanding
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the amount of local loans outstanding at each March 31st from 1917 to 1921, broken down by prefectures, counties, cities, towns and villages, and local associations.

metadata.title: Classification of Local Loans Outstanding
metadata.description: Breaks down local loans outstanding at each March 31st from 1917 to 1921 by purpose, such as education, sanitary works, industry, public works and debts redeemed.

metadata.title: [Bank, Company and Total Bond and Debenture Issues, 1916-1921]
metadata.description: Annual figures for bonds and debentures issued by banks, companies and in total, showing the growth of issues in the years before the article on the money market.

metadata.title: [Terms of Typical Bond Issues, 1921-1922]
metadata.description: Issue price, term and yield of a few typical bonds and debentures from 1921 and 1922, used to show how favourable the money market had become.

metadata.title: Taxable & Private Owned Land
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 cho)
metadata.description: The page gives the total area of taxable land for 1919 to 1921, broken down by paddy field, other farm, building lot, forest and plain, as part of the land statistics.

metadata.title: [Taxable Land to Gross Area and Per Capita Rate of Tan]
metadata.description: Shows the share of taxable land in gross area and the per capita tan rate of taxable land by category for 1919–1921, following the note on non-productive areas.

metadata.title: [Area of Arable Land in Japan Proper]
metadata.description: Classifies the arable land of Japan proper by landed farmers, tenanted area and total, split into paddy field and upland, at the end of December 1918–1921.

metadata.title: [Number of Families Engaged in Farming]
metadata.description: Gives the number of landed farmers, tenants, combining tenantry and total farming families at the end of December 1918–1921.

metadata.title: [Landed Farmers Classified by Area Cultivated per Family]
metadata.description: Breaks down landed farmer families by the area of cultivated land per family in 1920 and 1921, with numbers and percentages of the total.

metadata.title: [Maximum and Minimum Assessed Values of Land]
metadata.description: Shows the highest and lowest assessed values for paddy, upland and building land, illustrating how the total assessed value changed after the tax revisions.

metadata.title: [Total Assessed Value of Land, 1888–1921]
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the total assessed land values by category in three years, showing the decline in paddy and upland values after the tax changes.

metadata.title: [Average Price per Tan of Paddy and Upland Fields, 1914–1922]
metadata.description: Shows the average per-tan price of paddy and upland farms as computed by the Hypotheo Bank, illustrating the wartime rise and subsequent fall.

metadata.title: [Average Yield per Tan of Paddy Field, 1904–1920]
metadata.caption: (Unit: koku)
metadata.description: Gives the average paddy yield per tan over successive periods, showing the gradual improvement in the productive power of tilled land.

metadata.title: Ratio of One-Crop and Two-Crop Farms
metadata.caption: in 1,000 cho.
metadata.description: The official returns give the number of one-crop and two-crop paddy-fields in thousand cho for 1917, 1919 and 1921, showing their totals.

metadata.title: Animal Labor in Tillage
metadata.caption: Cattle and horses employed in tillage are returned as follows
metadata.description: The page gives the numbers of horned cattle and horses used for tillage in each year from 1916 to 1920, as officially returned.

metadata.title: Rice
metadata.description: The table gives rice area, production, average yield, and export and import quantities and values for 1917–1921 with a normal yield baseline, showing the rice supply position.

metadata.title: [Yield per Tan of Rice Varieties]
metadata.description: Average yields per tan at Government Experimental Farms show the middle variety of rice plant to be the most productive of the three main varieties.

metadata.title: [Rice Consumed at Home per Period, Total and Per Capita]
metadata.description: Estimated home consumption of rice by period, in total and per capita, obtained by balancing exports and imports against domestic yield.

metadata.title: Barley and Wheat
metadata.caption: (Production, in 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Shows barley, naked barley and wheat production for 1919 to 1921, illustrating that these upland and second-crop grains are important in Japanese agriculture.

metadata.title: [Area of Barley, Naked Barley and Wheat by Paddy-field and Upland Farm, 1921]
metadata.description: Breaks down the 1921 barley, naked barley and wheat acreage between paddy-field and upland farms, showing that the crops are grown mainly in upland farms.

metadata.title: Miscellaneous Grains
metadata.caption: (Production, in 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Gives the production of millets, buckwheat and maize for 1918 to 1920, showing these minor grains grown mainly in mountainous districts and remote places.

metadata.title: Beans, Potatoes and Sweet Potatoes
metadata.caption: (Production, in 1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the production of beans, peas, sweet potatoes and potatoes for 1918–1920, illustrating the importance of these subsidiary farm crops in Japan.

metadata.title: Productions of Some Special Crops
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows output of special industrial and fibre crops from 1918 to 1920, with the text noting tobacco's growth and the decline of cotton and indigo.

metadata.title: Productions of Other Minor Crops
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 kan)
metadata.description: Lists output of several minor vegetable and root crops for 1917–1920, where dashes mark years with no recorded production.

metadata.title: [Production of Miscellaneous Crops, 1917–1920]
metadata.description: Table giving yearly figures for various miscellaneous crops such as konnyaku, ginger, flax and vegetables, placed at the end of the agriculture section before the stock-breeding discussion.

metadata.title: Number of Cattle
metadata.description: Gives the yearly numbers of cows, bulls, total cattle, calvings and deaths from 1918 to 1920, illustrating the state of stock-farming alongside the sheep-rearing discussion.

metadata.title: Number of Horses
metadata.description: Shows the yearly number of native, cross-bred, foreign and total horses from 1918 to 1920, part of the stock-farming statistics on this page.

metadata.title: Number of Stallions
metadata.description: Shows the number of stallions in Japan by type (native, cross, foreign) and total for 1918 to 1920.

metadata.title: Number of Sheep, Goats and Swine
metadata.description: Gives the yearly head counts of sheep, goats and swine in Japan from 1917 to 1920.

metadata.title: Slaughtering Returns
metadata.description: Reports the number of slaughter-houses and animals slaughtered by kind for 1918 to 1920.

metadata.title: Statistics on Poultry
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the number of poultry-keeping families, fowls, chickens and egg production with values, at the end of June for 1918 to 1920.

metadata.title: Leading Dairy Districts (1920)
metadata.description: Shows the leading dairy districts in 1920 and the national totals of dairies, milk cows and milk output for 1916–1920, illustrating the scale of the dairy industry discussed in the text.

metadata.title: [Animals Affected by Epidemics, 1918–1920]
metadata.description: Lists the numbers of animals affected by anthrax, blackleg, cholera, erysipelas and hydrophobia from 1918 to 1920, showing the losses caused by animal epidemics.

metadata.title: Output of Fruits
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 kan)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly output of major fruits in Japan from 1916 to 1920, illustrating the growth of fruit cultivation described in the Horticulture introduction.

metadata.title: Sericultural Families by Season
metadata.description: The table gives the number of sericultural families by season (spring, summer, autumn) for 1917 to 1921, illustrating the scale of silkworm-rearing households.

metadata.title: [Egg-cards Hatched and Output of Cocoons, Spring and Summer-Autumn Varieties]
metadata.description: Egg-cards hatched, cocoon output by grade and total value for the spring and summer-autumn silkworm varieties, 1917 to 1921, shown as the figures for the rate of cocoon production.

metadata.title: No. of Establishments and Reeling Basins
metadata.description: Number of silk reeling establishments by size class of basins and total reeling basins, 1917 to 1921, illustrating the classification of silk reelers.

metadata.title: Output of Raw Silk
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 : 1 kan = lb. 8,267)
metadata.description: Annual output of raw silk and waste silk with their values and total value, 1917 to 1921, given to show the scale of silk production.

metadata.title: [Silk Cocoon Prices, 1918-1922]
metadata.description: Annual highest, lowest and average prices of silk cocoons in yen, showing market price movements for 1918 to 1922 within the sericulture section.

metadata.title: Silkworm Eggs
metadata.caption: Amount Produced (in No. of moths)
metadata.description: Number of silkworm egg producers and the amount of reproductive and industrial silkworm eggs produced, with totals, for 1918 to 1920.

metadata.title: Mulberry Plantations
metadata.description: Area of mulberry fields in cho for the years ending June 1916 to 1921, used as the basis for the sericulture industry's leaf supply.

metadata.title: Japanese and Foreign Exporters
metadata.description: Number of raw silk bales exported directly by Japanese and foreign firms each season, with the percentage share of each, showing the growing Japanese role in direct export.

metadata.title: Statistics on Tea
metadata.description: Shows the tea-growing area in cho and the number of tea manufacturers for 1915–1920, supporting the text's point that tea output has remained stationary.

metadata.title: Output of Various Kinds of Tea (kwan)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly output of the various grades of Japanese tea from 1917 to 1920, showing the decline in total production over the period.

metadata.title: Leading Tea Producing Districts (1920)
metadata.description: Lists the output and value of tea in the leading tea-producing prefectures in 1920.

metadata.title: Export of Tea
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the quantity (kin) and value (yen) of Japan's tea exports by type in 1917 and 1920, illustrating the fall in the tea trade.

metadata.title: Area of Forests
metadata.caption: (in cho)
metadata.description: Shows the area of Japan proper's forests by ownership class (Crown, State, Communal, Temple, Private) for 1915, 1918 and 1920, illustrating the broad classification described in the text.

metadata.title: Yield of Forests in Yen (Dec. 1920)
metadata.description: Shows the yield of Japan's forests by ownership category in December 1920, split into timber and fagots, to illustrate the revenue returns from forests.

metadata.title: [State Forest Receipts, Expenses and Balance, 1917-1920]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000; excluding Hokkaido and the Bonin)
metadata.description: Gives recent annual receipts, expenses and balance of State forest accounts, which are kept with great strictness, to show the comparatively small rate of profit.

metadata.title: [Forest Yield of Principal Timbers, 1920]
metadata.caption: (1 koku = 10 cubic ft.)
metadata.description: Lists the forest yield in koku and value in yen of the principal timber species in Japan proper for 1920.

metadata.title: Principal By-Products (1920 in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table lists the principal forest by-products of 1920 and their values in thousands of yen, in two side-by-side columns.

metadata.title: [By-Products from State Forests and Wild Lands, 1920]
metadata.description: The table shows by-products from State forests and wild lands, the second part of the by-product statistics for 1920, given in thousands of yen.

metadata.title: [Foreign Timber Inflow by Species and Volume, 1914–1921]
metadata.description: Shows the rising volume of American cedar, pine and fir timber imported into Japan from 1914 to 1921, taken from the Oriental Economist, to illustrate the foreign timber inflow.

metadata.title: Catches and Marine Production
metadata.description: The page gives the value of fish and marine catches and of marine products such as manure and fish oil for 1918 to 1921, showing the economic weight of the fishing industry.

metadata.title: Principal Catches
metadata.description: This table lists the quantities in kan and values in yen of the principal fish caught in 1919 and 1920, with totals including other catches.

metadata.title: Principal Marine Products
metadata.description: The page lists values in yen of the principal dried marine products for 1920 and 1921.

metadata.title: Export of Fish and Marine Products
metadata.caption: (in value of ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the export value of marine products, canned or bottled fish, and fish and whale oil for 1919–1921, with a total for marine products.

metadata.title: Acquiculture
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Reports the value of aquaculture output by species (oysters, carp, eel, laver) for 1918–1920, with totals including other products.

metadata.title: Deep Sea Catches
metadata.caption: (In Japan proper for 1921).
metadata.description: Gives the 1921 deep-sea catch in Japan proper by fishing method, showing boats and total catch value, supporting the account of pelagic fishing's growth after state bounties.

metadata.title: [Coral Fishing Catches by Prefecture]
metadata.description: The top of the page continues a list of coral catches by prefecture, with totals, before the text notes a new coral bed near Ogasawara.

metadata.title: Distribution of Strata
metadata.caption: relative percentage
metadata.description: Shows the relative percentage of sedimentary and igneous rock formations in Japan, given to introduce the discussion of the country's geological strata and mineral deposits.

metadata.title: [Mineral Production, 1917-1921]
metadata.description: Summarises Japan's annual output and value of gold, silver, copper, coal and other minerals from 1917 to 1921, introducing the mining section that follows.

metadata.title: [Copper Production, Import, Export, Consumption and Stock in Japan, 1914–1921]
metadata.description: The table gives annual copper production, imports, exports, domestic consumption and stocks in Japan from 1914 to 1921, illustrating how the industry declined after the war boom.

metadata.title: Principal Metal Mines (in 1920)
metadata.caption: (Figures in unit of 1,000)
metadata.description: The table lists the leading metal mines producing not less than ¥500,000 a year, giving gold, silver, copper and total output by mining district for 1920.

metadata.title: [Coal Reserves by District]
metadata.caption: (in 1000 tons)
metadata.description: Gives the estimated available coal resources in thousand tons, split between hidden stores and workable seams for Honshu and Shikoku, Kyushu and Hokkaido.

metadata.title: Investment
metadata.description: Shows the number of coal companies and their subscribed and paid-up capital from 1914 to 1921, quoted from the Oriental Economist's Major Industries of Japan.

metadata.title: Output, Import & Export
metadata.caption: (in 1000 tons)
metadata.description: Gives coal output, imports, exports and the resulting balance in thousand tons for selected years from 1914 to 1921.

metadata.title: Rate of Increase of Output
metadata.description: Shows the absolute increase of coal output, the rate of increase and the average rate of increase over successive periods from 1877 to 1921.

metadata.title: Principal Uses of Coal (in 1000 tons)
metadata.description: Shows the declining output and principal uses of coal in Japan from 1914 to 1921, which the text attributes to high prices and competition from hydro-electricity.

metadata.title: Output of the Chief Coal-Fields in Japan Proper
metadata.description: Lists annual coal output of the chief coal-fields in Japan Proper for 1919 and 1921, with the company working each field, illustrating the industry's structure.

metadata.title: Analysis of Coals from the Principal Coal-Fields
metadata.description: Gives proximate analysis, caking quality, specific gravity and calorific power for coals from the main coal-fields, shown after the coal-field output table.

metadata.title: [Output of Crude Oil, 1913-1921]
metadata.caption: (In 1000 koku)
metadata.description: Shows the annual yield of crude oil in 1000 koku, illustrating the rise after the adoption of rotary well-sinking in 1912 and the decline from 1917.

metadata.title: Output of Refined Oil
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Gives the output of refined oil by product type (volatile, lamp, solar, heavy, machine oil) for selected years to show the position of refined production.

metadata.title: [Arrivals of Foreign Refined and Crude Oil, 1917-1921]
metadata.caption: (In 1000 koku, exclusive of imports by the Navy)
metadata.description: Shows the arrivals of foreign refined and crude oil in Japan over the last five years from 1917, explaining Japan's reliance on imported oil as domestic yields declined.

metadata.title: Investment in Mining Business
metadata.caption: (Capital paid up being in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table shows the growing number of companies and paid-up capital in mining business from 1917 to 1921, split into metal, coal, combined coal-and-metal, petroleum and other groups.

metadata.title: [Paid-up Capital of Mining Companies, Groups IV and V, 1917–1921]
metadata.description: Shows the number of companies and paid-up capital of the mining groups IV and V and their totals for 1917 to 1921, supporting the discussion of mining business.

metadata.title: Mine-Workers Classified by Mines, Age and Sex, End of June, 1920
metadata.description: Gives the number of mine-workers by type of mine, age group, sex and whether working underground or above ground, at the end of June 1920.

metadata.title: Accidents at the Mines
metadata.description: The table gives the yearly number of accidents at Japanese mines from 1916 to 1920, with deaths and injured workers broken down by severity.

metadata.title: [Factories Employing Over 5 Operatives, 1914–1921]
metadata.description: The official statistics of factories employing over five operatives for 1914 to 1921, showing factories run by motive or manual power and the numbers of male, female and total operatives.

metadata.title: [Factories by Nature of Industry, 1921]
metadata.description: The 1921 factories employing over five operatives, classified by nature of industry, with factories by motive and manual power, horse power and number of employees.

metadata.title: [Engines Used in Factories, Development of Motive Powers, 1921]
metadata.description: Classification of the about 2,340,000 horse power of 1921 by kind of engine used, showing numbers of engines and horse power for steam, gas, oil, motor and water wheel types.

metadata.title: [Average Annual Output of Cotton Yarn by Count Grade]
metadata.description: Shows the shift in cotton yarn output toward finer counts, with the share of thick, medium and thin yarns in each three-year period.

metadata.title: [Cotton Yarn Supply and Demand (in Bales)]
metadata.caption: (in bales)
metadata.description: Summarises the annual supply and demand of cotton yarn in bales, comparing output and imports with exports, home consumption and balance.

metadata.title: [Raw Cotton Imports by Country, 1921-1922]
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 piculs)
metadata.description: Classifies the raw cotton, including cotton in the seed and cotton ginned, imported in 1921 and 1922 by country of origin.

metadata.title: [Paid-up Capital, Reserves and Average Dividend of Spinning Companies]
metadata.description: Gives the growth of paid-up capital and reserves of spinning companies after the war boom, with average dividend rates by half-year.

metadata.title: Average Working Spindles Per Day
metadata.description: Gives the average number of working spindles per day in the spinning industry for 1913 to 1921, by spindle type and spindles per loom.

metadata.title: Data on Leading Companies (1921)
metadata.description: Shows capital, factories, spindles and looms of the four largest hemp spinning companies in 1921, supporting the text on the leading establishments.

metadata.title: Statistics on Textile Industry
metadata.description: Gives official figures for factories and families, looms, operatives and output of the textile industry for 1919 to 1921, showing the decline after the peak year.

metadata.title: Output of Fabrics
metadata.description: Classifies the value of fabrics produced in 1919 to 1921 by type, such as silk, mixed, cotton, hempen and miscellaneous fabrics.

metadata.title: [Cotton Fabrics Statistics]
metadata.description: Shows the number of cotton factories, motive power, operatives, output, imports and exports of cotton fabrics from 1913 to 1920, illustrating the rise and fall after the 1919 peak.

metadata.title: Staple Products
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the output of staple cotton products such as white cloth, striped stuff, flannel, crape and towels, with totals, for the years 1913 to 1921.

metadata.title: [Silk and Cotton Fabric Factories and Operatives, 1920]
metadata.description: Official data on the number of silk and silk-and-cotton fabric factories, power-driven looms and operatives, showing the scale of the fabric industry.

metadata.title: Staple Exports
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Quantities and values of the main silk piece goods exported in 1920 and 1921, showing habutaye, crape, satin, pongee and taffeta trade.

metadata.title: Data on Woolen Fabrics
metadata.description: Statistics on the woolen fabric industry, including muslin, flannel, serge and other woolen goods, shown for 1917 to 1921, supporting the discussion of the muslin-de-laine trade.

metadata.title: Import of Raw Materials
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly import quantities and values of tops and wool, the raw materials feeding the textile trade, for 1913 to 1921.

metadata.title: Staple Import and Export of Fabrics
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the main imported and exported fabric categories, such as serges, cloth and blanket wool, in selected years from 1913 to 1921.

metadata.title: Statistics of Muslin
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Gives muslin output, and the import and export volumes and values, for selected years from 1913 to 1920.

metadata.title: [Number of Electric Companies by Capacity, 1912 and 1921]
metadata.description: The table shows how the number of Japanese electric companies in each capacity class grew between 1912 and 1921, illustrating the expansion of the hydro-electric industry's scope of business.

metadata.title: Supply of Power (k. w.)
metadata.description: Shows the growth of hydro-electric and steam power supply in Japan for 1911, 1920 and 1921, which underlies the rapid progress of motor-driven industry described above.

metadata.title: Motors as Classified by Use for 1921
metadata.description: Breaks down the motors in use in 1921 by industrial application, comparing number and horsepower with 1914 horsepower to show where motor power was concentrated.

metadata.title: Electric Light
metadata.description: Gives the growth of electric lighting from 1912 to 1921 in cases, households, lamps, candle-power and converted power, showing the spread of electric light across the country.

metadata.title: [Capital and Profit Figures by Year]
metadata.description: Shows subscribed and paid-up capital, debentures, profit and dividend percentage for the electric companies in 1916 and 1921, the tail of a table begun on the previous page.

metadata.title: Metallic Wire 10 c.p.
metadata.caption: (inclusive hire of apparatuses)
metadata.description: Gives the electric lighting and power rates per unit for hydraulic and coal-burning generation in 1918–1921, showing the rise in rating.

metadata.title: Supply of Power
metadata.description: Shows the price of power per horsepower and per kilowatt-hour from hydraulic and coal sources for 1918–1921.

metadata.title: Total Output of Electro-Chemical Industry
metadata.caption: in ¥1,000
metadata.description: Shows the yearly total output of the electro-chemical industry, which peaked in 1918 and then declined through 1921.

metadata.title: Value of Electro-Chemical Products in 1921 in ¥1,000
metadata.description: Shows the 1921 value of Japan's electro-chemical products by type, with a total, introducing the discussion of the gas industry that follows.

metadata.title: [Lamps, Heating and Motor Installations and Motive Power of Gas Industry]
metadata.description: Gives the yearly number of gas lamps, heating and motor installations and motive power used by the gas industry, showing the relative proportion of gas for different purposes.

metadata.title: [Situation of the Gas Industry]
metadata.description: Shows the business position of the gas industry in Japan by year: number of works, paid-up capital, gas production and by-product output of coke and coal-tar.

metadata.title: Tariff
metadata.caption: (per 1,000 c. f.)
metadata.description: Shows the tariff rates per 1,000 cubic feet for the whole country and major cities in 1914 and 1921, as a basis for comparing charges.

metadata.title: Balance-Sheet
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives yearly profit, ratio to paid-up capital, dividends and dividend percentage for the mechanical industry's companies from 1916 to 1920.

metadata.title: Mechanical and Engineering Productions in 1920
metadata.caption: (¥ million)
metadata.description: Shows the value of mechanical and engineering production in 1920 by product class, illustrating the classification of the roughly ¥541 million output of workshops employing at least 30 workers.

metadata.title: [Output of Principal Dynamo and Allied Machine Productions, 1914, 1919 and 1920]
metadata.caption: (¥ million)
metadata.description: Gives the output of principal dynamo and allied machine products from leading works such as the Mitsubishi and Kawasaki yards, showing wartime growth from 1914 to 1920.

metadata.title: Import of Dynamos, Etc.
metadata.description: The table shows the import of dynamos and related high-efficiency machines in 1914, 1919, 1920 and 1921, illustrating Japan's growing dependence on foreign-made machinery.

metadata.title: Mechanic Industry in Customs Returns — Exports
metadata.description: The page gives the total export values of machinery and related mechanic-industry goods, and of miscellaneous metallic products, for 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: Principal Items of Export
metadata.description: The principal export items within the mechanic industry, such as watches, musical instruments, bicycles, ships and electric machines, are listed with their values for 1920 and 1921.

metadata.title: [Imports of Machines and Parts]
metadata.description: Import values for machines and parts in 1919, 1920 and 1921, given as the main import category for the industry.

metadata.title: [Imports of Steamers and Transportation Machines]
metadata.description: Import values for steamers, marine engineering machines, railway rolling stock and transportation machines across 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: [Imports of Scientific Instruments and Guns]
metadata.description: Import values for scientific instruments and guns in 1919 to 1921, listed among the imports for the machinery industry.

metadata.title: [Principal Items of Import]
metadata.description: A list of the principal machinery and equipment items imported into Japan, with values for 1920 and 1921, introduced by the statement 'Principal items of import are as follows'.

metadata.title: [Mechanic Works by Organisation Type, Number, Capital and Reserves]
metadata.caption: (Capital and reserves in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Summarises the number of mechanic works by company type and by speciality, with their paid-up capital and reserves, following the note on workforce size.

metadata.title: Leading Mechanic Works
metadata.caption: (Capital in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists leading private mechanic works by speciality (steamship, steam engine, water turbine, gas and oil engine), with the location and subscribed and paid-up capital of each.

metadata.title: [Principal Electric, Machine Tool, Spinning and Locomotive Manufacturers]
metadata.description: The page lists leading Japanese makers of electric apparatus, machine tools, spinning and weaving machinery and rolling stock, with their locations and capital figures.

metadata.title: Working Result in Recent Years
metadata.description: Shows the average annual profit rate and dividend of nine leading shipbuilding and rolling-stock companies by half-year working term from 1917 to 1921.

metadata.title: [Caustic Soda Import, Export and Production, 1915–1921]
metadata.caption: (figures given in 1000 lb)
metadata.description: The table gives Japan's caustic soda imports, exports and production in 1000 lb for 1915–1921, illustrating the position of the industry after the wartime expansion of factories.

metadata.title: Production
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table gives annual production values of porcelain, Shippo enamel ware, bricks, tiles and pipes for 1919 to 1921, illustrating the output of the brick and tile industries described above it.

metadata.title: Refined Sugar (Japan Proper)
metadata.caption: (in 1,000 kin)
metadata.description: Shows Japan proper's refined sugar production, home consumption and exports from 1917 to 1921, illustrating the market conditions behind the refiners' output cuts.

metadata.title: Crude Sugar Used by Refiners
metadata.description: Gives the volumes of Java and Formosan crude sugar consumed by Japanese refiners in 1917 to 1920, showing the raw material supply on which the refining business depended.

metadata.title: Sugar Companies (Japan Proper)
metadata.description: The page closes the discussion of the sugar industry by listing Japan Proper sugar refining companies with their daily capacity and 1920 output.

metadata.title: [Artificial Fertilizer Companies, 1921]
metadata.description: Shows the scale of the leading artificial fertilizer companies at the end of 1921, with their number, factories, capital, working capacity and sulphuric acid output.

metadata.title: Business Result of 5 Leading Cos.
metadata.description: Gives capital, monthly capacity, profits and dividends of five leading artificial fertilizer companies from the first half of 1920 to the first half of 1922.

metadata.title: [Production and Exports of Matches, 1917–1921]
metadata.description: Japanese match production, value, and exports for 1917–1921, shown to illustrate the industry's setback from oversupply, lost markets, and rising costs.

metadata.title: Output, Consumption, Export, Etc. in Koku
metadata.description: Shows beer output, domestic consumption, exports and imports from 1915 to 1921, illustrating the industry's growth before the text on the 1921 distribution of output.

metadata.title: [Business Condition of the Four Leading Breweries]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Business results of the four leading beer companies are listed for the two half-years of 1920 and 1921, the latter two being the latest additions.

metadata.title: Statistics
metadata.description: Production figures for sake, beer and soy in Chiba-ken are given for the years ended March 1917 to 1920, illustrating the prefecture's brewing output.

metadata.title: [Position of the Three Leading Seifun (Milling) Companies]
metadata.description: Shows the capital, paid-up amounts, loans, reserves, profits and capacity of the three leading Seifun (flour-milling) companies, illustrating the milling business.

metadata.title: [Output of Paper Kinds Exceeding 10 Million Lbs. in 1921]
metadata.caption: (in unit of 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Lists the 1921 output of the paper kinds that each exceeded 10 million lbs. from the mills of the Paper League.

metadata.title: [Foreign-Style Paper Industry, 1920 and 1921]
metadata.caption: (in 1000)
metadata.description: Gives the latest figures on production, sales, exports and imports of the foreign-style paper industry for 1920 and 1921.

metadata.title: [Output of the Three Leading Paper Mills (Oji, Fuji and Mitsubishi), 1921]
metadata.caption: (in 1000)
metadata.description: Shows the 1921 output by paper grade of the three leading mills, Oji, Fuji and Mitsubishi, with the total for all mills.

metadata.title: Output of Japanese Papers
metadata.description: Gives the annual output of Japanese (native-style) paper for the whole country, split between the Hanshi and Mino types, with total value, for 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: Financial Position of Oji and Fuji
metadata.description: Shows paid-up capital, profit, profit ratio and dividend of the Oji and Fuji paper companies over several half-year periods, as evidence of the industry's financial position.

metadata.title: [Celluloid Production, Domestic Sales and Export]
metadata.description: Shows celluloid output, domestic sales and exports for 1918 to 1921, with exports of toys and miscellaneous manufactures, illustrating the post-war decline described in the text.

metadata.title: [Leather Production by Kind and Export]
metadata.description: Shows annual leather production by source animal, total output and exports, with the text noting that imports in the same period were far smaller in value.

metadata.title: Isinglass
metadata.description: Gives the quantity and value of Japanese isinglass (kanten) production for the years ended March 1918 to 1921, which was exported mainly for jam making.

metadata.title: [Production of Lacquer Juice and Lacquered Wares, 1918-1921]
metadata.description: Shows annual production of lacquer juice and lacquered wares in 1918-1921, presented to illustrate the trend in the lacquer industry described in the preceding text.

metadata.title: Fish Oil and Whale Oil
metadata.description: Shows the output of fish oils (sardine, herring), whale oil and others, with totals, to illustrate the recent decline in the vegetable oils and waxes trade.

metadata.title: Vegetable Oils
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of vegetable oils by kind (rape seed, sesame, cotton seed, bean, peanut) with total for each year, showing the decline in recent years.

metadata.title: Vegetable Wax
metadata.description: Records annual production of crude and refined vegetable wax for 1919 to 1921, part of the review of declining oils and waxes.

metadata.title: Oils and Fats in Trade Returns
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Summarises export and import values of oils and fats in the trade returns, showing the recent movement in these commodities.

metadata.title: Soaps
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives recent soap production from leading factories by category (toilet, industrial, laundry and others), as the text introduces the leading soap makers.

metadata.title: Exports
metadata.description: Shows Japan's exports of toilet and laundry soap by quantity and value for 1918 to 1921, illustrating the soap trade that is the subject of this section.

metadata.title: [Peppermint Production and Exports]
metadata.description: Gives the value of peppermint produced (crude, menthol crystal, oil) and exported (menthol, peppermint oil) from 1918 to 1921, showing the recovery of the industry after 1918.

metadata.title: Production
metadata.description: Shows the value of Japan's canned production by category (beef, fish and shellfish, fruit, vegetables) and total from 1919 to 1921, as background to the canning industry.

metadata.title: [Condensed Milk Production and Imports]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows condensed milk production and imports for 1919 to 1921, illustrating how foreign competition and over-production slowed the home industry's development.

metadata.title: [Toy Exports Classified by Materials]
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the value of toy exports in 1920 and 1921 classified by material, with celluloid, porcelain, rubber, wood, paper and cotton toys listed separately.

metadata.title: Destinations
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the export destinations, by value, of the straw and chip braid goods described above, for 1919 to 1921, with the sudden 1921 drop attributed to German competition.

metadata.title: Productions
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the annual value of domestic production of straw, chip, mixed and hemp braids for 1919 to 1921, showing the total output of the braid industry.

metadata.title: Exports
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Records the value of braid exports from Japan by type (straw, chip, mixed, others) from 1918 to 1921.

metadata.title: Production
metadata.description: Shows Japanese hosiery production by category and total value for 1919–1921, in thousands of yen, illustrating the industry's wartime boom and postwar decline.

metadata.title: Staple Exports
metadata.description: Gives the value of hosiery exported from Japan by product type and in total for 1919–1921, in thousands of yen.

metadata.title: Principal Markets
metadata.description: Shows the value of Japanese hosiery exports to each principal overseas market region from 1919 to 1921, in thousands of yen.

metadata.title: [Mat Production and Exports, 1918–1921]
metadata.description: The table gives Kobe mat production by type and mat exports by type for 1918 to 1921, illustrating the trade covered by the Government Mat Conditioning House's inspections.

metadata.title: Enamelled Hard Wares
metadata.description: Shows the production and export values of enamelled hardware for 1919 to 1921 as part of the minor manufactures survey.

metadata.title: Wood Manufactures (including Cabinet Works, Boxes, Barrels, Etc.)
metadata.description: Gives the production and export values of wood manufactures, such as cabinet work, boxes and barrels, for 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: Bamboo Wares
metadata.description: Records bamboo ware production and exports for 1919 to 1921, noting that exports consist mainly of baskets, trunks and bags.

metadata.title: Fans and Folding Fans
metadata.description: Presents the production and export values of fans and folding fans for 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: Leather Goods
metadata.description: Shows production and export values of leather goods such as boots, bags and purses for 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: Toilet Articles
metadata.description: Gives production and export values of toilet articles for 1919 to 1921.

metadata.title: Wicker Works
metadata.description: Shows the yearly production and export values of the wicker works industry from 1919 to 1921, illustrating the trade's scale in the Industry chapter.

metadata.title: Insulated Electric Wire
metadata.description: Gives the production and export quantities and values of insulated electric wire for 1919 to 1921, showing the industry's growth before the economic depression discussed below.

metadata.title: [Growth of Productive Capacity Before and After the European War]
metadata.description: The table shows percentage growth of productive capacity in various Japanese industries, comparing 1913 output with post-1914 maxima, to illustrate the effect of the European war.

metadata.title: [Main Features of Sales Business in 1920]
metadata.description: The list gives the main features of sales business for 1920, showing the amounts for leading lines of trade in thousands of yen, as the preceding text describes the rapid growth of sales business.

metadata.title: Business Promotion in 1922
metadata.caption: (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the capital invested in 1922 by business field, split into new promotion, expansion and debentures, as compiled from the Bank of Japan investigation.

metadata.title: Companies Classified by Organization (End, 1920)
metadata.description: Gives the number and paid-up capital of joint stock companies, limited and unlimited partnerships at the end of 1920, grouped by size of capital.

metadata.title: [Number, Paid-up Capital and Reserves of Companies by Industry, 1917–1920]
metadata.description: Shows the number of companies, paid-up capital and reserves by industry from 1917 to 1920, illustrating the growth of the company economy in Japan during the period.

metadata.title: Business Results in Recent Years
metadata.caption: (Money in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives business results of a small sample of about 150 companies, from the Oriental Economist, for spinning mills and woollen textiles over the second half of 1918 to 1921.

metadata.title: [Paid-up Capital, Reserves, Profit and Ratio to Capital by Industry]
metadata.caption: Continued
metadata.description: Continuation of a table giving paid-up capital, reserves, profit and the ratio of profit to capital for companies in each industry, from paper mills through sugar.

metadata.title: [Chambers of Commerce, 1916–1920]
metadata.description: Statistics for recent years on the number, membership and annual expenses of Chambers of Commerce in Japan, shown to illustrate the growth of these bodies after the law was amended.

metadata.title: Stock, Rice and Merchandise Exchanges
metadata.description: Summary figures for the stock, rice and merchandise exchanges of Japan, showing their number, capital, reserves, brokers, receipts, expenses and profits for 1918 to 1921.

metadata.title: Volume of Staple Commodities Transacted
metadata.description: Annual volumes of stocks, rice, cotton yarn and silk transacted on the Japanese exchanges, with a note explaining what the stock and cotton yarn totals cover.

metadata.title: Volume of Shares Transacted at Various Places (in 1,000)
metadata.caption: (in 1,000)
metadata.description: Number of shares transacted at the Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya exchanges and in total, for each year from 1918 to 1921.

metadata.title: Volume of Rice Transacted on Rice Exchanges
metadata.description: Rice volumes transacted on the rice exchanges overall and at Tokyo and Osaka, with average quotation per koku, for 1918 to 1921; the text following discusses delivery proportions.

metadata.title: Quotations of Leading Stocks at Tokyo and Osaka (1922)
metadata.caption: (50 sen or above counted as ¥1; smaller fragments ignored)
metadata.description: Introducing the Tokyo Stock Exchange, this table gives the paid-up value, highest and lowest 1922 quotations, and dividend rates for leading stocks at Tokyo and Osaka.

metadata.title: [Shares Quoted for Time Delivery, Prices and Dividend Rates]
metadata.description: The table lists selected shares traded for time delivery, giving paid-up value, highest and lowest prices, and dividend rates for the second halves of 1921 and 1922.

metadata.title: Stocks Transacted & Average Quotation on Tokyo Exchange
metadata.description: Shows the number of stocks transacted, total value and average price per share on the Tokyo Exchange for 1920 to 1922, as a measure of market activity.

metadata.title: Movement of Leading Shares
metadata.description: Gives the highest and lowest share prices, with the month of each, for four leading shares in 1921 and 1922.

metadata.title: Amount of Merchandise Transacted (1921)
metadata.description: Shows the 1921 volume of cotton yarn and raw silk dealt in at the Tokyo, Osaka and Yokohama merchandise exchanges.

metadata.title: [Principal Goods Warehoused, June 1920 to December 1922]
metadata.description: The table compares the principal goods warehoused in Tokyo and Yokohama at three dates, showing how the congestion of imported stock eased after the post-Armistice speculative buying.

metadata.title: Index Figures in Recent Years Compared
metadata.description: Shows the Bank of Japan's wholesale price index for Tokyo at several months in 1920–1922, so the 1922 fall can be compared with earlier years.

metadata.title: Wholesale Quotations of Staple Commodities
metadata.caption: (Average in Dec.)
metadata.description: Lists December average wholesale prices of staple commodities in 1922 against 1921, showing how prices moved over the year.

metadata.title: Movement of Staple Commodities in 1922
