metadata.title: Balance of Trade
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: A table of the balance of trade between Japan proper and various countries for 1935 and 1936, introduced by the text on the import-export balance.

metadata.title: Value of Exports and Imports
metadata.caption: (Japan Proper and Karafuto)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of Japan's exports and imports, with totals and the trade balance, from 1897 to 1936, to illustrate the growth of foreign trade.

metadata.title: Total Value of Exports and Imports of Gold and Silver Bullion and Specie
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly value of gold and silver bullion and specie traded by Japan from 1897 to 1936, with the resulting export or import surplus for each year.

metadata.title: Rate of Trade Expansion of Japan Proper in the Past 5 Years
metadata.description: Summarises the year-on-year percentage growth of Japan Proper's exports and imports over 1932-1936, with the resulting trade balance, to show recent trade expansion.

metadata.title: Exports and Imports of the Empire in 1936
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Summarises the Empire's 1936 exports and imports by region (Japan Proper, Chosen, Taiwan, South Seas), with changes from the previous year.

metadata.title: Gold and Silver
metadata.description: Shows the 1936 exports and imports of gold and silver by region, with changes from the previous year, as a companion to the trade totals.

metadata.title: Important Commodities (Japan Proper) — Exports
metadata.caption: (Japan Proper)
metadata.description: Lists the main Japan Proper export commodities for the year, with their values in yen and the change from the previous year.

metadata.title: Exports in 1936
metadata.description: Shows Japan's exports for 1936 by commodity group, with amounts in yen and changes from the previous year, ending with total imports and the excess of imports over exports.

metadata.title: Value of Chief Commodities Exported to Various Countries
metadata.caption: Japan Proper and Karafuto (In ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of cotton tissue exports and the chief destinations of these exports in 1934 to 1936, for Japan Proper and Karafuto.

metadata.title: [Foreign Trade by Countries and Commodities, 1934-1936]
metadata.description: A continuous list of Japan's trade figures for 1934 to 1936, showing values for foreign countries and commodities such as raw silk, rayon, machines, iron and silk tissues.

metadata.title: [Exports in 1936 by Commodity and Country (Left Column)]
metadata.description: Export values by destination country for major commodities in 1936, compared with 1934 and 1935, showing shifts in Japan's overseas trade.

metadata.title: [Exports in 1936 by Commodity and Country (Right Column)]
metadata.description: Continuation of the 1936 export statistics by commodity and destination, covering vegetable oils, toys, rayon, papers, glass, and timber.

metadata.title: [Foreign Trade by Commodities and Countries, 1934-1936]
metadata.description: Shows values for various commodities by the countries from which they were received or to which they were sent, for 1934 to 1936, as part of the Foreign Trade section.

metadata.title: Value of Chief Commodities Imported from Various Countries
metadata.caption: Japan Proper and Karafuto (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Continues the table of chief imported commodities by supplying country for 1934 to 1936, covering cotton, wool, iron, mineral oils and machinery.

metadata.title: [Imports by Commodities and Countries, 1934–1936]
metadata.description: Shows Japan's imports of major commodities in 1934–1936 broken down by supplying country, with yen-free volume figures for each source.

metadata.title: [Exports of Principal Commodities to Important Countries, 1934-1936]
metadata.description: A continuation of the table of Japan's export values by principal commodity and destination country for 1934 to 1936, shown in two side-by-side columns.

metadata.title: Percentage of Increase of Exports by Continents
metadata.description: Shows the value of Japan's exports to each continent in 1934-1936 and the percentage change from the previous year.

metadata.title: China's Share in Japan's Foreign Trade
metadata.description: Shows China's proportion of Japan's exports and imports at selected years, illustrating how important China became as a trading partner.

metadata.title: [Japan's Exports to and Imports from China, 1926-1931]
metadata.description: Gives the value of Japan's exports to and imports from China year by year from 1926 to 1931, showing the decline after the 1930 northern expedition and Manchurian Incident.

metadata.title: Imports of China
metadata.caption: (In units of 1,000 yuan)
metadata.description: Shows the value of goods China imported from its main supplying countries in 1932–1936, with each country's share of total imports in parentheses.

metadata.title: Exports of China
metadata.caption: (In units of 1,000 yuan)
metadata.description: Shows the value of goods China exported to its main buyer countries in 1932–1936, with each country's share of total exports in parentheses.

metadata.title: Value of Merchandise Exported to Various Countries
metadata.caption: (In ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the value of Japanese merchandise exported to each Asian and European country from 1930 to 1936, with the list continuing on the next page.

metadata.title: Value of Merchandise Imported From Various Countries
metadata.caption: (In ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: This table gives the value of merchandise imported from Asian countries and regions, such as China, British India and the Dutch East Indies, for 1930 to 1936.

metadata.title: Chief Articles of Trade between Japan and Other Countries
metadata.caption: (In ¥ 1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the main Japanese exports to Manchoukuo by value from 1932 to 1936, showing the trade in key goods such as flour, sugar, beer, yarn and silk.

metadata.title: China
metadata.description: Shows the value of Japan's trade with China by commodity for 1932–1936, with exports from Japan to China and imports from China to Japan.

metadata.title: [Foreign Trade, Continued From Previous Page]
metadata.description: Continuation of the table of trade figures for 1932 to 1936, listing commodities exchanged with Japan and the totals for each year.

metadata.title: Hong-Kong
metadata.description: Trade between Hong-Kong and Japan, showing goods shipped from Japan to Hong-Kong and tin sent to Japan, 1932 to 1936.

metadata.title: Straits Settlements
metadata.description: Goods shipped from Japan to the Straits Settlements, 1932 to 1936, by commodity.

metadata.title: [Trade With Each Country (Continued)]
metadata.description: Continuation of the year-by-year trade figures (1932–1936) with one country, listing principal commodities exported from and imported to Japan.

metadata.title: Asiatic Russia
metadata.description: Trade figures for 1932–1936 between Japan and Asiatic Russia, showing principal goods traded in each direction.

metadata.title: French Indo-China
metadata.description: Trade figures for 1932–1936 between Japan and French Indo-China, showing principal goods traded in each direction.

metadata.title: Dutch East Indies
metadata.description: Japan's exports to the Dutch East Indies for 1932–1936 by principal commodity, as the table continues on the next page.

metadata.title: Foreign Trade with the Philippine Islands
metadata.description: Shows the trade of the Philippine Islands with Japan, listing the main commodities imported from and exported to Japan for 1932 to 1936.

metadata.title: Foreign Trade with Siam
metadata.description: Shows Siam's trade with Japan, listing the principal goods sent from Japan and the goods shipped to Japan for 1932 to 1936.

metadata.title: Foreign Trade with Great Britain
metadata.description: Lists the principal goods Great Britain received from Japan over 1932 to 1936, in value figures.

metadata.title: France
metadata.description: Japan's trade with France for 1932 to 1936, listing principal goods shipped from Japan to France and goods received from France.

metadata.title: Germany
metadata.description: Japan's trade with Germany for 1932 to 1936, listing principal goods shipped from Japan to Germany.

metadata.title: Canada
metadata.description: Shows the quantities of rice, tea and raw silk sent from Japan to Canada in each year from 1932 to 1936.

metadata.title: [Trade with Chile, Argentine, Uruguay and Egypt, 1932–1936]
metadata.description: Japan's trade with Chile, Argentina, Uruguay and Egypt in 1932–1936, listing the principal goods exported from and imported to Japan by each country.

metadata.title: Union of South Africa
metadata.description: Shows Japan's trade with the Union of South Africa in 1932–1936, listing principal goods exported from and imported to Japan by year.

metadata.title: East Africa
metadata.description: Shows Japan's trade with East Africa from 1932 to 1936, giving total exports from Japan and the main imports to Japan.

metadata.title: Australia
metadata.description: Shows Japan's trade with Australia from 1932 to 1936, listing the main goods exported to and imported from Australia each year.

metadata.title: New Zealand
metadata.description: Shows Japan's trade with New Zealand from 1932 to 1936, listing the main goods exported to and imported from New Zealand each year.

metadata.title: Hawaii
metadata.description: Shows Japan's trade with Hawaii for 1932 to 1936, with exports from Japan by commodity and the trade to Japan, supporting the discussion of invisible trade.

metadata.title: Invisible Foreign Trade of Japan
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Sets out Japan's invisible foreign trade, receipts (assets) and payments (liabilities) by item from 1931 to 1935, compiled by the Ministry of Finance, as the basis for the discussion of the 1935 excess of payments.

metadata.title: Balance of International Payments
metadata.description: Shows Japan's international payments and receipts for 1931–1935, including tourist spending, government and private capital movements, and resulting balances.

metadata.title: Inward or Credit Movements (Exports)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's 1934 and 1933 inward or credit current-account items (merchandise exports, interest, dividends and other services) in million yen.

metadata.title: Inward or Credit Capital Movement
metadata.caption: (In Million yen)
metadata.description: Shows inflows of foreign capital into Japan in 1934 and 1933, split into long-term and short-term operations, with totals for each category.

metadata.title: Outward or Debit Capital Movement
metadata.caption: (In Million yen)
metadata.description: Begins the outward or debit capital movement statement, listing long-term payments for 1934 and 1933; the table continues beyond this page.

metadata.title: Vessels Entered at Five Principal Ports
metadata.caption: (Unit: Ton)
metadata.description: Shows the tonnage of vessels entered at the five principal Japanese ports, Yokohama, Kobé, Nagasaki, Moji and Osaka, for 1929 to 1936.

metadata.title: Foreign Trade Vessels Entered Japanese Ports
metadata.caption: (Steamers only)
metadata.description: Shows the number and tonnage of steamers of foreign trade entering Japanese ports, broken down by nationality of vessel, 1930 to 1936.

metadata.title: [Reduced Import Duties on Cotton Yarns, 1930]
metadata.caption: (Rates per 100 kin)
metadata.description: Lists the reduced import duty rates per 100 kin on gray single or two-fold cotton yarns, by count, under the 1930 amendments to Japan's import tariff.

metadata.title: Life Insurance Contracts During Past 10 Years
metadata.description: Shows life insurance contract volumes over the decade 1927–1936, including beginning balances, new contracts, cancellations and lapse rates, supporting the discussion of the industry's growth.

metadata.title: [Life Insurance Net Increase, Year-End Contracts, Premiums and Benefits Paid]
metadata.description: Gives the net yearly increase in contracts, the percentage increase, year-end totals, premiums received and benefits paid for the ten years, accompanying the life insurance contracts table.

metadata.title: [Business Expenditure as Percentage of Premiums Received, 1927–1935]
metadata.caption: (Figures in units of one thousand yen)
metadata.description: Shows business expenditure as a percentage of premiums received for the nine years from 1927, presented to show the cost ratio of insurance business.

metadata.title: [Grand Total of Insurance Business, Business Years 1921-22 to 1935-36]
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Shows the grand total of Japan's insurance business over the last 12 business years, compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, with the outlook for 1937 discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Contracts of Insurance Companies
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000,000)
metadata.description: Gives the new contracts and contracts at year end for each kind of insurance business by insurance companies in 1934 and 1935, as the text discusses the growth of insurance business.

metadata.title: Insurance Companies, 1930-1935
metadata.caption: (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: The table gives, for 1930-1935, the number of insurance companies, authorized and paid-up capital, and reserve funds by kind of insurance such as accident, fire, marine and life.

metadata.title: Conditions of Business Earnings
metadata.description: Shows the premiums, interest, other earnings and total earnings of insurance companies by kind of insurance and business year, from 1930-31 to 1934-35.

metadata.title: Conditions of Business Expenses
metadata.description: Shows the claims paid, contract payments, business expenses, other outlays and totals for accident insurance companies by business year, 1930-31 to 1934-35.

metadata.title: [Premiums, Interest and Other Income by Kind of Insurance]
metadata.description: Shows premiums, interest, other income and totals of each insurance kind by business year, 1930-31 to 1934-35, as the page's opening statistics on insurance business.

metadata.title: Conditions of Business
metadata.description: Gives the number and amount of new contracts and of contracts in force at year end for accident and fire insurance over the same five business years.

metadata.title: [Insurance Companies by Kind of Insurance, 1930-31 to 1934-35]
metadata.description: Shows the number of policies and amounts for each kind of insurance business for five business years, with the accompanying note explaining the business-year period and why capital is omitted.

metadata.title: Life Insurance
metadata.caption: (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: Gives business conditions of the three principal foreign life insurance companies in Japan, covering deposits, premiums, claims and contracts, compiled by the Department of Commerce and Industry.

metadata.title: Fire Insurance
metadata.description: Shows the yearly business of fire insurance companies, including deposits with the government, premiums, claims and contracts, for the years 1930-31 to 1934-35.

metadata.title: Marine Insurance
metadata.description: Presents the marine insurance business of the companies by year, covering deposits, premiums, claims and the new and in-force contracts from 1930-31 to 1934-35.

metadata.title: Investments of Home Insurance Companies — Advances
metadata.caption: The Insurance Year Book by the Department of Commerce and Industry (Amount in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the advances made by Japanese home insurance companies, by type of loan and mortgage, with the number of companies, for each business year from 1930-31 to 1935-36.

metadata.title: Securities
metadata.caption: The Insurance Year Book by the Department of Commerce and Industry (Amount in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Breaks down the securities held by Japanese home insurance companies by type, with totals and deposits with banks, for the years 1930-31 to 1935-36.

metadata.title: Life Insurance Companies
metadata.description: Lists the principal Japanese life insurance companies with the year each was established, the first of the Japanese concerns listed in this section.

metadata.title: [Insurance Companies in Japan with Year Established]
metadata.description: The list gives the Japanese life and property insurance companies alongside the year each was established, with mutual companies marked by a cross.

metadata.title: Post Office Life Insurance
metadata.caption: Compiled by the Bureau of the Post Office Life Insurance, the Department of Communications. (In yen)
metadata.description: Gives yearly figures for new contracts, revivals and deaths of Post Office Life Insurance policies, with premiums and sums insured, following the description of the scheme's rules.

metadata.title: Expirations, Surrenders, Lapses and Other Causes
metadata.caption: (In yen) printed above the Surrenders block
metadata.description: Shows the yearly expirations and surrenders, lapses and other terminations of insurance policies by number, premiums and sums insured over the financial years 1926-27 to 1935-36.

metadata.title: Net Increase and Contracts in Force at the End of the Financial Year
metadata.caption: (In yen) printed above the Contracts in Force premium column
metadata.description: Shows the net increase in insurance policies and the total contracts in force at each financial year end, by number, premiums and sums insured, from 1926-27 to 1935-36.

metadata.title: Post Office Life Annuities
metadata.caption: Compiled by the Bureau of the Post Office Life Insurance, the Department of Communications. (In yen)
metadata.description: Lists new contracts and deaths for the Post Office life annuity plans (immediate and deferred single and instalment premium), by financial year from 1931-32 to 1935-36.

metadata.title: [P. O. Life Annuities: Surrenders, Cancellations, Changes and Contracts in Force]
metadata.description: Shows, for each financial year 1931-36, the surrenders, statutory cancellations, other changes and contracts remaining in force for each kind of postal life annuity, with premiums and annuity amounts.

metadata.title: Loans and Investments of the P.O.L.I. Fund
metadata.caption: At the end of March, each year; (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the year-by-year amounts of loans and investments held by the P.O.L.I. Fund, from 1931 to 1935, to illustrate how the insurance fund was deployed across public welfare and other purposes.

metadata.title: Live Stock Insurance
metadata.description: Shows the business results of live-stock insurance over the last five years, from March 1931 to March 1935, covering societies, animals insured, amounts, premiums and claims.

metadata.title: Live Stock Insurance Classified Between Horses and Cattle
metadata.description: Breaks down the live-stock insurance business for each year from 1931 to 1935 into cattle and horses, giving insured numbers, insured amounts and premiums.

metadata.title: Health Insurance
metadata.description: Gives the number of persons holding health insurance policies from 1929 to 1935, split into compulsorily insured, voluntarily insured and voluntarily insured in continuation.

metadata.title: Under Control of Health Insurance Associations
metadata.description: Shows the number of health insurance associations and the persons insured through them each March from 1929 to 1935, by compulsory, voluntary and continuation voluntary categories.

metadata.title: Premiums Collected & Insured Money Paid Out
metadata.description: Summarises premiums collected and insured money paid out by fiscal year from 1928-29 to 1934-35, for total insurance and for each of the two insurance schemes.

metadata.title: Farm Households
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry)
metadata.description: Shows the number of farm households in Japan Proper from 1931 to 1935, split by agricultural engagement, tenure, and size of cultivated area.

metadata.title: Owners of Arable-Lands
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry)
metadata.description: Gives the number of owners of arable lands in each size class for 1931 to 1935, showing the distribution of land ownership by holding size.

metadata.title: Arable Lands
metadata.caption: (Unit: ha.)
metadata.description: Reports the total arable land area and the portion cultivated by owners of the lands in Japan Proper, 1931 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production by Farmers in 1935
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Lists the value of farm-household production in 1935 by category, with the total, as the basis of the value-of-production discussion.

metadata.title: [Area Planted, Yield and Average Yield of Rice, 1925-1936]
metadata.description: The table gives rice area planted, yield in koku, yield per tan and the five-year preceding average from 1925 to 1936, supporting the text's comparison of the 1935 and 1936 crops.

metadata.title: [Rice Stocks by Month, 1934–1936 and Five-Year Average]
metadata.description: Shows the nation's rice stocks at successive dates in 1934, 1935 and 1936 against a five-year average, illustrating the decline in stocks after poor harvests.

metadata.title: Rice Stocks of the Government
metadata.caption: (In koku)
metadata.description: Gives the Government's share of the rice stocks in 1936, split between Japan Proper and overseas territories, with November comparisons for 1935 and 1934.

metadata.title: Rice Quotations
metadata.description: Shows monthly and yearly high, low and average rice prices on the Tokyo Rice Exchange futures market and for Fukagawa Middling, from 1929 to 1936.

metadata.title: [Forecast of Rice Supply and Demand for 1937]
metadata.description: The Government's forecast of 1937 rice supply and demand is set against the actual 1936 results, explaining the expected price trend.

metadata.title: Supply of Rice
metadata.caption: (In koku)
metadata.description: Supply side of the rice balance for 1927–1936, showing carry-over, domestic production and imports, which together form the annual total supply.

metadata.title: Demand for Rice
metadata.description: Demand side of the rice balance for 1927–1936: exports, stock carried forward, domestic consumption, population of Japan Proper and per capita consumption.

metadata.title: Rice Conditions in Korea
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Korean rice production, foreign rice imports and exports to Japan Proper for 1924–1936, shown alongside Formosa to compare the two colonial rice suppliers.

metadata.title: Rice Conditions in Formosa
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Formosan rice production, foreign rice imports and exports to Japan Proper for 1926–1936, set beside the Korean figures.

metadata.title: [Acreage of Plantation and Yield, 1931–1934]
metadata.caption: (The units are cho and koku)
metadata.description: Gives the acreage of tea plantation and the yield in Japan Proper for each year from 1931 to 1934, following the discussion of the 1936 crop.

metadata.title: [Acreage of Plantation and Yield, 1935–1936]
metadata.description: Shows the plantation acreage and yield for 1935, the 1931–1935 average and 1936, completing the seven-year comparison in Japan Proper.

metadata.title: Value of Cereal Production in Japan Proper
metadata.description: Gives the area and value of each cereal crop (rice, wheat, oats, barley, rye and other cereals) in Japan Proper from 1931 to 1936, showing the value of cereal production.

metadata.title: [Soy-beans and Azuki Beans: Area, Production and Value, 1935]
metadata.description: Listed under the field crops text, these figures give the area, production and value of soy-beans and azuki beans, the predominant pulse crops.

metadata.title: [Tuber and Root Crops: Area, Production and Value, 1935]
metadata.description: Following the tuber and root crops text, this table lists area, production and value for the main tuber and root crops, which are predominant in the category.

metadata.title: [Chief Industrial Crops: Quantity and Value, 1935]
metadata.description: Summarised under the industrial crops text, this table gives the quantity and value of the chief industrial crop products for 1935.

metadata.title: [Chief Vegetables: Quantity and Value, 1935]
metadata.description: Given under the vegetables text, this table shows the quantity and value of the chief vegetable products of the year.

metadata.title: [Predominant Fruits: Quantity and Value, 1935]
metadata.description: Following the fruit production text, this table lists the quantity and value of the predominant fruits grown in 1935.

metadata.title: Number of Animals Slaughtered
metadata.description: Gives the number of animals slaughtered in 1935 at slaughter-houses, by kind of animal, as part of the section on meat and animals slaughtered.

metadata.title: Quantity of Meat Obtained
metadata.description: Shows the quantity in kan and the value in yen of meat obtained from each kind of animal slaughtered in 1935.

metadata.title: Number of Eggs Obtained
metadata.caption: (Year ending June)
metadata.description: Compares the number and value of fowls' and ducks' eggs obtained in the years ending June 1935 and June 1936.

metadata.title: Number of Co-operative Societies
metadata.caption: (At the year end)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly totals of village co-operative societies and the number of credit societies among them from 1930 to 1935.

metadata.title: [Co-operative Societies by Type of Business and Liability, 1930–1934]
metadata.description: The table gives the number of co-operative societies by type of business and form of liability over 1930–1934, continuing from the previous page.

metadata.title: Operation of Co-operative Societies
metadata.caption: (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: This table reports the membership, capital, deposits, advances, and business turnover of co-operative credit, trading, purchasing and utilization societies from 1930 to 1934.

metadata.title: [Debts of Rural Communities by Prefecture]
metadata.chapter_raw: Items of Interest On Farm Villages
metadata.description: The table lists the debts of farm, mountain and fishing communities in each prefecture, based on the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry survey at the end of August 1935.

metadata.title: Funds and Go-kura
metadata.description: Shows the imperial gifts and national treasury funds granted to six northern prefectures, and the number of new and old Go-kura in each, for 1934 and 1935.

metadata.title: Amount of Cereals Stored in the Go-kura in 1935
metadata.description: Gives the quantities of rice, unhulled rice and other cereals kept in the Go-kura in 1935, with the loans made and cash saved by prefecture.

metadata.title: [Population and Index Number of Three Standard Villages]
metadata.description: Shows population and index numbers of the three villages from 1914 to 1934, illustrating that their populations remained almost stationary during the period.

metadata.title: Number of Households by Occupation
metadata.caption: (March, 1935)
metadata.description: Gives the number of households in each village by occupation and their percentage share, as the basis for the villages' economic character, with farming dominant.

metadata.title: Production (In Yen)
metadata.description: Lists the annual production value in yen of each village by branch of industry for 1933-1934, showing agriculture as the main source.

metadata.title: Number of Households
metadata.caption: Classification By Income (March 1935)
metadata.description: Tabulates the number of households in each village by annual income bracket, based on the household tax estimates for the 1934-35 fiscal year.

metadata.title: [Expenses of the Three Villages as Political Units]
metadata.description: Shows the annual expenses of the three villages as political units, by item, which the text introduces as tabulated figures for Kuchiyoshikawa, Tanisoto and Kamiide villages.

metadata.title: [Expenses of the Three Villages for the Conduct of State Affairs]
metadata.description: Shows the portion of village expenses regarded as required for the conduct of State affairs, by item, for the three villages.

metadata.title: [Taxes Paid by Inhabitants of the Three Villages]
metadata.description: Shows the national and prefectural taxes borne by inhabitants of the three villages, illustrating that village taxation is the heaviest burden.

metadata.title: [Village Tax Statement]
metadata.description: The page itemizes village tax revenue by category (land and special land surtax, household tax, house surtax, miscellaneous surtaxes, others) for three standard villages, with totals.

metadata.title: [Cocoon Output and Index Number, 1880–1936]
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xiv — Sericulture and Raw Silk
metadata.description: Shows the cocoon output for each five-year period and each year from 1930 to 1936, with index numbers, to illustrate the growth of sericulture over the past half century.

metadata.title: [Sericultural Statistics, 1933–1936]
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xiv — Sericulture and Raw Silk
metadata.description: Summarises the recent condition of the sericultural industry from 1933 to 1936, covering families, mulberry area, egg-cards brushed, and cocoon yield and value.

metadata.title: Production of Silkworm Eggs
metadata.caption: (In kg.)
metadata.description: The table gives the number of silkworm egg producers and the production and government-qualified output of silkworm eggs, split into reproductive and industrial eggs, for 1931 to 1935.

metadata.title: Cost of Cocoon Production
metadata.caption: (For 1 kwan Cocoon; in yen)
metadata.description: Based on the Imperial Farmers' Association investigation, this table itemises the cost of producing one kwan of spring cocoons in 1937.

metadata.title: [Cocoon Prices, 1932–1937]
metadata.caption: (In yen per kwan)
metadata.description: High, low and average cocoon prices at the Hamamatsu market for 1937 and the preceding five years, which set the standard for prices in the country.

metadata.title: Cocoon Production in 1930-1935
metadata.caption: (Japan Proper)
metadata.description: Annual figures for number of silk producers, egg-cards incubated, and the quantity and value of total production, cocoons, doupions and waste cocoons in Japan Proper, 1931–1936.

metadata.title: Average Cocoon Price in Japan Proper per Kwan
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows average cocoon prices per kwan in Japan Proper for spring and summer-autumn crops, 1924 to 1936, illustrating price fluctuation that the article links to the dry cocoon law.

metadata.title: [Filature Basins Used, 1936]
metadata.description: Gives the 1936 division of Japanese silk filatures by number of basins used, with the decrease from 1935 for each size group.

metadata.title: Number of Filatures, Basins and Operatives
metadata.caption: (Silk Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry)
metadata.description: Shows the decline in the number of silk reeling establishments, machine-worked filatures, boiling basins and operatives from 1919 to 1936.

metadata.title: Silk Production
metadata.caption: (Silk Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry)
metadata.description: Gives annual silk output by volume and value, total and split into white and yellow silk, for 1924 to 1935.

metadata.title: Total Production by Raw Silk Factories
metadata.description: Summarises the 1930–1935 output of raw silk factories: establishments, boiling basins, operatives by sex, and value of raw silk and waste produced.

metadata.title: Raw Silk Production in the World
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 kirogrammes)
metadata.description: Shows world raw silk output by country and year from 1924 to 1935, illustrating Japan's leading position in the silk industry.

metadata.title: Silk and Total Exports Compared
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Compares the value of silk exports with total Japanese exports, and the silk share of the total, for 1912 to 1936.

metadata.title: [Quantity of Silk Exported, 1925–1936]
metadata.description: Accompanies the text on silk exports, giving the annual quantity of silk exported for the twelve years ending 1936.

metadata.title: World Markets for Japanese Silk
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the value of Japanese raw silk exports to each world market from 1930 to 1936, illustrating the dominance of the United States.

metadata.title: Silk Exports to the United States
metadata.caption: (Unit: picul 133 lbs.)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly volume of silk exported to the United States from 1921 to 1936, with index numbers and year-on-year rates of change.

metadata.title: Raw Silk Price at Yokohama Spot Market
metadata.caption: (In yen); (Standard quality; per 100 kin, 133 lbs.)
metadata.description: Lists monthly and average raw silk prices at the Yokohama spot market for 1925–1927, illustrating the price decline discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Price of Raw Silk, Monthly and Yearly Average, 1928-1936
metadata.description: Monthly and average domestic raw silk quotations for 1928 to 1936, showing the price movement that the text describes for 1936 and earlier years.

metadata.title: [Consumption, Imports and New York Stocks of Raw Silk by Kind]
metadata.description: Breakdown of April raw silk consumption, imports and New York stocks by Japanese, European, Cantonese and Shanghai silk, given with the text on American demand.

metadata.title: [Raw Silk Arrivals, Sales and Sales in Japan, 1930–1936]
metadata.description: Accompanying the note on April stocks and the domestic distribution text, this table gives December and annual totals of raw silk arrivals, sales and sales in Japan for 1930 to 1936.

metadata.title: Raw Silk Distribution in Domestic Markets
metadata.caption: (Arrivals and Deliveries at Kobe and Yokohama) —Quantity in bales—
metadata.description: Monthly arrivals, sales and sales in Japan of raw silk at Kobe and Yokohama during 1936, showing the domestic market distribution of the silk trade.

metadata.title: Distribution of Raw Silk in America in 1936
metadata.caption: (Quantity in bales)

metadata.title: Growth of Machinery Industry
metadata.caption: (Amount in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly growth of Japan's machinery industry in mills, operatives and value of production, from 1914 to 1935, illustrating the wartime and postwar expansion discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Production of Engines
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the number and value of engines produced by type (steam, gas, internal combustion, water wheels) from 1926 to 1935, with fittings and grand totals, showing the rapid growth of the engine industry.

metadata.title: Production of Boilers
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows yearly output of boilers by type (water-tube, cast iron, others), fittings, totals and gas-producing machinery, indicating the growth of the boiler industry.

metadata.title: Production of Pumps, Compressors and Fans
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives annual production numbers and values of pumps, hydraulic and gas compressors, and blowing machines (fans), showing the expansion of these machinery lines.

metadata.title: Production of Metal Manufacturing Machines and Machine Tools
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Lists yearly output of metal manufacturing machines and machine tools (drills, cutters and others) with totals, showing the growth of metal-working machinery production.

metadata.title: Production of Optical Instruments
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows yearly value of optical instruments produced, including lenses, microscopes, telescopes, field-glasses and glasses, for 1929–1935.

metadata.title: Production of Measuring and Weighing Instruments
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of measuring and weighing instruments produced in Japan, by instrument type, 1926-1935, within the machinery and engineering statistics.

metadata.title: Production of Various Meters
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the production of thermometers, clinical thermometers, electricity meters and other meters, with values and totals, for 1926-1935.

metadata.title: Production of Clocks and Watches
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Lists the number and value of electric, stand and other clocks, watches, and fittings produced in Japan from 1926 to 1935, with yearly totals.

metadata.title: Production of Cranes, Elevators, etc.
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Reports the quantity and value of cranes, hoists and conveyors, and elevators produced in Japan from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production of Various Machinery for Industrial Purposes
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yen value of machinery produced for various industrial purposes from 1926 to 1935; the 1926-1928 agriculture figure appears centred across the agriculture and building columns.

metadata.title: Production of Miscellaneous Instruments
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the yen value of miscellaneous instruments produced by category, such as safes, gas utensils and fittings, from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production of Musical Instruments, etc.
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Lists yearly yen production of pianos, organs, violins and other musical instruments, with totals, gramophones and arms, from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production of Scientific and Medical Instruments and Testing Machines, etc.
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly output value of scientific, surgical, surveying, office and camera instruments and testing machines in Japan, 1926–1935.

metadata.title: Production of Electrical Machinery
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly production numbers and values of various electrical machines and apparatus in Japan, 1926–1935, in the electrical machinery section.

metadata.title: Production of Electrical Instruments
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Lists the yearly production of wireless and telegraph instruments, storage and dry-cell batteries and other electrical instruments in Japan, 1926–1935.

metadata.title: Production of Electric Bulbs, Searchlights, etc.
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows yearly output and value of electric bulbs and searchlights from 1926 to 1935, illustrating growth in the electrical manufacturing that accompanies the rolling stock industry discussed below.

metadata.title: Production of Locomotives and Rolling Stock
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the annual number and value of locomotives and rolling stock produced in Japan from 1926 to 1935, supporting the text on the rapid growth of the railway equipment industry.

metadata.title: Manufacturers of Aircrafts
metadata.description: After describing the present aircraft industry and its orders, the text lists the number of aircraft makers of bodies and motors and of balloons and airships from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production of Automobiles and Motor Cycles
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows annual Japanese output of automobiles and motor cycles by parts source and value, reflecting the growth of domestic assembly and parts manufacture discussed in the preceding text.

metadata.title: Imports of Automobiles & Accessories
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Lists yearly Japanese imports of automobiles and accessories, by number and value, showing the rise and fall of foreign car imports that the text on automobile imports describes.

metadata.title: Production of Bicycles in Japan
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly number of bicycles produced in Japan, their value, and the value of accessories produced, 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: [Imports and Exports of Cycles and Accessories]
metadata.description: Gives the yearly imports and exports of cycles and accessories since 1926, showing how the trade changed over the decade.

metadata.title: Imports of Machinery
metadata.caption: (unit ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the yen value of imports of various precision and electrical instruments and cameras by article from 1929 to 1935.

metadata.title: [Machinery Output by Article, 1929–1935]
metadata.description: The table gives yearly figures for Japanese machinery output by article from 1929 to 1935, providing the background for the discussion of machinery production and trade.

metadata.title: [Exports of Japanese-Made Clocks and Surgical Instruments, 1934–1936]
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The section on machinery exports lists the value of Japanese-made machines and instruments exported in the last three years, showing growth from 1934 to 1936.

metadata.title: [Output of Machinery and Electrical Equipment, 1934-1936]
metadata.description: The table gives the output value of machinery and electrical equipment in Japan for 1934 to 1936, placed alongside the shipbuilding discussion to show the wider engineering industry.

metadata.title: Ships Launched
metadata.description: The article compares the 1936 shipbuilding boom with the preceding four years, showing the number of ships and total tonnage launched each year.

metadata.title: Production of Vessels
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the annual value and number of vessels produced by Japanese shipbuilders, by steel vessels and other classes, with totals and ship fittings, to show the trend of output.

metadata.title: Number of Dockyards, Employing More Than 5 Persons and Those Employed
metadata.description: Shows the number of shipbuilding dockyards employing more than five persons and the staff employed in them, by category, at the end of each year from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Electric Power Generated for Industrial Purposes
metadata.caption: (in kw.)
metadata.description: Shows annual electric power generated for industrial purposes from 1907 to 1935, split into hydro-electric and thermal sources, illustrating the rapid growth of hydro-electric output.

metadata.title: Total Volume of Electric Power Generated for Lighting and Industrial Purposes
metadata.caption: (In kw. h.)
metadata.description: Shows the total electric power generated for lighting and industrial use from 1926 to 1935, with the yearly rate of increase, accompanying the discussion of the trend of demand.

metadata.title: Growth of Demand for Power for Lighting
metadata.description: Gives the number of electricity consumers, lamps, candle-power and electric power used for lighting nationally from 1926 to 1935, illustrating growth in lighting demand.

metadata.title: Electric Lighting in Various Prefectures at the End of 1935
metadata.caption: (Number of lights per 100 persons)
metadata.description: Lists the number of electric lights per 100 persons for each prefecture (and the national average) at the end of 1935, to show regional differences in electrification.

metadata.title: Amount of Electric Power Consumed by Various Kinds of Industries, Etc.
metadata.caption: at the end of 1934 and 1935 (In 1,000 kw.)
metadata.description: Shows electric power consumed by the chief industries in 1934 and 1935, illustrating the increase in industrial demand for power described in the adjacent text.

metadata.title: [Number of Suppliers by Industry (continued from previous page)]
metadata.description: A continuation table giving figures for industrial categories, with its column headings on the previous page, leading into the section on electric power suppliers.

metadata.title: Power Supply Companies
metadata.description: Shows the number of electric power supply companies by year from 1931 to 1935, split into opened and unopened, by generating method and purchasing.

metadata.title: Profits of Electric Industry
metadata.description: Gives paid-up capital, profit and the rate of profit against paid-up capital of the electric industry over the years shown, introduced as the rate of profit for all companies.

metadata.title: Demand for Electric Light
metadata.caption: (In units of 1,000 lamps)
metadata.description: Shows the rising number of electric lamps supplied by the three main electricity bureaus from 1931 to 1936, illustrating growing demand for electric light.

metadata.title: Demand for Electric Power
metadata.caption: (In units of 1,000 kilowatts)
metadata.description: Gives the electric power demand of the same three organizations for 1931 to 1936, shown as the rate of increase in demand for electric power outpaces that for light.

metadata.title: Receipts from Electricity Charges
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 yen)
metadata.description: Lists half-yearly receipts from light and power charges of the Tokyo Electric Light Co. and Toho Electric Power Co. from 1933 to 1936, showing power charges overtaking light charges.

metadata.title: Assets
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 yen)
metadata.description: Shows fixed and floating assets of the Tokyo Electric Light and Toho Electric Power companies by half-year, illustrating how their asset positions changed over the past four years.

metadata.title: Liabilities
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 yen)
metadata.description: Gives internal and external liabilities of the two companies by half-year, showing internal liabilities rising as external liabilities fell, which the text presents as evidence of sound business policy.

metadata.title: [Highest and Lowest Quotations for Shares of Electric Companies, 1936]
metadata.description: Shows the highest and lowest share prices of various electric companies in 1936, introduced as the background to the electric industry's market conditions discussed on the page.

metadata.title: [Gas Industry Statistics, 1926–1935]
metadata.description: Gives the gas industry's annual coal consumption, gas output and supply, consumer numbers, lights and burners, and motors from 1926 to 1935, as background to the 1936 review.

metadata.title: Gas Consumption
metadata.caption: (In units of 1,000 themal units)
metadata.description: Shows annual gas consumption of the Tokyo and Toho Gas Companies over the six years to 1936, illustrating the growth in demand during the extraordinary situation.

metadata.title: Gas-Meters Installed
metadata.description: Shows the number of gas meters installed by the Tokyo and Toho Gas Companies at successive dates from 1933 to 1936.

metadata.title: Industrial Expenditure
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 yen)
metadata.description: Compares the industrial expenditure of the six leading gas companies over 1934 to 1936, supporting the text's point that total expenditure is trending downward.

metadata.title: [Gas Charges and By-Product Profits of Tokyo and Toho Gas Companies, 1933-1936]
metadata.description: Compares gas charge receipts with by-product profits for the Tokyo and Toho Gas Companies over 1933 to 1936, illustrating the rapid growth of by-product profits.

metadata.title: Business Results of Gas Companies
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the paid-up capital, fixed capital, profit, profit ratio and dividend rate of gas companies from 1930 to 1936, illustrating the sector's business performance in the Utilities chapter.

metadata.title: Stocks in Warehouses in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (According to the Japan Warehouse Association)
metadata.description: Shows annual averages and end-of-June and end-of-December stocks held in warehouses across Japan Proper, by number of warehouses, parcels and value, from 1927 to 1936.

metadata.title: Stocks in Warehouses by Districts
metadata.description: Breaks down warehouse numbers, parcels and values for 1927–1936 by the Tokyo-Yokohama, Kobe-Osaka and other districts.

metadata.title: Stocks in Warehouses by Important Commodities
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 parcels)
metadata.description: Lists the quantity of stocks held in warehouses at year end for each important commodity group from 1927 to 1936.

metadata.title: Stocks in Warehouses by Important Commodities (Value)
metadata.caption: (Value in ¥1,000,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of year-end warehouse stocks for the main commodity groups, 1927 to 1936, continuing the quantity figures above.

metadata.title: Chief Warehouse Companies
metadata.description: A list of the principal warehouse companies, giving each firm's founding year, capital, the cities where its warehouses stand, and its head office.

metadata.title: Production of Domestic Wheat and Its Acreage
metadata.description: Shows domestic wheat production and cultivated acreage from 1927 to 1936, set beside the text noting that 1936 production fell 7.2 per cent from the previous year.

metadata.title: Quantities of Wheat Imported
metadata.caption: Countries from Which Imported (Quantities in piculs)
metadata.description: Lists the quantities of wheat imported into Japan from 1925 to 1936 by supplying country, illustrating how imports from countries other than Australia fell as domestic production grew.

metadata.title: Exports of Wheat Flour
metadata.caption: Countries to Which Exported (Quantities in piculs)
metadata.description: Gives wheat flour exports from 1927 to 1936 by destination, showing the rise of Manchoukou and Kwantung as markets, which the accompanying text ties to the Tsurumi Mill's output.

metadata.title: Flour Production, Consumption, Etc
metadata.caption: (In bags)
metadata.description: The table gives Japan's yearly wheat flour production, imports, exports and home consumption with stock from 1923 to 1936, illustrating the trends discussed in the surrounding text on wheat policy.

metadata.title: Production of Sugar
metadata.caption: (Unit 1,000 piculs)
metadata.description: The table gives annual sugar production in piculs by region, from 1924-25 to an estimated 1936-37, showing the rapid growth of output, chiefly from Formosa.

metadata.title: Consumption of Sugar in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Unit 1,000 piculs)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's yearly total sugar consumption and per capita consumption, supporting the text's discussion of consumption rising in 1934 and 1935.

metadata.title: Sugar Exports and Imports of Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (In piculs)
metadata.description: Gives Japan Proper's sugar imports, exports and the resulting net balance year by year, compiled by the Japan Sugar Institute, to support the discussion of trade.

metadata.title: Imports of Refined Sugar by Origins
metadata.caption: (In piculs)
metadata.description: Breaks down Japan Proper's refined sugar imports for 1927 and 1928 by country of origin, showing Java as the main source.

metadata.title: Exports of Refined Sugar by Destination
metadata.caption: (In piculs)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's refined sugar exports by destination country or region for 1927-1936, in piculs, with annual totals.

metadata.title: Capital, Capacities, Etc., of Sugar Companies
metadata.description: Lists the authorized and paid-up capital, raw and refined sugar capacity, and 1935 output of the principal Japanese sugar companies.

metadata.title: Production of Beer, 1927-1936
metadata.caption: (In Koku)
metadata.description: Gives Japan's annual beer production in koku for each year from 1927 to 1936, with 1936 as an estimate, following the historical note on brewing.

metadata.title: Exports of Beer
metadata.caption: (Quantity in koku and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's beer exports by destination, in quantity and value, for 1933 to 1936, illustrating the export trade discussed in the accompanying text.

metadata.title: Production of Saké by Kinds
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Shows annual saké output in thousands of koku, broken down by type, for the ten years from 1925-26 to 1934-35, illustrating recent production under the present condition of the industry.

metadata.title: Production of Soft Drinks
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of soft drink production in yen by type, from 1930 to 1935, illustrating the industry's development alongside the discussion of its growth.

metadata.title: Consumption of Soft Drinks
metadata.caption: (In litre) (Import included)
metadata.description: Gives the litres of soft drinks consumed in Japan from 1932 to 1935 by type, including imports, showing how consumption changed over these years.

metadata.title: Production of Canned Provisions
metadata.caption: (Quantity in kg. and value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the 1934 and 1935 production quantities and values of Japan's canned provisions by kind, supporting the discussion of the canning industry's development.

metadata.title: Production of Paper Since 1925
metadata.caption: (Factory Statistics by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry) (Quantity in 1,000 kg. and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows annual factory output of paper by type since 1925, quantity and value, illustrating the production trends discussed in the text on curtailment and the 1931 reduction.

metadata.title: Production of Paper Since 1925 (Other Paper Types)
metadata.caption: (Factory Statistics by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry) (Quantity in 1,000 kg. and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives factory output quantity and value of match, cigarette, art and Hanshi paper from 1926 to 1935, part of the same factory statistics series.

metadata.title: Production of Paper Since 1925 (Minogami, Torinoko, Board and Totals)
metadata.caption: (Factory Statistics by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry) (Quantity in 1,000 kg. and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Presents factory output of Minogami, Torinoko and imitation paper, board, and the overall paper total value from 1926 to 1935, completing the production series.

metadata.title: Production of Cellophane
metadata.description: Shows how Japanese cellophane production grew from 1929 to 1935, in quantity and value, illustrating the rapid expansion of the industry described in the text.

metadata.title: Consumption of Foreign-Style Paper
metadata.caption: (Statistics of the Nihon Seishi Rengokai) (Quantity in 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly production, imports, exports, consumption and per-capita consumption of foreign-style paper in Japan from 1927 to 1936, supporting the text on paper consumption trends.

metadata.title: Production of Pulp
metadata.caption: (Forest Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry) (In tons)
metadata.description: Shows annual pulp production by type and the lumber consumed for it, illustrating how much timber the pulp industry used.

metadata.title: Imports of Pulp
metadata.caption: (Qty in 100 kin and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists pulp imports by country of origin for 1932 to 1936, giving quantity and value where recorded, to show the rising reliance on foreign pulp.

metadata.title: Demand and Supply of Pulps During the Last 7 Years
metadata.caption: (Forest Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry) (Unit in ton)
metadata.description: Compares yearly pulp production, imports, total consumption and the quantity needed for paper making, showing the demand and supply balance over seven years.

metadata.title: Quotations of Foreign-Style Papers
metadata.description: Shows the monthly and yearly quotations of three grades of foreign-style paper from 1929 to early 1937, illustrating the price recovery that accompanied rising pulp costs.

metadata.title: [Foreign-Style Paper Machines, Production, Sales and Demand, 1929–1936]
metadata.description: The table gives yearly figures for foreign-style paper manufacturing from 1929 to 1936, covering machines in operation, production, sales and demand, supporting the discussion of the paper industry.

metadata.title: Production of Superphosphates
metadata.caption: (In metric tons)
metadata.description: Shows annual superphosphate production in metric tons from 1929 to an estimated 1936, illustrating the growth of this chemical fertilizer industry.

metadata.title: [Demand and Supply of Superphosphate, 1926-1935]
metadata.caption: (1,000 tons)
metadata.description: Gives ten years of superphosphate production, exports and re-exports, and consumption within Japan Proper, showing the supply and demand balance of the fertilizer.

metadata.title: [Supply and Demand of Sulphate of Ammonia, 1926-1935]
metadata.caption: (In metric ton)
metadata.description: Annual production, imports, reimports, exports, re-exports and domestic consumption of the nitrogenous fertilizer in Japan from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production of Cyanamide
metadata.caption: (Unit in metric ton and in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Quantity and value of cyanamide produced in Japan from 1926 to 1935, illustrating the growth of this fertilizer's output discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Vegetable Fertilizers, 1935
metadata.caption: (In Japan Proper) (In ton)
metadata.description: Domestic production, imports, reimports, exports and consumption of bean cake, rape-seed cake and cotton-seed cake in Japan in 1935.

metadata.title: [Fertilizer Quotations, 1933–1936]
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: The table compares monthly high and low fertilizer quotations during 1936 with annual figures for the preceding three years, showing how chemical and vegetable fertilizer prices moved.

metadata.title: [Percentage of Profit and Dividend of Artificial Fertilizer, Electro-chemical and Show Fertilizer Companies, 1932–1936]
metadata.description: Shows the percentages of profit and dividend for three fertilizer companies in each half-year from 1932 to 1936, illustrating the business conditions discussed in the surrounding text.

metadata.title: [Percentage of Profit and Dividend of Showa, Chosen Nitrogenous and Miike Nitrogenous Fertilizer Companies, 1932–1936]
metadata.description: Gives the profit and dividend percentages for three further fertilizer companies over the same half-years, supporting the text's observation that most firms paid greater dividends than before.

metadata.title: The Value of Fertilizers Produced in Japan Proper 1925-1934
metadata.caption: (Unit ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of fertilizers produced in Japan Proper, split by licence category and fertilizer type, supporting the text's account of production and its statistics.

metadata.title: Consumption of Fertilizers in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Unit in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the consumption of fertilizers in Japan Proper by year, covering licensed and unlicensed market sales, raw materials, self-supplied fertilizers and grand totals.

metadata.title: Number of Persons Engaged in the Fertilizer Business
metadata.description: Lists the number of manufacturers, importers, colonial importers and traders in the fertilizer business for each year from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Production of Cement
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Shows yearly cement production from 1929 to 1935 by Portland and other cement, in barrels and yen, with total value, to illustrate the industry's fluctuations.

metadata.title: Consumption of Cement Classified by Uses
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 metric tons)
metadata.description: Shows how Japan's cement consumption was divided among public works, buildings, mining and other uses over 1934 to 1936, supporting the discussion of the 1936 cement industry.

metadata.title: Exports of Cement
metadata.caption: (Quantity in tons and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists cement exports by destination (Manchoukuo, Kwantung, China, Asian and other markets) with quantity and value for 1933 to 1936, illustrating the export trade of the industry.

metadata.title: [Cement Production, Shipments and Stocks, 1933–1936]
metadata.description: The table gives monthly and annual cement production capacity, clinker, shipments, exports, Manchoukuo shipments, contracts and stocks, based on a survey by the Cement Manufacturers' Association.

metadata.title: Factories and Production of Ceramics
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: The table gives yearly figures for ceramic factories, operatives and production values by category, showing how the chinaware industry developed from 1927 to 1935.

metadata.title: Factories and Production of Tiles and Drainage Pipes
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: This table lists yearly factory counts, operatives and values for roof tiles, other tiles and drainage pipes, showing the development of this branch of the ceramics industry.

metadata.title: Exports of Chinaware to Different Countries
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table shows the value of chinaware exports from Japan to each country from 1914 and 1930 to 1935, illustrating the rapid growth of the export trade described in the text.

metadata.title: Production of Glass and Glassware
metadata.caption: (one case contains 100 sq. ft. of glass)
metadata.description: Shows annual output of glass and glassware from 1927 to 1935, by product type, illustrating the growth of the glass industry in Japan.

metadata.title: [Sheet Glass, Others and Looking Glasses Production, 1927–1935]
metadata.caption: (Quantity in 1,000; value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the quantity and value of sheet glass by thickness, other glass, and looking glasses produced each year from 1927 to 1935, with the year's total.

metadata.title: Exports of Glass and Glassware
metadata.caption: (Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists export quantities and values of glass products for 1934 to 1936, showing the trade in glass and glassware abroad.

metadata.title: Imports of Glass
metadata.caption: (Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's imports of glass by kind, with quantities and values for 1934 to 1936, illustrating the trade in glass products within the miscellaneous industries section.

metadata.title: Factories and Production of Lacquer-Ware
metadata.description: The table gives yearly numbers of lacquer-ware factories and operatives, and the value of production by category, from 1927 to 1935, accompanying the discussion of the industry.

metadata.title: [Record Production Demand by Industry]
metadata.description: Introduced by the text on record soda production in 1936, this list gives the share of demand for soda from each chemical industry.

metadata.title: Price Per 100 Kilograms
metadata.caption: PRICE PER 100 KILOGRAMS
metadata.description: Shows the year-by-year high and low quotations for caustic soda and soda ash, illustrating the price movements described in the Quotations text.

metadata.title: [Business Conditions of the Soda Companies, 1934–1936]
metadata.description: Accompanying the discussion of soda company business, this table shows the profit and dividend percentages of four soda companies over six half-years from 1934 to 1936.

metadata.title: Production and Imports of Soda Ash
metadata.description: Statistics on the production and imports of soda ash, the first of the three soda articles, covering the years 1927 to 1936.

metadata.title: Production, Imports and Exports of Caustic Soda
metadata.description: Statistics on the production, exports, imports and supply of caustic soda for 1927 to 1936, given as data on the third soda article.

metadata.title: Production and Exports of Bleaching Powder
metadata.description: Shows Japan's annual production, exports and domestic supply of bleaching powder in metric tons, presented in two panels alongside the soap-making article.

metadata.title: Production of Soap by Mills
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly value of soap production by product type (toilet, industrial, medical and others) from 1926 to 1935, supporting the soap industry discussion.

metadata.title: Production of Vegetable Oils
metadata.description: Vegetable oil production by type, in yen values, for 1926–1935, presented as the statistics of the vegetable and animal oil industry following the note on vegetable oil exports and imports.

metadata.title: Production of Animal Oils and Tallow
metadata.description: Production values of animal oils and tallow (fish, whale and animal fats) for 1926–1935, shown in yen, closing the statistics on the vegetable and animal oil industry.

metadata.title: Production of Vegetable Wax, Candles, and Manufactures of Oils
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows annual Japanese output of vegetable wax, candles and several oil manufactures, 1926–1935, illustrating growth of the miscellaneous oil and wax industries.

metadata.title: Imports of Vegetable and Animal Oils, Tallows and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's imports of olive oil, beef tallow, stearine and oleine by year from 1926 to 1935, documenting the oil and tallow trade.

metadata.title: Exports of Vegetable and Animal Oils, Wax, and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Gives Japan's exports of perilla, bean, rapeseed, fish and whale oils, vegetable wax and hardened oil for 1926–1935, showing the export trade in these products.

metadata.title: [Percentage of Profit and Dividend of Rubber Companies, 1934–1936]
metadata.description: Rubber companies' profit and dividend percentages over six half-years, showing their improved business conditions and dividend increases from 1934 to 1936.

metadata.title: Production of Rubber Manufactures in Japan
metadata.caption: Soft Rubber Manufactures
metadata.description: Production statistics for soft rubber manufactures in Japan for 1926 and 1927, listing footwear, toys, tyres and machinery goods, which the text introduces as the chief articles produced.

metadata.title: [Footwear, Toys, Tyres and Machinery Rubber Goods Production, 1928-1935]
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000, except shoes in No. Pairs)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly output of footwear, toys, tyres and accessories, and machinery rubber goods, as the rubber industry's domestic production figures for 1928 to 1935.

metadata.title: Soft Rubber Manufactures
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly value of soft rubber manufactures (belts, pipes, others) and hard rubber manufactures, with grand totals, for 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Imports of Raw Rubber and Exports of Principal Rubber Manufactures
metadata.caption: (Unit in yen)
metadata.description: Compares the yen value of raw rubber imports with exports of boots and shoes, vehicle tyres, toys and other rubber manufactures for 1932 to 1936.

metadata.title: Production of Celluloid and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.description: Shows Japan's annual output of raw celluloid and celluloid manufactures, with values, illustrating the industry's growth in the late 1920s and 1930s, as the text describes.

metadata.title: Exports of Raw Celluloid and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.description: Lists Japan's yearly exports of raw celluloid and celluloid manufactures by type, showing how the export trade moved from 1924 to 1932.

metadata.title: [Raw Celluloid and Celluloid Manufactures, 1933-1936]
metadata.description: The table gives annual raw celluloid output and celluloid manufacture values for 1933-1936, and a note explains why these figures differ from the exports tables.

metadata.title: Exports of Matches
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the value of Japan's match exports by destination in 1935 and 1936, illustrating the shift of export markets after the Kreuger collapse.

metadata.title: Production of Matches, Etc.
metadata.description: Gives the yearly output of matches and allied articles (gross, value, match-boxes and matchwood) from 1926 to 1935, shown as recent production trends.

metadata.title: Imports of Dyestuff
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's dyestuff imports by colour type for 1934 to 1936, showing that imports still continued despite domestic dye production growth.

metadata.title: Production of Synthetic Dyestuffs
metadata.description: Shows annual output of basic, direct, acid and mordant synthetic dyestuffs in quantity and value, reflecting the growth of Japan's domestic dye industry in the early 1930s.

metadata.title: Production of Synthetic Dyestuffs
metadata.description: Gives yearly output of sulphide dyes, artificial indigo and other vat colours, with a combined total, continuing the survey of synthetic dyestuff production.

metadata.title: Production of Aniline and Intermediates
