metadata.title: [Kindergartens and Children Attending, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: Gives the number of kindergartens and the children attending them in each year from 1931 to 1935.

metadata.title: [Miscellaneous Schools and Their Pupils, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: Gives the number of miscellaneous schools and their pupils in each year from 1931 to 1935.

metadata.title: [Number of Schools for Training Teachers and Their Students, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: Introduces the training of teachers for the years 1931-1935, giving the number of schools for training teachers and their students.

metadata.title: [Number of Normal Schools and Their Students and Graduates, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: Shows the number of normal schools, and their students and graduates, for 1931-1935, as the principal organs for training elementary school teachers.

metadata.title: [Agricultural, Technical, Commercial and Total Schools for Training Business School Teachers, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: The table shows the number of institutes training business school teachers by type, with their students and graduates, for 1931-1935.

metadata.title: [Institutes, Students and Graduates for Training Business Continuation School Teachers, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: The table gives the number of institutes for training business continuation school teachers, with their students and graduates, for 1931-1935.

metadata.title: [Students Abroad at the End of March, 1930-1935]
metadata.description: The figures show how many persons were sent abroad for further study at the government's expense at the end of March each year.

metadata.title: Teacher's Certificate Given by Examination
metadata.description: Shows the number of applicants and certificates granted by examination to teachers of various school types in 1934–1935, as a classification of the 33,494 certificates issued.

metadata.title: [Public Libraries, Books and Readers, 1931–1935]
metadata.description: Presents the growth of public libraries, their book stocks, readers and daily average readership per library from 1931 to 1935, illustrating the progress noted in the Libraries paragraph.

metadata.title: [Young Men's and Young Women's Associations and Their Members, 1930–1934]
metadata.description: The table gives the number of young men's and young women's associations and their members for 1930 to 1934, illustrating the spread of these self-governing youth bodies outside the schools.

metadata.title: [Total Governmental and Public Educational Expenditure, 1930–1935]
metadata.description: Shows total governmental and public educational expenditure by source of funds for each year from 1930 to 1935, introduced by the text on how teacher salaries and extended education raised spending.

metadata.title: Governmental Educational Expenditure
metadata.description: Lists the national government's educational expenditure by category for 1934–1935, shown as a two-column breakdown with a total.

metadata.title: Public Educational Expenditure Borne by Local Public Bodies
metadata.description: Breaks down the 1934–1935 public educational expenditure paid by Hokkaido, prefectures, cities, school associations, and towns and villages, by kind of school.

metadata.title: Educational Expenditure Borne by Private Bodies in 1934–1935
metadata.description: Shows the educational expenditure and revenue of private bodies in Japan proper for 1934–1935, by school type, following the note on total private educational spending.

metadata.title: Foreign Teachers and Students
metadata.caption: At the end of March, 1935
metadata.description: Gives the number of foreign teachers and foreign pupils and students at each type of school in Japan at the end of March 1935, split by sex.

metadata.title: [Foreign Teachers and Students by Schools]
metadata.description: Summarises the number of foreign teachers and students in Japan's business, blind, deaf and dumb and miscellaneous schools, as a basis for the five-year comparison that follows.

metadata.title: [Foreign Teachers and Students, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: Gives the year-by-year number of foreign teachers and students from 1931 to 1935, as the text announces a five-year comparison.

metadata.title: [Number of Shrines at the End of 1934]
metadata.description: Gives, from the Shrine Bureau's report, the number of shrines of each type in Japan at the end of 1934, as the text introduces them.

metadata.title: Sectarian Shinto
metadata.caption: (End of 1933)
metadata.description: Gives the number of preaching halls, preachers (men, women and total) and adherents of the Sectarian Shinto denominations, introducing the page's survey of religious statistics.

metadata.title: Buddhism
metadata.caption: (End of 1933)
metadata.description: Lists Buddhist denominations with their temples, executive heads, priests by sex and adherents, giving the state of the Buddhist church at the end of 1933.

metadata.title: Christianity
metadata.caption: (End of 1933)
metadata.description: Gives the Christian denominations in Japan with their churches, preaching stations, preachers and adherents at the end of 1933.

metadata.title: Conditions of the Work of the Block Committee
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (March, 1935)
metadata.description: Summarises the state of the Block Committees in March 1935, giving the number of committees, blocks and committeemen, which motivated the new legal framework described beside it.

metadata.title: Number of families and their members in cities, towns and villages where the system is established and the number of poor families and their members which are registered
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: Shows how many families and household members in cities, towns and villages under the block system were there, and how many poor families and members were registered for relief.

metadata.title: Estimated Expenditure of the Social Bureau
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the estimated annual expenditure of the Social Bureau on ordinary and extraordinary items, illustrating the government's child protection and social relief spending across four fiscal years.

metadata.title: [Children Protected by the Law, 1934–1935]
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: The page reports how many children were protected under the new Child Protection Law in 1934–1935, broken down by type of protection, sex, and cause of maltreatment.

metadata.title: Relief of Mothers and Children, 1932–34
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: This table gives the number of children under 13 and nursing mothers receiving relief under the general Relief Law, with the relief money paid, for fiscal years 1932 to 1934.

metadata.title: Pawners at the Public Pawnshops
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: Shows the number of public pawnshops and the number of pawners from each occupation group borrowing from them, year by year, to illustrate who uses the pawnshops.

metadata.title: Standing Loans of the Public Pawnshops
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: Gives the yearly figures for public pawnshops' loans, including number and amount of loans, average loan size and the balance outstanding at fiscal year end.

metadata.title: Employment Exchange
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: The table gives the yearly business of public employment exchanges from 1923 to 1936, covering general situations and day-labour placements, to illustrate the bureau's growth.

metadata.title: Unemployment Relief Enterprises in 1933-1936
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (Subsidized ones only)
metadata.description: Summarises the subsidized unemployment relief enterprises of the last three fiscal years, giving expenses, wages and work days for ordinary labourers and the low-salaried class.

metadata.title: Business Training Institutes for the Unemployed
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: Lists the business training institutes for unemployed people run by cities and prefectures, showing management mode, capacity, costs, subsidies, instructors and course length.

metadata.title: Results of Relief Work
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (Units 1,000 people and ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the results of the relief work under the Relief Law since 1932, giving numbers relieved and expenses defrayed for living cost, medical treatment and maternity cases.

metadata.title: Military Relief 1930-1935
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: Statistics of persons relieved and sums expended under the Military Relief Law for each year from 1930 to 1935, shown to illustrate the growth of relief during the depression.

metadata.title: Statistical Table of Social Work in Japan
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (Fiscal Year 1933-34)
metadata.description: The table gives the number of institutions, property and funds, and expenditure for social work organs and child protection services in Japan for fiscal 1933-34, illustrating the scale of welfare activity discussed in the preceding text.

metadata.title: [Statistical Table of Social Work in Japan]
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: The first part lists the numbers of organizations, their property and funds, and their expenditure across each category of social work in Japan, with a grand total.

metadata.title: Statistical Table of Social Work in Jaran
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.caption: (Continued)
metadata.description: The continuation gives the results in cases and student numbers, plus the number of workers, for the organs engaged in social work.

metadata.title: [Results of Social Work Undertakings]
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: The page gives statistical results of social work undertakings by category (child protection, economic protection, unemployment relief, poor relief, medical treatment), with cases and workers.

metadata.title: [Social Work Results and Workers by Institution]
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.description: This table summarises the results and staff of the various social work institutions, such as settlements, consultation bureaux and welfare protection schemes, with a grand total at the foot.

metadata.title: Classification of People in Japan Proper According to Occupations
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xxxi — Labour and Labour Movements
metadata.caption: (The 1930 Census)
metadata.description: Census figures classifying the population of Japan proper by occupation, showing totals, sexes, and occupied employees, introduced as the vocational classification of the population.

metadata.title: [Labourers by Kind of Occupation, End of 1935]
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xxxi — Labour and Labour Movements
metadata.description: Investigation by the Labour Section of the Social Bureau giving the number of labourers by kind of occupation at the end of 1935.

metadata.title: Number of Factory Labourers by Industries
metadata.chapter: XXX. Social Problems and Social Works
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xxxi — Labour and Labour Movements
metadata.caption: Sex Distribution
metadata.description: Factory labourers in Japan proper classified by industry, showing number, percentage share, and male and female distribution at the end of 1935.

metadata.title: [Workers by Industry, Sex and Number]
metadata.description: The table gives the number of workers by industry with percentages and the male and female split, and it continues a fuller industry table begun on the previous page.

metadata.title: Age Distribution
metadata.description: The table shows the age distribution of workers in each industry, under 16, 16-49 and over 50, with percentages, to show how far juvenile and older labour is employed.

metadata.title: Comparison of Index Numbers of Labourers in 1935 and 1936
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Bank of Japan); (Base, 1926=100)
metadata.description: The table compares monthly and annual labour index numbers for 1935 and 1936, average and by sex, showing the recovery in employment during 1936.

metadata.title: Unemployment by Kinds of Labour
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Social Bureau); (In 1,000)
metadata.description: The table gives unemployment figures for total workers and salaried men at successive investigation dates, with rates, showing the decline after 1932 as described in the adjacent text.

metadata.title: Labourers
metadata.description: Shows the investigated numbers, unemployment counts and rates for day-labourers and other labourers from 1925 to 1935, illustrating the labour market trend mentioned in the text.

metadata.title: Movement of Employment at Factories and Mines Where More Than 50 Operatives Are Employed
metadata.description: Gives yearly dismissals, engagements and October totals of employees at large factories and mines, supporting the text on the excess of dismissals over engagements.

metadata.title: [Aggregate Labour Hours, Total Amount of Wages and Per Hour Wage by Industry, 1935]
metadata.description: Shows 1935 labour hours, total wages and average hourly wage for factory labourers by industry, supporting the text on the average wage of 12 sen per hour.

metadata.title: Average Daily Wages of Labourers (In 13 Largest Cities)
metadata.caption: (In Yen)
metadata.description: Gives average daily wages of silk-reelers, a female textile occupation, in the 13 largest cities from 1931 to 1936.

metadata.title: Average Daily Wages of Workers Employed in Farming and Sericulture
metadata.caption: (In Yen)
metadata.description: Shows average daily wages in yen, with index numbers, for male and female workers employed in farming and in sericulture, by year, season and day, from 1926 to 1935.

metadata.title: Average Daily Wages of Miners
metadata.caption: (In Yen)
metadata.description: Shows average daily wages of male and female workers in mineral, coal, oil-field and other mines from 1929 to 1934, reflecting the labour conditions discussed in the section.

metadata.title: Average Daily Wages of Employees on Fishing Boats and Vessels
metadata.caption: (In Yen)
metadata.description: Shows average daily wages of employees on fishing boats and vessels by occupation from 1929 to 1933, with index numbers on a 1926-1928 base.

metadata.title: Index Number of Factory Labourers
metadata.description: Shows the monthly and yearly index of factory labour for all, male and female workers from 1932 to December 1936, with changes on the previous year, illustrating the rise in employment.

metadata.title: Index Number of Factory Labourers Classified According to Principal Industries
metadata.description: Breaks down the factory labour index by principal industry for 1933 to 1935 and the first four months of 1936, showing which industries grew most under the wartime expansion.

metadata.title: [Index Numbers of Wage Rates by Industries, May to December 1936]
metadata.description: Continuation of the monthly wage-rate index numbers by industry, covering May to December 1936 and showing the later movements in each trade.

metadata.title: The Rate of Unemployed for the Last 4 Years (in %)
metadata.description: Monthly rates of unemployment for 1933 to 1936, showing the decline in unemployment that accompanies the labour market discussion in the text.

metadata.title: Index Number of Wage Rates, Compiled by Bank of Japan
metadata.caption: (Base 1926=100)
metadata.description: Monthly index of wage rates compiled by the Bank of Japan, showing the downward movement of wage rates from 1932 to 1936.

metadata.title: Index Number of Wage Rates Classified According to Principal Industries
metadata.caption: (Base 1926=100)
metadata.description: Wage rate index by principal industry for 1933 to 1936, showing wage rates falling while actual earnings rose in the same period.

metadata.title: Index Number of Actual Earnings
metadata.caption: (Base, 1926=100)
metadata.description: Monthly index numbers of actual earnings for 1933 to 1936, shown alongside the text noting that earnings rose in few industries and fell considerably in several.

metadata.title: The Index Number of Actual Earnings Classified According to Principal Industries
metadata.caption: (Base 1926=100)
metadata.description: Index numbers of actual earnings for each principal industry, from 1933 through December 1936, showing how wage levels moved in each sector.

metadata.title: The Index Number of the Real Value of Wages
metadata.caption: (Base, 1926=100)
metadata.description: Shows the real value of wages, derived by dividing actual earnings by the Bank of Japan retail price index, on a 1926 base, for 1931 to September 1936.

metadata.title: Index Number of Living Costs
metadata.caption: (Base, 1926=100)
metadata.description: Gives monthly living-cost index numbers by category, showing the rise in costs against which the real wage index is compared.

metadata.title: Working Hours
metadata.caption: (Exclusive of extra working hours)
metadata.description: Monthly working hours excluding extra work, computed as daily hours times working days, for January to May in 1936 and 1935, with January short due to New Year holidays.

metadata.title: Total Monthly Working Hours in the Principal Industries
metadata.description: Shows total monthly working hours by industry group for 1933 to 1936, supporting the discussion of how working hours changed across industries.

metadata.title: Hours and Days Worked per Month in the Principal Industries
metadata.description: Gives the average hours and days worked per month in each principal industry for 1933 to 1936, showing the figures behind the hourly comparison.

metadata.title: Rest Periods in the Chief Industries, 1935
metadata.description: Shows average daily rest periods in 1935 for all industries and for three chief industry groups, illustrating that munition-related industries had less rest than average.

metadata.title: [Factory Accident Casualties as Share of Labourers, 1926-1934]
metadata.description: Gives the yearly percentage figures for factory accidents from 1926 to 1934, for private factories and for all factories including government-managed ones, supporting the text on rising accident rates.

metadata.title: Total Casualties in Industry
metadata.description: Lists the numbers of workers killed, seriously injured and slightly injured in industrial accidents from 1932 to 1934, with yearly totals, showing the rising trend.

metadata.title: Labour Accidents
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Social Bureau, Home Ministry)
metadata.description: Breaks down labour accidents for 1925 and 1926 between government and private factories and by industry, showing where accidents occurred most.

metadata.title: [Number of Factory Accidents by Year]
metadata.description: Shows yearly counts of factory accidents, split between government and private factories and by industry, from 1927 to 1934.

metadata.title: Rate of Factory Accidents per 1,000 Operatives
metadata.description: Gives the rate of factory accidents per 1,000 operatives, in total and by government and private factory category, 1928 to 1934.

metadata.title: Accidents in Mines
metadata.description: Lists yearly mine accidents with cases, deaths, injured and total casualties from 1925 to 1934, as background to the accompanying text on mine accidents.

metadata.title: Marine Accidents
metadata.description: Summarises marine accidents from 1925 to 1929: wrecked fishing boats by engine type, losses, fishermen involved and crew casualties, as described in the accompanying text.

metadata.title: [Labour Accident Relief Legal Insurance Business Conditions, April 1935 to March 1936]
metadata.description: The page gives the business conditions of the Labour Accident Relief Legal Insurance from April 1935 to March 1936, showing premium income, payments, carried-forward balances and insured enterprises and labourers.

metadata.title: Accidents on Civil Engineering and Building Jobs during 1932-1935
metadata.description: Shows the number of labourers employed on civil engineering and building jobs and the resulting deaths and injuries, with rates, for 1932 to 1935, illustrating the rising accident problem discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Health Insurance: Insured Persons Classified by Bodies in Charge
metadata.description: Gives the number of persons insured under Health Insurance at the end of September 1936, classified by the bodies under whose charge the business falls and by kind of insurance.

metadata.title: [Mills, Working Places and Undertakings under Governmental Charge]
metadata.caption: (Under Governmental charge only)
metadata.description: Lists the number of mills, working places and undertakings in 1935 by type under Governmental charge, with the grand total including undertakings employing voluntarily insured persons.

metadata.title: [Health Insurance Guaranteed Payments by Cause, 1934-35]
metadata.description: Shows the number of cases and amounts paid under health insurance guaranteed payments during 1934-35, broken down by the reason for payment.

metadata.title: [Medical Organization of Health Insurance under Direct Government Charge, September 1936]
metadata.description: Lists the number of medical personnel in the health insurance system directly administered by the Government at the end of September 1936.

metadata.title: [Medical Organization under Health Insurance Associations, End of 1934]
metadata.description: Gives the number of ordinary and dental medical facilities and contracted practitioners under the Health Insurance Associations at the end of 1934.

metadata.title: Labour Disputes
metadata.description: Shows the number of labour disputes by industry and the number of participants from 1932 to 1936, illustrating the decline in disputes after 1931.

metadata.title: Cases Classified According to Demands
metadata.description: Labour cases from 1932 to 1934 are sorted into positive demands, such as higher wages and shorter hours, and negative demands, such as opposing wage cuts or dismissals.

metadata.title: Number of Labour Disputes Accompanied by Strikes, Sabotage or Lockouts 1931-1935
metadata.description: Labour disputes from 1931 to 1935 are counted by whether they involved strikes, sabotage or lockouts, with the number of cases, participants and participants per case.

metadata.title: Classified by Demands
metadata.description: Labour cases from 1931 to 1935 are broken down by the demands made, showing the number of cases and men involved for each demand type.

metadata.title: [Tenant Disputes by Demands and Results, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: Shows the number of tenant dispute cases and participating men in each year from 1931 to 1935, broken down by the demand made.

metadata.title: Results of Disputes
metadata.description: Gives the yearly outcome of tenant disputes from 1931 to 1935, showing how many were compromised, accepted, unaccepted, defeated or left unsettled.

metadata.title: Tenant Disputes
metadata.description: Lists the number of tenant disputes, participating tenants and area involved each year, with 1936 given as an estimate.

metadata.title: Tenant Disputes
metadata.caption: By Causes
metadata.description: Breaks down the tenant disputes of 1931 to 1935 by their underlying causes, as the text introduces the yearly causes, demands and results.

metadata.title: Tenant Disputes
metadata.caption: By Demands
metadata.description: Breaks down the tenant disputes of 1931 to 1935 by the demands the tenants made, such as lowering rents or continuing tenure.

metadata.title: Results of Disputes
metadata.description: Shows the yearly results of tenant disputes from 1931 to 1935, by outcome, illustrating the decline in disputes over tenant rents and the rise in those over tenant rights.

metadata.title: Tenant Disputes in 1935
metadata.description: Summarises the Department of Agriculture and Forestry report on tenant disputes in 1935, giving the number of disputes, participants and area of land under dispute.

metadata.title: Arbitration in Tenant Disputes in 1935
metadata.description: Shows the number of appeals for arbitration under the Tenant Dispute Arbitration Law in 1935, with complainants, participants and land area, and the increase over 1934.

metadata.title: Landowners' and Tenant-farmers' Unions in 1935
metadata.description: Summarises the number of tenant-farmers', landowners' and mixed unions and their members in 1935, following the note on cases mediated by Tenant Officials.

metadata.title: Tenant-Farmers' Unions
metadata.description: Shows the yearly decline and recovery in the number of tenant-farmers' unions and their members from 1932 to 1935.

metadata.title: Landowners' Unions
metadata.description: Gives the yearly number of landowners' unions and their membership from 1932 to 1935, showing a steady fall.

metadata.title: Landowners and Tenant-Farmers' Unions
metadata.description: Records the associations and members of mixed landowner and tenant-farmer unions for 1932 to 1935.

metadata.title: Members of the Japan Trade Union Council
metadata.description: Lists the nine member bodies of the Japan Trade Union Council and their membership, giving the combined total of 263,914 labourers.

metadata.title: [Member Unions of the Council]
metadata.description: The list gives the fifteen member unions of the Council, with the membership of each union and the aggregate total of 80,278.

metadata.title: Trade Unions
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Social Bureau)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly growth of Japanese trade unions from 1924 to 1935, with unions, members, total labourers and union share, alongside the text on union organisation.

metadata.title: Farmers' Unions
metadata.description: Shows the yearly number of farmers' unions and their members, split by landowners, tenant-farmers and combined, from 1929 to 1935.

metadata.title: Friendly Societies Government Factories
metadata.caption: (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: Gives membership, income and disbursements of friendly societies attached to government factories for 1930 to 1934.

metadata.title: Private Factories
metadata.description: Lists the number of friendly societies and their membership in private factories from 1930 to 1935.

metadata.title: Consumers' Co-operative Societies Organized by Labourers in City Areas
metadata.caption: (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: Summarises consumers' co-operative societies run by city labourers from 1930 to 1934, covering membership, capital, sales, deposits, loans and balances.

metadata.title: [Jobworkers in Nagoya City Classified by Age and Sex]
metadata.description: Shows the number of out-workers (jobworkers) in Nagoya's home industries by age group and sex, with each group's share of the total, to illustrate the predominance of young women.

metadata.title: [Home Work Out-workers Classified by Class of Work]
metadata.description: Shows how the several hundred kinds of home work fall into ten major classes, with the number of kinds and of workers in each and their percentage shares.

metadata.title: [Monthly Wages of Out-workers by Article]
metadata.description: Gives the total monthly wages earned by out-workers in each article group, their share of the whole and the average monthly wage per capita, to be read with the previous table.

metadata.title: [Purposes for Which Out-Work Income Was Spent]
metadata.description: The table breaks down how out-workers' families spend the income earned from out-work, showing the number of home-workers and the percentage for each purpose.

metadata.title: [Out-Workers Classified by Hours Spent in a Day]
metadata.description: The text gives the daily working hours of out-workers, and this small table classifies them into three groups by hours worked per day, with numbers and percentages.

metadata.title: [Persons, Dairy Firms, Milk-Cows and Milk Quantities, 1935]
metadata.caption: (Quantities of milk in Litres)
metadata.description: The table gives the number of persons, dairy firms, milk plants and milk-cows engaged in milk production in 1935, with milk quantities produced and handled, asterisked figures being special milk.

metadata.title: Goat's Milk
metadata.caption: (Litres)
metadata.description: The table compares 1935 goat's milk figures for persons, dairies, milk-goats and milk output with the increases over 1934.

metadata.title: Milk-Products
metadata.description: Lists the 1935 output of milk products in kilograms, shown alongside the discussion of dairy products under medicine and sanitation.

metadata.title: [Snow and Ice Traders and Quantities, 1935]
metadata.description: Gives the number of snow and ice traders at the end of 1935 and the quantities of snow and ice gathered or manufactured, compared with 1934.

metadata.title: [Number of Manufacturers of Non-Alcoholic Drinks]
metadata.description: Shows the number of manufacturers of each kind of non-alcoholic drink in 1935 and the change from the previous year.

metadata.title: [Quantity of Non-Alcoholic Drinks Manufactured]
metadata.description: Gives the quantity of non-alcoholic drinks manufactured in 1935 and the change compared with the preceding year.

metadata.title: [Waterworks Permitted, Cities, Towns and Villages]
metadata.description: Classifies the waterworks permitted between April 1935 and March 1936 by the body undertaking them and how many were completed.

metadata.title: [Waterworks Permitted, Associations, Prefectures and Private Parties]
metadata.description: Breaks down the waterworks permitted by undertaking body, with the number constructed and completed, as a companion to the city and village table.

metadata.title: [Refuse Removal and Sanitary Statistics, 1935]
metadata.description: Summarises the 1935 refuse removal, incineration and water-closet figures for the 128 cities under the Law for the Removal of Refuse, giving the general idea of foul-matter removal.

metadata.title: [Animals Slaughtered for Food, 1935]
metadata.description: Lists the number of animals of various kinds slaughtered for food in 1935 and the change from the preceding year, excluding emergency and household slaughter.

metadata.title: [Weight of Meat from Slaughtered Animals, 1935]
metadata.description: Gives the total and average weight of meat from each kind of slaughtered animal in 1935 with comparison to the preceding year.

metadata.title: [Meat Inspected and Condemned, 1935]
metadata.description: Shows the quantity of meat inspected in 1935 by type, and the amount condemned and the resulting ratio of condemned meat.

metadata.title: [Insane Persons Admitted and in Custody, 1935]
metadata.description: Breaks down the insane persons at the end of 1935 by custody or admission status, giving actual numbers and percentages for males, females and totals.

metadata.title: [Results of Tuberculosis Health Examinations, 1935]
metadata.description: Gives the results of the 1935 tuberculosis health examinations conducted by prefectural governments, with changes compared with the preceding year.

metadata.title: [Trachoma Examinations, 1935]
metadata.description: The table gives the results of trachoma examinations conducted by the prefectural governments in 1935, compared with the preceding year, under the Law for the Prevention of Trachoma.

metadata.title: [Diseases Found in Examined Prostitutes Throughout the Country, 1935]
metadata.description: The table classifies, by disease, the prostitutes in the whole country found diseased on examination during 1935, with ratios to total cases for 1932–1935.

metadata.title: Fifty Years of Infectious Diseases
metadata.description: A table summarising the rates of cholera, dysentery, typhoid, smallpox and diphtheria over fifty years since 1886, given as a closing overview of infectious disease statistics.

metadata.title: [Public and Private Vaccinations by Period, First and Second Times]
metadata.description: The text introduces the number of public and private vaccinations, first and second times, in the two periods, as a comparison with the preceding year's results.

metadata.title: [Licences Issued to Medical Practitioners, 1935 Compared with Preceding Year]
metadata.description: Shows the number of persons to whom medical licences were issued in 1935, by category, with changes compared with the preceding year.

metadata.title: [Medical Practitioners at the End of 1935, Classified and in Percentage]
metadata.description: Gives the total number of medical practitioners at the end of 1935 by category, with percentage shares for 1935 and the preceding four years for comparison.

metadata.title: [Dental Surgeons Licences Issued in 1935]
metadata.description: Shows the number of dental surgeon licences issued in 1935 by route of qualification, compared with the preceding year.

metadata.title: [Dental Surgeons at the End of 1935 Classified, with Percentages]
metadata.description: Gives the classified number of dental surgeons at the end of 1935 with each category's share of the total, compared with the four preceding years.

metadata.title: [Pharmacists' Licences Issued in 1935]
metadata.description: Shows the number of persons to whom pharmacist's licences were issued in 1935 by qualification route, compared with the preceding year.

metadata.title: [Pharmacists Classified by Qualification, 1931-1935]
metadata.description: The table gives the 1935 number of pharmacists by qualification route, with percentage shares for 1931-1935, following the report of the total pharmacist count.

metadata.title: Acupuncture, Moxicautery, and Massage
metadata.description: Shows the number of persons licensed by prefectural offices at the end of 1935 in acupuncture, moxicautery and massage, by sex and blindness, with combined practices.

metadata.title: [Public Hospitals by Accommodation for Patients]
metadata.description: Gives the number of public hospitals at the end of 1935 by size of accommodation for patients and by urban, town and village location.

metadata.title: [Accommodations and Capacity of Public Hospitals, 1935]
metadata.description: Lists the total accommodations of public hospitals in 1935 and the part of that capacity reserved for infectious diseases and tuberculosis.

metadata.title: [Number of Public Hospital Patients, 1935]
metadata.description: Records the movement of patients in public hospitals during 1935, with averages per hospital and average length of stay.

metadata.title: [Private Hospitals by Accommodation and Locality]
metadata.description: Shows the 2,811 private hospitals at the end of 1935 distributed among cities, towns and villages according to their capacity for admitting patients.

metadata.title: [Private Hospitals Classified by Diseases Treated]
metadata.description: The table gives the number of private hospitals in cities, towns and villages, classified by the diseases they treat.

metadata.title: [Private Hospitals: Capacity and In-Patients, 1935]
