metadata.description: The table gives the number of farm households in Japan proper from 1935 to 1939, split by agricultural engagement and by tenure, supporting the text's discussion of the decline in households.

metadata.title: Owners of Arable-Lands
metadata.description: Gives the number of owners of arable land at year end from 1935 to 1939, grouped by the size of land owned.

metadata.title: Arable Lands
metadata.caption: (In cho)
metadata.description: Shows total arable land in cho for 1935 to 1939, split between rice-fields and upland-farms and by owner-cultivated versus tenant-cultivated land.

metadata.title: Fluctuations of Prices of Farmland
metadata.caption: (In yen per tan)
metadata.description: Shows Industrial Bank survey prices of farmland from 1932 to 1934, given as a comparison with the ministry's 1939 survey.

metadata.title: [Value of Farm Production by Items, 1939]
metadata.description: The tail of a breakdown of the 1939 total value of production by farm-households, showing cocoons, wood and bamboo, and the grand total.

metadata.title: Production by Farmers in 1939
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Lists the 1939 value of farm production by farmers under each main category, summarising the value of production discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Farm Products Value, 1940
metadata.description: Shows the 1940 value of each farm product and its share of total farm production, illustrating that rice's share of the combined farm value had fallen.

metadata.title: Supply
metadata.caption: (In koku)
metadata.description: Gives the annual rice supply in koku over the past ten years, showing carry-over stocks, prior-year production, imports and the resulting total.

metadata.title: Demand
metadata.description: Gives the annual disposition of rice over the past ten years: exports, carry-forward stocks, domestic consumption, population and per capita consumption.

metadata.title: Rice Conditions in Chosen
metadata.description: Shows rice production, exports to Japan Proper, and consumption in Chosen (Korea) for 1931–1939, documenting the colony's rice supply position.

metadata.title: Rice Conditions in Taiwan
metadata.description: Shows rice production, exports to Japan Proper, and consumption in Taiwan for 1931–1939, alongside the Chosen figures.

metadata.title: Utilization of Rice According to Purposes, in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (From November 1, 1937 to October 31, 1938) (In 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Breaks down how the rice used in Japan Proper during the 1937–38 crop year was allocated across food and industrial purposes.

metadata.title: Standard Prices of Rice
metadata.caption: (In yen, Per koku, Unhulled Rice)
metadata.description: Lists the government's standard minimum and maximum prices per koku of unhulled rice set under the Rice Control Law from 1933 to 1940.

metadata.title: Rice Crop in 1936–1941 in Japan Proper
metadata.description: Compares the area planted and the rice crop in Japan Proper for 1936–1940, their five-year average, and the 1941 estimate.

metadata.title: Value of Cereal Production in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Area in cho, Value in yen)
metadata.description: The cereal table gives the cultivated area and production value of each cereal crop in Japan Proper for 1936 to 1939 under the Agriculture heading.

metadata.title: Chief Products Summarized
metadata.description: This summary lists the quantities and values of the chief non-cereal farm products, introduced by the sentence 'Chief products are summarized below'.

metadata.title: [Leguminous Plants Area and Production]
metadata.description: The text gives the 1939 area planted and value of production of soya-beans and azuki beans, the two chief leguminous crops.

metadata.title: [Sweet Potatoes, Daikon and Potatoes Area and Production]
metadata.description: The text reports the area and production of tuber and root crops in 1939, naming sweet potatoes, daikon and potatoes as the predominant ones.

metadata.title: [Chief Vegetable Products]
metadata.description: This table gives the 1939 quantities and values of the chief vegetable products, introduced by the text on vegetable area and production.

metadata.title: [Predominant Fruits]
metadata.description: The text states the value of the fruit production and lists the predominant fruits with their quantities and values.

metadata.title: Number of Animals Slaughtered
metadata.description: Shows the number of each kind of animal slaughtered in 1939 at slaughter-houses, which the text gives alongside the number of slaughter-houses and the quantity of meat obtained.

metadata.title: Quantity of Meat Obtained
metadata.description: Gives the quantity of meat obtained from each kind of slaughtered animal in 1939, with the total for all animals.

metadata.title: Number and Value of Eggs Obtained, July 1938—June 1939
metadata.caption: July 1938—June 1939
metadata.description: Reports the number and value of eggs obtained from fowls and ducks during the year ending June 1939.

metadata.title: Tea Plantations in Japan
metadata.caption: (In Chobu)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly growth of tea gardens and total tea plantation area in Japan from 1930 to 1940, as the opening table of the agricultural tea statistics.

metadata.title: Tea Plantations in Japan by Prefectures
metadata.caption: (In Chobu)
metadata.description: Breaks down the Japanese tea plantation area for 1939 and 1940 by leading prefecture, showing Shizuoka as the largest producer.

metadata.title: Average Prices of Tea
metadata.caption: (In Yen per Kwan)
metadata.description: Gives the average yen-per-kwan price of each grade of tea, from sencha and bancha to gyokuro and black tea, for 1936 to 1940.

metadata.title: Tea Production by Varieties
metadata.caption: (Quantity in 1,000 Kwan; Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the quantity and value of each tea variety (gyokuro, sencha, bancha, black tea) and the overall total produced in Japan from 1936 to 1940, along with the number of tea producers.

metadata.title: Japan's Tea Exports 1930-40
metadata.caption: (Quantity in 1,000 Kwan; Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's annual tea exports from 1930 to 1940 by green, black and other teas, with totals, to illustrate the trade in tea.

metadata.title: Japan's Exports of Tea by Countries
metadata.caption: (Quantity in 1,000 Kwan; Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Breaks down Japan's tea exports for 1936-1939 by destination country or region, giving quantity and value for each year.

metadata.title: Number of Live-Stock in Japan
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Head)
metadata.description: Gives the number of cattle, milk cows, pigs, sheep and goats in Japan at the end of each year from 1931 to 1940, supporting the text on livestock breeding.

metadata.title: Number of Houses Raising Cattle or Pigs
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Houses)
metadata.description: Shows the number of farm households keeping cattle or pigs at the end of each year from 1931 to 1940, grouped by head-count class, illustrating the growth of livestock raising.

metadata.title: Number of Live-Stock Slaughtered
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Head)
metadata.description: Gives the number of butcheries and live-stock slaughtered by kind, with total and meat supplied, for 1931 to 1940, illustrating the meat supply discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Number of Houses Raising Honey-Bees
metadata.caption: Houses Keeping
metadata.description: Shows how many households kept honey-bees in each colony-size class, with yearly totals, from 1930 to 1940 as part of the livestock survey.

metadata.title: Number of Boxes of Honey Bees by Origin
metadata.description: Gives the number of honey-bee boxes kept, split between domestic and foreign species, with totals, for each year from 1930 to 1940.

metadata.title: Production of Honey and Bees-Wax
metadata.description: Reports the annual output of honey and bees-wax in kwan and yen, with the combined yen value, for 1930 to 1940.

metadata.title: Domestic Production of Fruits by Year
metadata.description: Shows national fruit tree numbers, fruit output and production value for 1931–1940, illustrating the growth of Japan's fruit industry over the decade.

metadata.title: Number of Fruit-Trees in Japan
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Trees)
metadata.description: Lists the number of fruit trees of each kind in Japan for 1937–1940, giving the national totals for the years covered by the preceding production figures.

metadata.title: Production of Fruits in Japan
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Kwan)
metadata.description: Gives the national fruit output by kind for 1937–1940, with plums in koku converted to kwan and totals including plums, as a companion to the tree counts.

metadata.title: Number of Cooperative Societies
metadata.caption: (At the year end)
metadata.description: Gives the number of village cooperative societies of each type (credit, trading, purchasing, utilization and combinations) at the end of each year from 1934 to 1939.

metadata.title: Operation of Cooperative Societies
metadata.caption: (At the end of March) (Amount in yen)
metadata.description: The table shows the yearly operation of cooperative societies from 1935 to 1939, covering capital, credit, trading, purchasing and utilization societies.

metadata.title: Number of Village Warehouses
metadata.description: Shows the yearly growth from 1934 to 1939 in the number of village warehouses, by owner type, federations, and storage capacity for cereals and cocoons.

metadata.title: Farmland in Japan at End of 1940
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Chobu)
metadata.description: Shows the change in Japan's farmland at the end of 1940 compared with 1939, with total area and the amounts expanded and destroyed, as a note on agricultural conditions.

metadata.title: Production of Principal Cereals
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Koku)
metadata.description: Shows annual production of rice, barley, rye and wheat from 1937 to 1941, supporting the page's discussion of East Asian rice supply and cereal output.

metadata.title: Area of Farmland Planted with Principal Cereals
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Chobu)
metadata.description: Gives the acreage planted with rice, barley, rye and wheat from 1937 to 1941, shown alongside the production figures to indicate cultivation trends.

metadata.title: Rice Exports and Imports within Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Metric Tons)
metadata.description: Shows rice imports and exports among Japan, its colonies, and other Asian and Southeast Asian countries from 1936 to 1939, illustrating the regional rice trade within the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere.

metadata.title: Rice-Planted Areas
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Hectares)
metadata.description: Gives rice-planted areas by country in East Asia and the Co-prosperity Sphere for four seasons, showing the acreage under rice in each region.

metadata.title: Rice Production
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Metric Tons)
metadata.description: Gives annual rice production in metric tons for the same countries and regions of East Asia and the Co-prosperity Sphere, following the rice-planted area figures.

metadata.title: [Asia and World Totals, Continued]
metadata.description: Continuation from the previous page, giving the Asia and World totals for the crop years 1936-37 to 1939-40 against which the per-hectare figures that follow are read.

metadata.title: Per-Hectare Production
metadata.caption: (In Metric Tons)
metadata.description: Shows the yield of major rice-growing countries and regions per hectare for four crop years, comparing Japan with Chosen, Taiwan, Manchoukuo, and Southeast and South Asian producers.

metadata.title: [Annual Cocoon Output, 1931–1941]
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xiv — Sericulture and Raw Silk
metadata.description: A year-by-year series of cocoon figures from 1931 to 1941 given without printed column headings, supporting the history of silk production in the chapter.

metadata.title: [Cocoon Output, 1880–1884 and 1930]
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xiv — Sericulture and Raw Silk
metadata.description: Compares cocoon output in the early 1880s with 1930 using an index, showing the growth over the past half century.

metadata.title: Cocoon Statistics in Japan
metadata.chapter_raw: Chapter Xiv — Sericulture and Raw Silk
metadata.description: Gives the number of cocoon raising-houses, egg-cards gathered and cocoon production by season for 1937–1941, detailing the decline described in the text.

metadata.title: Cocoon Production
metadata.caption: (Million Yen)
metadata.description: The opening figures give national silk cocoon output in million yen, split between spring and summer-autumn crops, as the start of the cocoon production section.

metadata.title: Domestic Production of Cocoons by Prefectures 1941
metadata.description: This prefectural table gives the 1941 cocoon harvest by prefecture: egg-cards gathered and spring, summer-autumn and total cocoon output, with the decrease from 1940.

metadata.title: Cocoon Raising Houses 1930-1940
metadata.description: Shows how the number of spring and summer-autumn cocoon-raising houses in Chosen, and their share of farm houses, changed from 1930 to 1940, supporting the text on sericulture expansion.

metadata.title: Cocoon Production in Chosen 1935-40
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 kilograms)
metadata.description: Shows annual cocoon output in Chosen (Korea) from 1935 to 1940, split into spring and summer-autumn crops, with the share of mixed varieties.

metadata.title: Filatures Classified by the Number of Basins Operated
metadata.description: Shows the 1938 and 1939 counts of silk filatures grouped by number of basins, with the change between years, to show where the decline in filatures occurred.

metadata.title: Number of Filatures, Basins and Operatives
metadata.caption: (Silk Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry)
metadata.description: Shows the number of silk filatures, filature machines, basins and operatives for 1935 to 1939, illustrating the decline in the silk reeling industry before 1940.

metadata.title: Silk Production
metadata.caption: (Silk Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry)
metadata.description: Gives the total output of silk by volume and value, and its split into white and yellow silk, for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Raw Silk Production and Domestic Consumption
metadata.caption: (In 10 piculs)
metadata.description: Gives raw silk production and domestic consumption by filature and other reeling, white and yellow, for the 1939-40 and 1940-41 seasons and the monthly figures for 1941.

metadata.title: Raw Silk Price at Yokohama Spot Market
metadata.caption: (In yen) (Standard quality; per picul, 133 lbs.)
metadata.description: Monthly and average raw silk prices at the Yokohama spot market from 1926 to 1941, shown to illustrate the price trend described in the preceding text.

metadata.title: Winding Speed
metadata.description: Gives the winding speed to be used for each thread size, from the finest to the coarsest, in the winding test of raw silk.

metadata.title: Value of Fishery Products in 1939
metadata.description: Shows the yen value of each branch of Japan's fishery output in 1939, illustrating the country's leading world position in aquatic products.

metadata.title: Catches in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Compares the 1938 and 1939 yen catches in Japan Proper by fishery type, giving the comparison that the text introduces before the figures.

metadata.title: Number of Persons Engaged in Various Branches of the Fishery Industry
metadata.description: Gives the yearly number of people working in fishing, cultivation and manufacture of aquatic products, showing the trend in the fishery workforce from 1931 to 1939.

metadata.title: Fishery Employers and Employees
metadata.description: Lists the number of fishery employers and employees for 1931 to 1935, showing the employment side of the industry alongside the workforce figures.

metadata.title: [Number of Fishing Boats and Vessels, 1931-1939]
metadata.description: Gives the total number of fishing boats and vessels from 1931 to 1939, divided into those without engines and those with steam or motor engines.

metadata.title: Fishing Boats and Vessels Classified According to Kinds and Capacities
metadata.caption: (At the end of each year)
metadata.description: Classifies fishing boats and vessels by kind (without engines, steam or oil engines) and tonnage for each year from 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: [Coastal Fishery Catches, 1939]
metadata.description: Lists the quantity and value of the major classes of coastal fishery catches in 1939, which the accompanying text gives as totalling 378,431,439 yen.

metadata.title: Yearly Comparison of Catches in Coastal Waters
metadata.caption: (Quantity in Kan, Value in Yen)
metadata.description: Summarises yearly coastal fishery catches from 1935 to 1939 in quantity and value, total and by fish group, introducing the detailed species tables that follow.

metadata.title: Catches of Principal Fish by Kinds
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Gives yearly values in yen of the principal fresh fish caught in coastal waters from 1935 to 1939, by kind, as detailed support for the yearly comparison.

metadata.title: Value of Various Kinds of Shellfish
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value in yen of various shellfish kinds caught in coastal waters from 1935 to 1939, supporting the shellfish figures in the yearly comparison.

metadata.title: Value of Crustaceans and Mollusca
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value in yen of crustacean and mollusc catches, 1935–1939, illustrating the growth of these fisheries.

metadata.title: Values of Various Kinds of Seaweed
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly yen value of several kinds of seaweed harvested from 1935 to 1939, listed under the seaweed heading of the fisheries section.

metadata.title: [Catches of Principal Fish in Home Waters, 1939]
metadata.description: Lists the principal fish caught in home waters in 1939 by quantity in kan and value in yen, as introduced in the text on home-waters pelagic fishing.

metadata.title: Number and Crews of Vessels Engaged in Deep-Sea Fishing in Home Waters
metadata.description: Gives the yearly number, tonnage and crew of deep-sea fishing vessels in home waters from 1935 to 1939, split by whether they had engines.

metadata.title: Value of Deep-Sea Fish Caught in Home Waters
metadata.caption: In Japan Proper (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of deep-sea fish caught in Japanese home waters by species, 1935–1939, illustrating the growth of the pelagic fishery.

metadata.title: Value of Deep-Sea Fish Caught in Outlying Waters
metadata.description: Gives the number of boats and total value of deep-sea catches in the Chosen, Taiwan, Kwantung and South Sea Mandated Islands waters for 1935–1939.

metadata.title: Whales Caught
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Reports the number and value of whales caught in Japanese home waters by year, 1935–1939, as Japanese whaling expanded under government permit.

metadata.title: Whales Caught
metadata.description: Shows the number and value of whales caught in home and colonial waters from 1935 to 1939, by species, illustrating the state of Japan's whaling industry.

metadata.title: Antarctic Whaling
metadata.description: Gives the yearly scale of Japan's Antarctic whaling operations, with mother ships, men, whales caught and estimated values of oil, meat and total output.

metadata.title: Fish Caught by Trawling
metadata.caption: (Quantity in kan, value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the total catch by trawling and the catch of the red sea bream (Pagrus major) by quantity and value over 1936 to 1939, following the text on trawling regulation.

metadata.title: Number of Fisheries, Fishing Vessels, Fishermen, and Products in Soviet Waters
metadata.description: Gives the number of fisheries leased and worked, fishing vessels, fishermen, catches and prepared products in Soviet waters for 1936 to 1939, supporting the text on Russian fishery rights.

metadata.title: [Fishery Products by Species, 1936–1939]
metadata.description: Shows the yearly quantity and value of salmon, trout, canned food, red salmon, crab and other fishery products from 1936 to 1939.

metadata.title: Floating Salmon Canneries in Kamchatka
metadata.description: Gives the number of mother ships, men, catches, canned output and salted, frozen and egg values of the Kamchatka floating salmon canneries, 1935–1939.

metadata.title: Floating Crab Canneries
metadata.description: Shows vessels, fishermen, crab catches and canned crab output of the floating crab canneries from 1935 to 1939, which the adjacent text describes.

metadata.title: No. of Establishments Engaged in Aquiculture, Area and Products
metadata.description: Accompanies the text on aquiculture, giving the yearly number of establishments, the area they covered, and the value of their products from 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Fish, Shell-Fish, Etc., Raised Through Aquiculture
metadata.description: Shows the quantity and value of carp, eel, goldfish, oyster and pearl production raised through aquiculture in each year from 1936 to 1939, following the text on total output.

metadata.title: Manufactured Fishery Products
metadata.caption: (Units: Quantity in kan, value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows yearly totals of manufactured fishery products, split into food products, fertilizers, fish oils and sukifunori, illustrating the growth of processing alongside the discussion of food preservation.

metadata.title: Value of Food Products
metadata.caption: (Unit ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of various processed food fish products, such as fushi, dried, salted, boiled, smoked and saltcured items, for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: [Agar-agar Production]
metadata.description: Gives the number of agar-agar (kanten) establishments and the total quantity and value of production for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Fish Fertilizers
metadata.caption: (Quantity in kan, value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly quantity and value of fish fertilizers produced in total and by type, such as herring cake, sardine cake and dried fish, for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Fish Oils
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the value of fish oils produced for 1935 to 1939 in total and by source, such as sardine, herring, cod, whale and shark oil.

metadata.title: Area of Forests, Bamboo-Groves and Wild Lands in Japan Proper
metadata.description: Shows the area of forests, bamboo-groves and wild lands in Japan proper at successive surveys, by forest type and by ownership, as reported by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

metadata.title: [Growing Timber in Japan Proper by Ownership, 1933]
metadata.caption: (Quantities in 1,000 cu. m.)
metadata.description: Gives the 1933 stock of growing timber in Japan proper by kind of tree and by ownership (Imperial Household, Government, public and private interests), from careful investigations.

metadata.title: Standing Timber in Hokkaido, Taiwan, Chosen and Karafuto in 1933
metadata.caption: (Quantities 1,000 cu. meters)
metadata.description: Shows the standing timber volume by owner and tree type in Hokkaido, Taiwan, Chosen and Karafuto in 1933, supplementing the discussion of forest stock in the other parts of the country.

metadata.title: Total Stand of Timber in Japan in 1933
metadata.caption: (1,000 cu. m.)
metadata.description: Gives the national total of standing timber in Japan in 1933 by owner class and tree type, summarising the regional figures before the discussion of afforestation.

metadata.title: Artificial Afforestation
metadata.caption: (Area in cho)
metadata.description: Shows the annual area and number of trees artificially planted from 1937 to 1939, broken down by coniferous, broad-leaved and Crown areas.

metadata.title: Area of Wood and Bamboo Lands Cleared and Value of Wood and Bamboo Produced
metadata.description: Gives the area of wood and bamboo lands cleared and the total value of wood, fuel wood and bamboo produced from 1936 to 1939.

metadata.title: Value of Other Forest Products
metadata.description: Lists the value of other forest products such as seeds, fruits, mushrooms and charcoal from 1936 to 1939, with the 1939 total of ¥291,869,358.

metadata.title: Protective Forests
metadata.caption: (Area in cho)
metadata.description: The page explains the government's system of protective forests under the Forestry Act and gives the area of such forests for 1936-39, broken down by purpose.

metadata.title: Forestry Co-operative Societies
metadata.caption: (Area in cho)
metadata.description: The table shows the growth of forestry co-operative societies, their operated area and membership from 1935 to 1939, as the text introduces the recent trend.

metadata.title: [Forest Fire Insurance Business, 1937-1939]
metadata.description: The table gives the results of the government forestry fire insurance business since it began in 1937, showing policies, area, amounts insured and premiums received.

metadata.title: Production of Lumber
metadata.caption: Japan Proper (In koku)
metadata.description: Shows annual lumber production in Japan Proper from 1930 to 1939, supporting the statement that output rose steadily since 1930.

metadata.title: Imports of Lumber
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of lumber imports by wood type from 1934 to 1937, illustrating the text's point that imports have generally decreased in recent years.

metadata.title: Exports of Lumber (In ¥1,000)
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Export figures for lumber products by category from 1934 to 1939, shown to illustrate trade in wood goods before the section on forestry in 1941.

metadata.title: [Principal Zinc Mines and Places of Production]
metadata.description: Listing the principal zinc mines and their locations, given as the main places of zinc production in Japan and its colonies.

metadata.title: Numbers of Operatives, Mills, Etc. in Textile Industry in 1938 as Compared with Those in 1937
metadata.description: Introducing the textile chapter, this table compares 1937 and 1938 counts of mills, motorised mills, officials and technicians across textile branches, showing the industry's growth that year.

metadata.title: [Operatives and Workers in Textile Industry, 1937 and 1938]
metadata.description: This table gives the number of male, female and other operatives, and total workers, in each textile branch for 1937 and 1938, drawn from the Factory Statistics.

metadata.title: Business Conditions of Cotton Spinning Companies in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the financial position of cotton spinning companies in Japan Proper by half-year from 1936 to 1940, illustrating the industry's condition as wartime controls tightened.

metadata.title: Spinners' Capital and Equipment
metadata.caption: (In Japan Proper and Chosen)
metadata.description: Shows the capital, reserves, mills, spindles and looms of Japanese cotton spinning companies at mid-year from 1936 to 1940, illustrating the industry's capital and equipment position.

metadata.title: Production, Consumption, Imports and Exports of Cotton Yarns Since 1933
metadata.caption: (In bales)
metadata.description: Gives yearly domestic output, imports, exports, tissue-equivalent exports and domestic consumption of cotton yarn from 1936 to 1939, in bales.

metadata.title: Production of Cotton Yarns in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Reports the number of mills, operatives, and the quantity and value of cotton yarn produced in Japan Proper from 1934 to 1938.

metadata.title: Production of Cotton Tissues in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Gives the number of mills, looms, operatives and value of cotton tissue production in Japan Proper from 1934 to 1938.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Cotton Tissues in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Japan Cotton Spinners' Association)
metadata.description: Shows the annual supply of cotton tissues in Japan Proper, comparing total and spinning-company output with exports and home consumption for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Production of Silk Textiles
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Gives the number of silk mills, looms and operatives, and the quantity and value of broad silk weaves such as crêpes and habutaé, for 1931 to 1938.

metadata.title: [Production of Silk Tissues and Silk-Cotton Mixtures, 1931-1938]
metadata.description: Shows output quantities and values of silk and silk-cotton textiles by type from 1931 to 1938, illustrating the trend of the silk weaving industry before the artificial silk period.

metadata.title: Domestic Demand for Artificial Silk
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Gives production and imports of artificial silk yarns for 1938 and 1939 as the domestic supply side of the artificial silk demand discussed in the text.

metadata.title: [Artificial Silk Demand: Releases, Exports, Stocks and Total Demand]
metadata.description: Shows the released joint-stock quantities, export volumes, stocks, and domestic and total demand for artificial silk in 1938 and 1939, supporting the text on the demand split.

metadata.title: Supply-Demand of Staple Fiber
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Shows the domestic supply and demand for staple fiber in 1938 and 1939, including production, exports by type, and the balance left for domestic use.

metadata.title: Estimated Consumption of Staple Fiber
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Estimates domestic consumption of staple fiber in 1938 and 1939, split between pure staple fiber yarns and yarns mixed with other fibers, based on assumed mixing and home-use shares.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Wood Pulp for Rayon
metadata.caption: (In metric tons)
metadata.description: Gives wood pulp supply (domestic production and imports) and its demand by rayon, staple fiber and cellophane makers for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Imports of Pulp for Fiber by Origin
metadata.caption: Quantity (Unit: picul); Value (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's imports of wood pulp for fiber by supplying country, giving quantities and values for 1936 to 1938.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Woollen Yarn
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 pounds)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's woollen yarn production, imports, exports and domestic balance from 1931 to 1939, illustrating the effect of State control on the industry.

metadata.title: Imports of Raw Wool
metadata.description: Gives the quantity and value of raw wool imported into Japan from 1930 to 1939, showing the scale of dependence on foreign wool for the woollen industry.

metadata.title: Imports of Sheep's Wool by Origin
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's sheep's wool imports by supplying region (Yen-bloc, third countries) for 1936 to 1938, in quantity and value, showing the shift toward other sources.

metadata.title: Woollen Yarn and Textile Manufacturing Facilities
metadata.caption: (At the end of the year)
metadata.description: The table gives year-end figures for woollen factories, machines, operatives and spindles from 1933 to 1938, showing the scale of the woollen industry's facilities.

metadata.title: Production of Woollen Textiles
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: The table shows yearly quantities and values of various woollen textile products, from 1936 onward, with a note on how its figures differ from the Factory Statistics.

metadata.title: Exports of Woollen Textiles by Kind
metadata.description: The table gives export quantities and values of muslin, cloth and serge, and total woollen textiles for 1937 to 1939.

metadata.title: Domestic Production of Hemp
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Kan)
metadata.description: The Government's hemp policy is reflected in these year-by-year figures of domestic hemp output in Japan, Chosen and Taiwan, shown to support the discussion of the industry.

metadata.title: Production of Hemp by Kinds in 1938
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 Kan)
metadata.description: Breaks down the 1938 hemp output by fibre type (flax, hemp, jute, ramie, blue hemp) across the three regions, showing the wartime shift in supply.

metadata.title: Hemp Industrial Plants, Machines and Operatives
metadata.description: Gives the number of hemp industrial plants, machines and operatives for each year from 1929 to 1938, showing the decline of the industry over the decade.

metadata.title: Production of Hemp Tissues
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Shows annual production of hemp tissues by mills, looms, operatives, and by weave type and total value from 1930 to 1938.

metadata.title: Value of Production by Hosieries
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Lists the number of hosiery mills, operatives and value of hosiery products for 1933 to 1938, showing growth in output value.

metadata.title: Earnings of Dyeing and Bleaching Houses
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Gives the number of bleaching and dyeing houses, their operatives and earnings for 1933 to 1938, comparing the two branches of the dyeing trade.

metadata.title: Growth of Number of Operatives in Machinery Industry
metadata.description: The table shows how the number of operatives in the machinery industry grew from 1930 to 1939 compared with all industries, with the ratio between them rising steadily.

metadata.title: Increase in Number of Machinery Factories
metadata.description: The table shows the growth in the number of machinery factories relative to all industrial factories, which the text links to the rapid expansion of machinery companies and capital.

metadata.title: Expansion of Production in Machinery Industry
metadata.caption: 1929-1938 (In millions of yen)
metadata.description: Shows total industrial production and machinery industry output in yen millions for 1930-1939, with machinery's share of total, to illustrate the machinery industry's expansion.

metadata.title: Number of Companies and Amount of Capital in Machinery Industry
metadata.description: Gives the number of machinery companies, their combined authorized and paid-up capital at end of 1939, and new companies and capital established in 1938-1939 by branch.

metadata.title: [Capital Expansion, Increased Capital and Shareholders' Payments of Machinery Companies]
metadata.description: Shows the capital expansion, increased paid-up capital and shareholders' payments of machinery-industry companies by sub-branch in the halves of 1938 and 1939.

metadata.title: Business Results of Major Machinery Manufacturing Companies
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Industrial Bank of Japan)
metadata.description: Gives the number of companies, paid-up capital, and dividend, reserve and profit rates of major machinery manufacturers by half-year from 1937 to 1940.

metadata.title: Manufactures of Aircraft
metadata.description: The table lists how many makers of aircraft bodies and motors and of balloons and airships were operating in Japan each year from 1930 to 1936, illustrating the industry's growth.

metadata.title: Production of Automobiles and Motor Cycles
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: The table gives yearly production of automobiles and motor cycles in Japan from 1930 to 1935, by imported parts assembled, others, accessories and parts, total value and motor cars.

metadata.title: Imports of Automobiles and Accessories
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly number and value of automobiles and accessories imported into Japan from 1930, with 1937 covering only January to July.

metadata.title: Production of Bicycles in Japan
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly number of bicycles produced in Japan, their value, and the value of accessories produced, from 1930 to 1938.

metadata.title: [Imports and Exports of Cycles and Accessories]
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's imports and exports of cycles and bicycle accessories in yen from 1930 to 1939, following the statement that trade has been tracked since 1930.

metadata.title: Production of Vessels
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: The table gives yearly output of steel and other ships by number and value, with total value and fittings, showing the rise and fall of the shipbuilding industry from 1930 to 1938.

metadata.title: Number of Dockyards, Employing More Than 5 Persons and Those Employed
metadata.description: The table shows the number of dockyards employing more than five persons and the staff they employed at each year end, from 1930 to 1937.

metadata.title: Imports of Machinery
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table gives the yen value of Japan's machinery imports by article from 1934 to 1939, showing the overall import trend discussed in the preceding text.

metadata.title: [Exports of Japanese-Made Machinery, 1936–1939]
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists values of machinery exported from Japan by article for 1936–1939, illustrating the rising export trade in Japanese-made machinery discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Electric Power Capacity for Industrial Purposes
metadata.caption: (In kw.)
metadata.description: Shows the installed electric power capacity for industrial purposes, split into hydro-electric, thermal and other sources, at the end of each year from 1930 to 1938.

metadata.title: Total Volume of Electric Power Generated for Lighting and Industrial Purposes
metadata.caption: (In kw. h.)
metadata.description: Gives the total electric power generated for lighting and industrial use each year from 1930 to 1937, with the percentage rate of increase over the previous year.

metadata.title: Growth of Demand for Power for Lighting
metadata.description: Shows the number of electricity consumers and of lamps connected for lighting at the end of each year from 1930 to 1938, indicating growing demand for power.

metadata.title: Electric Lighting in Various Prefectures at the End of 1935
metadata.caption: (Number of lights per 100 persons)
metadata.description: Lists the number of electric lights per 100 persons in each prefecture at the end of 1935, with the national average at the foot, showing regional differences in electrification.

metadata.title: Power Supplying Companies
metadata.description: Shows the number of power supplying companies by year, split into opened and unopened, and by water, steam and purchased power sources, from 1933 to 1939.

metadata.title: Profits of Electric Industry
metadata.caption: (In Yen)
metadata.description: Gives paid-up capital, profit and the rate of profit on paid-up capital for the electric industry from 1929 to 1938.

metadata.title: Consumption of Electric Power by Industries
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 k.w. h.)
metadata.description: Shows electric power consumption by industry group for 1934 to 1938, in thousand kilowatt-hours, with the grand total including other industries.

metadata.title: [Electric Companies Valued at Over ¥10,000,000]
metadata.description: The text explains that the valuation of the 33 existing electric companies exceeded ¥10,000,000 for these twelve firms, which are listed with their assessed values.

metadata.title: Conditions of Gas Producing Companies
metadata.description: Shows the yearly operating conditions of Japan's gas producing companies from 1934 to 1939, covering coal use, output, supply, consumers, lights and byproducts, illustrating the industry's growth.

metadata.title: Business Results
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the business results of gas companies at the end of March 1934 and 1935, including capital, assets, profit and dividend rates, following the statistics of gas producing companies.

metadata.title: Consumption of Gas by Industries
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 cubic meters)
metadata.description: Shows the gas consumption of each major industry in 1937 and 1938, compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, to illustrate the growth of industrial gas demand.

metadata.title: Distribution of Gas in Japan
metadata.description: Shows gas supply, consumers, and per-day and per-house consumption in Japan from 1930 to 1939, split into six major cities (A) and other areas (B), illustrating growth in the gas industry.

metadata.title: Gas Enterprises by Prefectures (1939)
metadata.description: Lists the number of gas companies, gas tanks, gas supply and consuming houses for eleven prefectures in 1939, showing where the gas enterprise was concentrated.

metadata.title: Gas Production by Kind
metadata.caption: (In million cubic meters)
metadata.description: Shows gas production by kind for 1938 and 1939 with the increase between the two years, in million cubic meters.

metadata.title: [Waterworks Sanctioned and in Operation by Established-By Category (Cities, Towns and Villages)]
metadata.description: Summarises the number of waterworks sanctioned and in operation, broken down by the bodies that established them (cities, towns and villages, associations).

metadata.title: [Waterworks Sanctioned and in Operation by Established-By Category (Prefecture, Private Persons)]
metadata.description: Shows the waterworks sanctioned and in operation established by prefectures and private persons, with the overall total.

metadata.title: Number of Waterworks in Operation by Districts
metadata.caption: (March 1938)
metadata.description: Lists, for each prefecture, the number of operating waterworks by who established them and the district total, as of March 1938.

metadata.title: Number of Households Supplied
metadata.description: Lists, by prefecture and in total, the number of households supplied with waterworks water and the share per 100 households, as of 1935.

metadata.title: Number of Hydrants and Volume of Water Supplied
metadata.description: Gives yearly figures for the number of waterworks, private supply, hydrants with and without meters, and fire-hydrants from 1934 to 1937.

metadata.title: [Public Water Supply Statistics, 1934-1937]
metadata.description: Shows the number of district water meters, total figure, and volume of water supplied for 1934 to 1937, illustrating growth in the public water utility.

metadata.title: Production and Sale of Foreign Style Papers in the Past Five Years
metadata.caption: (9 member companies of the Japan Paper Manufacturers' Association) (Unit: 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Shows annual production and sale of foreign style printing, daily press and other papers by nine member companies, illustrating the decline in daily press paper and the rise in book printing paper.

metadata.title: Production of Paper Since 1930
metadata.caption: (Factory Statistics by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry) (Quantity in 1,000 kg. and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives factory output quantities and values of various paper grades from 1934 to 1938, showing the growth of paper production under the Ministry's factory statistics.

metadata.title: Consumption of Foreign-Style Paper
metadata.caption: (Statistics of the Japan Paper Manufacturers' Association). (Quantity in 1,000 lbs.)
metadata.description: Shows annual production, imports, exports, consumption and per-capita consumption of foreign-style paper in Japan, 1934–1940, illustrating the trade balance of the paper market.

metadata.title: Production of Cellophane
metadata.description: Gives the quantity and value of cellophane production in Japan from 1931 to 1938, split across two side-by-side blocks of years.

metadata.title: Production of Hand-Made Japanese-Style Paper, 1940
metadata.description: Lists the quantity and value of hand-made Japanese-style paper by item type for 1940, supporting the text on the hand-made paper industry.

metadata.title: Production of Pulp
metadata.caption: (Forest Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry); (In tons)
metadata.description: The table gives the annual output of pulp in Japan and Manchoukuo, with totals, for 1934 to 1939.

metadata.title: Imports of Pulp
metadata.caption: Quantity (in ton); Value (in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table shows Japan's pulp imports by country of origin, giving quantities in tons and values in thousand yen for 1936 to 1939.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Pulp for Paper
metadata.caption: (Forest Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry); (Unit in ton)
metadata.description: The table sets out pulp production, imports and consumption for paper manufacture in Japan for each year from 1932 to 1939.

metadata.title: Production of Superphosphates
metadata.caption: (In metric ton)
metadata.description: Shows annual superphosphate of lime production from 1930 to 1939, supporting the text's account of steadily rising output and the 1939 record.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Superphosphate in Recent Years
metadata.description: Gives the supply and demand position of superphosphate for 1930–1939, showing production, exports and re-exports, and consumption in Japan Proper.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Ammonium Sulphate in Japan
metadata.description: Presents the supply and demand of ammonium sulphate in Japan for 1935–1939, covering domestic production, imports, exports and consumption.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Lime Nitrogen
metadata.caption: (In metric ton)
metadata.description: Shows annual quantity of lime nitrogen produced and consumed in Japan from 1934 to 1939, illustrating the synthetic nitrogen fertilizer supply discussed in the chemical fertilizer section.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Bean Cake
metadata.caption: (In metric ton)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly supply and demand of bean cake, a vegetable fertilizer, covering domestic production, imports, exports and consumption in Japan Proper for 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Value of Fertilizers Produced in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Fertilizers which require a licence for production) (Unit ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the value of licensed fertilizers produced in Japan Proper by type, from 1935 to 1939, to indicate the growth of domestic fertilizer manufacture.

metadata.title: Consumption of Fertilizers in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Summarizes the consumption of fertilizers in Japan Proper from 1935 to 1938 by source, separating licensed, unlicensed, market-sold and self-supplied fertilizers.

metadata.title: Production and Imports of Soda Ash
metadata.caption: (In metric ton)
metadata.description: Shows domestic soda ash production and imports from 1934 to 1939, illustrating how home output grew and displaced foreign supply during the industry's development.

metadata.title: Production, Imports and Exports of Caustic Soda
metadata.caption: (In metric ton)
metadata.description: Gives caustic soda production, exports, imports and resulting domestic supply for 1935 to 1939, showing the commodity's market balance as the industry expanded.

metadata.title: Production and Exports of Bleaching Powder
metadata.caption: (In metric tons)
metadata.description: Records bleaching powder production, exports and supply for 1934 to 1939, the chemical whose demand the paper-manufacturing sector drove.

metadata.title: Production of Soap by Kind
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows annual soap output in Japan from 1934 to 1938 broken down by type, illustrating growth of the soap industry in the chemical section.

metadata.title: Production of Vegetable Oils
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Lists annual Japanese production of the principal vegetable oils in yen, 1934 to 1938, as compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, presented as the statistics for the vegetable and animal oil industry.

metadata.title: Production of Animal Oils and Tallow
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of animal oils and tallow produced in Japan by type, 1934 to 1938, with totals.

metadata.title: Production of Vegetable Wax, Candles, and Manufactures of Oils
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly value of vegetable wax, candles, boiled and hardened oils, and other oil manufactures produced in Japan from 1934 to 1938.

metadata.title: Imports of Vegetable and Animal Oils, Tallows and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Records the yearly value of Japanese imports of vegetable and animal oils, tallows and their manufactures from 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Exports of Vegetable and Animal Oils, Wax, and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of Japanese exports of vegetable and animal oils, wax and their manufactures from 1935 to 1939.

metadata.title: Production of Rubber Manufactures in Japan
metadata.caption: Soft Rubber Manufactures (Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table gives the yearly value and footwear pairs of soft rubber goods produced in Japan, illustrating growth of the rubber industry after the 1923 earthquake.

metadata.title: Production of Rubber Manufactures in Japan
metadata.caption: Soft and Hard Rubber Manufactures
metadata.description: This continuation of the production table shows belts, pipes, other soft goods, hard rubber manufactures and grand totals for each year from 1934 to 1938.

metadata.title: Imports of Raw Rubber and Exports of Principal Rubber Manufactures
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: The table sets out Japan's imports of raw rubber and exports of its main rubber goods (boots and shoes, tyres, toys, belts and hoses) in yen for 1934 to 1939.

metadata.title: Production of Celluloid and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.description: Gives the yearly output of raw celluloid by quantity and value, and the value of celluloid manufactures from 1934 to 1938, illustrating the industry's growth.

metadata.title: Exports of Raw Celluloid and Manufactures Thereof
metadata.description: Shows annual exports of raw celluloid and celluloid manufactures (toys, combs, armlets, others) from 1934 through the first nine months of 1940.

metadata.title: Imports of Dyestuffs
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's dyestuff imports by colour type for 1937-1939, illustrating the declining trend in imports discussed in the accompanying text.

metadata.title: Production of Synthetic Dyestuffs
metadata.description: Gives annual output of basic, direct, acid and mordant dyestuffs in Japan from 1934 to 1938, by quantity and value, showing the growth of the domestic industry.

metadata.title: Production of Synthetic Dyestuffs
metadata.description: Continues the annual production figures for sulphide, artificial indigo, vat colours and other dyestuffs, with the combined value of all dyestuffs for 1934-1938.

metadata.title: Production of Aniline and Intermediates
metadata.description: Lists Japan's aniline output in quantity and value from 1934 to 1939, with an estimate for 1939, alongside totals for other intermediates.

metadata.title: Exports of Synthetic Dyestuffs
metadata.description: Shows the quantity and value of synthetic dyestuffs exported from Japan from 1934 to 1939, reflecting the growth of overseas sales.

metadata.title: Production of Indigo Balls
metadata.description: Shows annual output of coarse indigo and indigo balls, in quantity and value, from 1933 to 1938, as part of the dyestuffs review.

metadata.title: Production and Exports of Pyrethrum
metadata.caption: (Quantity in metric ton; value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives pyrethrum production and exports by quantity and value for 1934 to 1939, shown to illustrate the growing pyrethrum trade noted in the text.

metadata.title: Value of Production of Chemical Industry
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists the value of output of individual industrial and chemical products for 1936 to 1938, showing the scale of Japan's chemical industry.

metadata.title: [Production of Chemical Industry Products, 1936-1938]
metadata.description: Gives production figures for 1936-1938 across many chemical, pharmaceutical, paint, soap, explosives and related industrial products, with a grand total for the chemical industry.

metadata.title: Production of Domestic Wheat and Its Acreage
metadata.description: Domestic wheat output and planted acreage for 1936–1941, shown to illustrate how Government measures raised home production to reduce Japan's heavy annual wheat imports.

metadata.title: Quantities of Wheat Imported
metadata.caption: (Quantities in piculs)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's wheat imports by supplying country for 1935–1939, with totals and value, documenting the sources and scale of the wheat trade.

metadata.title: Exports of Wheat Flour
metadata.caption: (Quantities in piculs)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's wheat flour exports by destination, mainly Manchoukuo, China and Kwantung, for 1935–1939, with total value.

metadata.title: Flour Production, Consumption, Etc.
metadata.caption: (In bags)
metadata.description: Gives Japan's flour production, imports, exports and home consumption in bags for 1935–1939, with a note on bag weight and data source.

metadata.title: Production of Sugar
metadata.caption: (Unit: 1,000 piculs)
metadata.description: Shows annual sugar output by region in Japan, Taiwan and the South Sea Islands, illustrating the growth of Taiwan's sugar industry described in the text.

metadata.title: Exports of Refined Sugar by Destination
metadata.caption: (In piculs)
metadata.description: Lists refined sugar exports from Japan by destination (China, Manchoukuo, Kwantung) for 1931 to 1940, showing the trade flows to the Asian continent.

metadata.title: Imports of Refined Sugar by Origins
metadata.caption: (In piculs)
metadata.description: Shows refined sugar imports into Japan by origin, chiefly from Java, with totals including other sources, for 1931 to 1940.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Sugar in Japan Proper
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Taiwan Government-General) (In 1,000 piculs)
metadata.description: Compares sugar production in Japan proper with imports from foreign countries over 1933 to 1938, showing the supply side of the domestic market.

metadata.title: [Sugar Imports, Exports and Consumption]
metadata.caption: (Unit: kin)
metadata.description: Gives sugar imports, exports and consumption figures for 1933 to 1938, with per capita consumption, as part of the miscellaneous industries survey.

metadata.title: [Beer Production by Breweries, 1935–1941]
metadata.description: Shows the number of breweries, beer production in koku and value for 1935 to 1941, illustrating the growth and later curtailment of the beer industry.

metadata.title: Exports of Beer
metadata.caption: (Quantity in koku and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows beer export quantities and values by destination country and region for 1936 to 1939, with totals.

metadata.title: Production of Sake by Kinds
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 koku)
metadata.description: Shows annual sake production by kind over eight seasons, illustrating how refined sake dominated output while the total brewing volume varied.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Sake
metadata.caption: (Sake Brewers' Association figures) (In koku)
metadata.description: Gives the Sake Brewers' Association figures for sake produced, shipped and held in stock each year, showing the supply side of the refined sake trade.

metadata.title: Production of Wine
metadata.description: Lists the annual number of wineries and wine production in koku for recent years, as the text introduces the wine figures.

metadata.title: Value of Production of All Kinds of Spirits
metadata.description: Reports the total yen value of all spirits produced from 1934 to 1938, based on the Factory Statistics of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

metadata.title: Value of Production of Soy, Miso, Etc.
metadata.caption: (Unit: ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows the yearly value of production of soy, miso, vinegar, saké-lees and sauce and ketchup, illustrating growth in these fermented-food industries from 1933 to 1938.

metadata.title: Value of Production of Soft Drinks
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: Gives the yearly value of soft drink production by type (cider, ramune, syrup, others) and total, from 1931 to 1938, following the discussion of the soft drink industry.

metadata.title: Production of Canned Provisions
metadata.caption: (Compiled by The Canned Foods Association of Japan)
metadata.description: Shows annual production quantities and values of canned meat, fish, fruit and vegetable products in Japan for 1936–1938, illustrating the growth of the canning industry.

metadata.title: Exports of Canned Provisions
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Finance); (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the export value of canned meats, crabs, and salmon and trout from Japan for 1936–1939, showing the foreign trade side of the canned provisions industry.

metadata.title: [Exports of Canned Foods]
metadata.description: The table gives the export figures for fish and other canned foods for 1936 to 1939, continuing from the previous page, with a note on export destinations and imports.

metadata.title: Value of Production of Bread and Sweetmeat
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: The table shows the yearly value of factory-made confectionery, bread and mizu-amé production from 1934 to 1938, part of the survey of important manufactured foodstuffs.

metadata.title: Value of Milk Products
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: The table gives the factory value of condensed milk, butter and total milk products for 1934 to 1938, alongside the bread and sweetmeat figures.

metadata.title: Value of Production of Artificial Butter, Etc.
metadata.caption: (In yen)
metadata.description: The table lists the yearly values of ham and bacon, artificial butter, salt, vermicelli and starch produced in factories from 1934 to 1938.

metadata.title: Production of Tea
metadata.caption: (Quantity in metric ton, Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: The table gives tea production by grade and type from 1934 to 1938, drawn from factory statistics for tea makers with more than five operatives.

metadata.title: Value of Total Output of the Foodstuffs Manufacturing Industry
metadata.description: Gives the value of total foodstuffs manufacturing output in yen for each year from 1930 to 1939, with a note on canned food figures.

metadata.title: Production of Cement
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: Shows the 1931 cement production by Portland and other cement, in barrels and yen, with the total value of output.

metadata.title: Consumption of Cement Classified by Uses
metadata.caption: (In 1,000 metric tons)
metadata.description: Breaks down domestic cement consumption by end use, such as railways, buildings and mining, for 1937 to 1939.

metadata.title: Exports of Cement
metadata.caption: (Quantity in metric tons and value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists cement exports by destination, giving quantity and value for each year from 1936 to 1939.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Cement
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Cement Manufacturers' Association) (In metric tons)
metadata.description: Gives cement production capacity, clinker output and shipments to Japan Proper for 1934 to 1939, compiled by the manufacturers' association.

metadata.title: [Association Member Companies: Exports, Contracts and Stocks, 1934-1939]
metadata.description: The table gives exports and contract and stock figures for the member companies of the ceramics association from 1934 to 1939, showing the industry's recent trade position.

metadata.title: Factories and Production of Ceramics
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry)
metadata.description: This table shows how the ceramics industry developed from 1931 to 1938, giving factories, operatives and production values by product, as the text introduces it.

metadata.title: Factories and Production of Tiles and Drainage Pipes
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows the number of factories, operatives and production values of roof tiles, other tiles and drainage pipes in Japan for 1931 to 1938, illustrating the trend in the industry discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Exports of Chinaware to Different Countries
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of Japanese chinaware exports by destination country from 1933 to 1939, showing the growth in exports that the preceding text describes.

metadata.title: Supply and Demand of Sheet Glass
metadata.caption: (Unit: Case which contains 100 sq. feet of sheet glass)
metadata.description: Shows annual sheet glass production, imports, exports and domestic consumption from 1930 to 1939, accompanying the account of the Asahi Glass Co. and other sheet glass makers.

metadata.title: Production of Glass and Glassware
metadata.caption: (Compiled by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry) (Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Gives the value of glass and glassware production by product type, including tableware, decorative and illuminating goods and bottles, for 1930 to 1938.

metadata.title: [Glass Production]
metadata.caption: (Quantity in 1,000; Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's annual glass production by sheet thickness, other glass types and looking glasses, with total value, for 1930 to 1938.

metadata.title: Exports of Glass and Glassware
metadata.caption: (Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's exports of glass and glassware by kind, giving quantity and value for 1937 to 1939.

metadata.title: Imports of Glass
metadata.caption: (Value in ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Lists Japan's imports of glass by kind, with quantity and value for 1937 to 1939.

metadata.title: Exports of Matches
metadata.caption: (Value in yen)
metadata.description: Shows Japan's match exports by destination for 1938 and 1939, with totals in value and gross quantity, illustrating the export trade discussed in the text.

metadata.title: Production of Matches, Etc.
metadata.description: Gives annual match production for 1930 to 1938 by gross quantity and value, with separate values for match-boxes and matchwood, showing the industry's recent growth.

metadata.title: Factories and Production of Lacquer-Ware

metadata.title: Production of Tobacco

metadata.description: Shows the Monopoly Bureau's tobacco production by product type for 1936 to 1938, introduced as the recent trade and production of various tobacco kinds.

metadata.title: Sales of Tobacco Products in Japan
metadata.caption: (In ¥1,000)
metadata.description: Annual sales figures for tobacco products in Japan from 1929 to 1941, showing the trend in this monopoly-related trade over the period.

metadata.title: Production of Metallic Industry
metadata.caption: Value in ¥1,000
metadata.description: Values of output in the metallic industry, covering metal refining, casting, and metal wares, for 1936 to 1938, as part of the production figures for other industries.

metadata.title: [Production of Razors, Cutlery, Toys and Plated Articles]

metadata.title: Production of Bricks and Other Fire-Proof Articles

metadata.description: Value of brick and other fire-proof article production in Japan for 1936 to 1938.

metadata.title: Production of the Kiln Industry
metadata.caption: (Not mentioned elsewhere) Value in ¥1,000
metadata.description: Value of kiln-industry output not covered elsewhere, including cement manufactures, lime and enamelled ironwares, for 1936 to 1938.

metadata.title: Production of Wood-Works
metadata.caption: Value in ¥1,000
metadata.description: Value of wood-works production with number of houses and operatives engaged in the industry, for 1936 to 1938.

metadata.title: Earnings of Printing Houses
metadata.caption: Amount in ¥1,000
metadata.description: Gives the yearly amount earned by printing houses from 1936 to 1938, showing the trend in this trade within the miscellaneous industries.

metadata.title: Production of Miscellaneous Industries (Not Mentioned Elsewhere)

metadata.title: Earnings by Workers in Finishing, Mending, Etc.

metadata.title: [Number of Post Offices, 1871–1882]

metadata.title: [Number of Post Offices in Japan Proper, 1931–1940]
metadata.description: Gives the continued increase in the number of post offices in Japan proper for each year from 1931 to 1940, as postal business expanded.
