metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by sex and by penalty (penal servitude for life or for a term by length, imprisonment and others), separately for Japanese and islanders, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 入監及出監者
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons admitted to and discharged from prison, with discharges of convicts by reason (expiry of sentence, death, parole and others), separately for Japanese and islanders, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 入監新受刑者年齡別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by sex and by age group, separately for Japanese and islanders, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 入監新受刑者罪名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by sex and by Criminal Code offence and special-law offences, separately for Japanese and islanders, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: サイパン實業學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of classes by school year, teachers (regular and part-time), students and graduates of the Saipan Vocational School, as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937.
metadata.caption: (每年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 小學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of teachers (regular and part-time), classes in the ordinary and higher courses, and pupils by sex at the primary schools for Japanese children, as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by school.
metadata.caption: (每年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 公學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of teachers (Japanese and islander), classes in the regular and supplementary courses, and pupils by sex at the public schools (kōgakkō) for island children, as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by school.
metadata.caption: (每年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 小學校卒業生
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of graduates of the ordinary and higher courses of the primary schools by sex, by school year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by school.
metadata.caption: (每學年)

metadata.title: 公學校卒業生
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of graduates of the regular and supplementary courses of the public schools for islanders by sex, by school year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by school.
metadata.caption: (每學年)

metadata.title: 木工徒弟養成所
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of classes, staff (full-time and part-time instructors and assistants), students in the regular and other courses, and graduates, by year from 1933 to 1937.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在但シ卒業生ハ毎學年)

metadata.title: 公學校寄宿舍寄宿兒童
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of island children boarding at the dormitories of the Yap, Koror, Natsushima (Dublon, Truk), Kolonia (Ponape), Jabor (Jaluit), Wotje and other public schools, as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 幼稚園
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of kindergartens, nursery teachers and assistants, and children by sex, as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 島民內地在留者
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of islanders staying in Japan proper by sex, by purpose (study at primary, secondary and other schools, and others), as of 1 March, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office of origin.
metadata.caption: (毎年三月一日現在) — title split across the gutter: 島民內地 (p. 90) / 在留者 (p. 91); 留學者 is the printed heading over the 小學校, 中等學校, 大學 and 宗教學校 columns

metadata.title: 基督敎
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Catholic and Protestant churches and preaching stations, missionaries, brothers, nuns and islander catechists or preachers, and adherents (Japanese, foreigners and islanders), as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在) — title split across the gutter: 基督 (p. 90) / 敎 (p. 91); the heading 舊 ... 敎 (舊敎) stands over the p. 90 columns and 新 ... 敎 (新敎) over the p. 91 columns

metadata.title: 佛敎
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Buddhist mission stations, missionaries and adherents (Japanese, foreigners and islanders), as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 宗敎學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Buddhist, Catholic and Protestant schools, their pupils by sex and their teachers (Japanese, foreigners and islanders), as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在) — title split across the gutter: 宗敎 (p. 92) / 學校 (p. 93)

metadata.title: 布敎者國籍別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of missionaries by religion and nationality (Spanish and Colombian Catholics; Japanese, German, Swiss and American Protestants; and others), as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 天理敎
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Tenrikyō mission stations, teachers and adherents (Japanese, foreigners and islanders), as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 農耕地面積
metadata.description_en: Gives the area of cultivated land (paddy and upland fields) at year end and of land newly brought under cultivation during the year, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年末現在)

metadata.title: 農產物作付面積
metadata.description_en: Gives the area planted to rice, millets, maize, soya beans, red beans, groundnuts and other crops, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年中) — title split across the gutter: 農產物 (p. 94) / 作付面積 (p. 95). 單位 ヘクター (printed under the table on p. 94). The table is printed as two stacked bands across the spread; each band has its own column set (parts 上段 and 下段), each with the label column at the left of p. 94 and repeated at the right edge of p. 95.

metadata.title: 農產物實收穫面積
metadata.description_en: Gives the area actually harvested of rice, millets, maize, soya beans, red beans, groundnuts and other crops, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年中) — title split across the gutter: 農產物實 (p. 94) / 收穫面積 (p. 95). 單位 ヘクター (printed under the table on p. 94). Printed as two stacked bands across the spread (parts 上段 and 下段), each with the label column at the left of p. 94 and repeated at the right edge of p. 95.

metadata.title: 農產物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of agricultural products (rice, millets, maize, beans, sweet potatoes, taro, tapioca, vegetables, fruits, sugar cane, coffee, cacao and others), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中) 單位 數量ハ瓩 價額ハ圓

metadata.title: 農產物ヘクター當收穫高
metadata.title_en: Yield per Hectare of Agricultural Crops
metadata.description_en: Gives the yield per hectare of rice, millets, maize, soya beans, red beans, groundnuts and other crops, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 肥料消費
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of commercial fertilizers consumed (superphosphate of lime, compound fertilizers, ammonium sulphate, bone meal and others) and the quantity of farm-produced fertilizers used, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 肥料生產
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity of farm-produced fertilizers (stable manure, compost, night soil, plant ash and green manures such as groundnut haulm, Tephrosia and Crotalaria), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 家畜家禽
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cattle, horses, goats, pigs, other livestock and poultry at year end, by sex and age (adult or young), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 家畜年齡別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cattle, horses, pigs, sheep and other livestock at year end by age and by sex (female, male, castrated), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 家畜家禽斃死
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cattle, horses, goats, pigs, other livestock and poultry that died during the year, by sex and young, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 家畜家禽生產
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cattle, horses, water buffalo, goats, pigs, other livestock and poultry born or hatched during the year by sex, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 屠畜
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cattle, horses, water buffalo, goats, rabbits and pigs slaughtered and the quantity of meat obtained, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 畜產物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of milk, hens' eggs, duck eggs and other livestock products, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 甘蔗收穫面積、收穫高、產糖高
metadata.title_en: Sugar Cane Harvested Area, Cane Harvest and Sugar Output
metadata.description_en: Gives the harvested area, the cane harvest, sugar output by grade, extraction rate, cane yield per hectare and molasses, by crushing season from 1933-34 to 1937-38, with the 1937-38 figures by island.
metadata.caption: (每年期中)

metadata.title: 勞銀
metadata.description_en: Gives the daily wages of carpenters, ship carpenters, sawyers, joiners and other trades, for Japanese and islanders, at year end by year from 1933 to 1937, by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 日用品小賣價格
metadata.description_en: Gives the retail prices in yen of principal daily necessities, with their brand and unit, as of 16 December each year from 1933 to 1937, by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年十二月十六日現在) — 單位 圓

metadata.title: 料金
metadata.description_en: Gives charges for haircuts and shaves, monthly board and lodging and daily hotel rates (highest, ordinary and lowest) and other services, at year end by year from 1933 to 1937, by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在) — 單位 圓

metadata.title: 會社
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of companies and their nominal and paid-up capital, by line of business (agriculture and forestry, commerce and others), at year end by year from 1933 to 1937, with companies having their head office in the South Seas shown separately.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 酒類製造
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity in litres of alcoholic beverages produced by kind (shōchū, sugar spirit, whisky, wine, sake and others, with their alcohol strength), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 工產物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of industrial products (sugar, molasses, alcohol and others), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 椰子林
metadata.description_en: Gives the area of coconut plantations and the number of trees standing and bearing, government-owned and private, at year end by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 椰子類生產
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and value of coconuts produced from government-owned and private trees, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 林產物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of timber by species (tamana, ukal and others), firewood, charcoal and other forest products, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 漁業許可件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of fishing licences in force at year end by kind (bonito, tuna long-line, pearl-shell, trochus, green-snail, hawksbill turtle and other fishing), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 漁船
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of fishing boats at year end, without engines by tonnage class and with steam or motor engines by tonnage class, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 水產漁獲物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of fish (bonito, tuna and others), shellfish, turtles and other marine products caught, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 水產製造物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity and value of dried bonito (katsuobushi), dried tuna, tinned fish and other processed marine products, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 鑛產物
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity in tons and the value of phosphate and bauxite produced in fiscal 1937, in total and by mine.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 產業獎勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of subsidies granted for the sugar industry, livestock, agriculture, coffee growing, pineapple growing, vegetable growing and other industries, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 糖業獎勵金及下付面積
metadata.title_en: Sugar Industry Subsidies and Areas Subsidised
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of sugar industry subsidies and the area subsidised for new planting, land clearance, cane nurseries and other purposes in fiscal 1937, in total and for Japanese and islanders.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 畜產獎勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of livestock subsidies, Japanese and islanders, by purpose (keep of breeding sires, purchase of breeding stock and others), in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 畜產獎勵金下付牛豚、畜舍棟數
metadata.title_en: Cattle, Pigs and Livestock Sheds Covered by Livestock Subsidies
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of breeding bulls and boars kept, breeding stock purchased and livestock sheds built with subsidies, Japanese and islanders, in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 農產獎勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of agricultural subsidies, Japanese and islanders, by purpose (application of compost, construction of manure pits and others), in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 特殊農作物奬勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of subsidies for land clearance and new planting of coffee, cassava, pineapple and other special crops in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 特殊農作物奬勵金下付面積
metadata.description_en: Gives the area cleared and newly planted with subsidies for coffee, cassava, pineapple and other special crops in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 蔬菜栽培奬勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of vegetable-growing subsidies and the quantities subsidised, Japanese and islanders, in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 奬勵金下付ノ椰子林面積及コプラ乾燥場
metadata.title_en: Subsidised Coconut Plantation Area and Copra Driers
metadata.description_en: Gives the area of coconut plantations improved and the number and floor area of sun and fire copra drying sheds built with subsidies, Japanese and islanders, in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 椰子栽培奬勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of subsidies for coconut planting, Japanese and islanders, by purpose (improvement of plantations, copra driers and others), in fiscal 1937, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 水產奬勵金及漁業經營費低減施設補助
metadata.title_en: Fisheries Subsidies and Grants for Reducing Fishing Costs
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of fisheries subsidies and grants for facilities to reduce fishing costs (slipways, cannery and fertilizer works, survey vessels and others) in fiscal 1937, in total, for the head office and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 商工奬勵金
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of commerce and industry subsidies by purpose (operating costs, vegetable markets, transport vessels, refrigeration, inns and others) in fiscal 1937, in total, for the head office and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度)

metadata.title: 道路延長
metadata.description_en: Gives the length of roads in metres at year end by width (under four metres, under seven metres, seven metres and over), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 諸車
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of bicycles, carriages, rickshaws, ox and horse carts, handcarts and other vehicles at year end, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 南洋廳命令航路
metadata.title_en: Shipping Routes under South Seas Government Contract
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and gross tonnage of ships used, voyages made, total nautical miles sailed and cargo carried on the subsidised routes of the Nippon Yūsen Kaisha and the Nan'yō Bōeki Kaisha, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by line.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 船
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and tonnage of steamers, motor vessels, steam and motor launches and sailing vessels at year end, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 船舶入出隻數及總噸數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and gross tonnage of steamers and sailing vessels entering and leaving port, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 汽船乘降人員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of steamer passengers embarking and landing by sex, split between Japanese, foreigners and islanders, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 船舶入出純噸數
metadata.title_en: Net Tonnage of Vessels Entered and Cleared
metadata.description_en: Gives the net tonnage of steamers and sailing vessels entering and leaving port, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 汽船乘降人員出發地及行先地別
metadata.title_en: Steamer Passengers by Origin and Destination
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of passengers embarking by destination and landing by place of departure (Japan proper, within the islands and elsewhere), by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 郵便物
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of ordinary and special letters and of parcels posted and delivered, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 電報
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of domestic and foreign telegrams sent and received and of relayed messages, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 電話
metadata.description_en: Gives the length of telephone lines, circuits and wires (cable and open wire), and the number of subscribers and instruments, at fiscal year end from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (每年度末現在)

metadata.title: 私設電話
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of private telephone installations and instruments, for government and private use, at fiscal year end from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度末現在)

metadata.title: 島民通信事業利用狀況
metadata.title_en: Use of Postal and Telegraph Services by Islanders
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of letters and parcels posted and delivered, telegrams sent and received, and other postal services used by islanders, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 簡易保險
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of policies and sums insured for new contracts, revivals, deaths, maturities and lapses or cancellations, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 電氣
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of generators and their prime movers (heavy-oil, light-oil and steam engines) and the number of electric lamps by wattage, at fiscal year end from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度末現在)

metadata.title: 無盡講
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of mujin (rotating credit) associations, members and instalments due over their term at year end, and instalments paid and sums drawn during the year, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 產業組合組織別
metadata.title_en: Industrial Cooperatives by Form of Liability
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of industrial cooperatives, their members, shares and total subscribed capital, by form of liability (limited and others), at fiscal year end from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度末現在)

metadata.title: 產業組合目的別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of industrial cooperatives, their members, shares and total subscribed capital, by purpose (credit and others), at year end from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 爲替貯金年金恩給
metadata.title_en: Money Orders, Postal Savings, Annuities and Pensions
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and amount of domestic and foreign money orders issued and paid, postal savings deposits and withdrawals, and annuities and pensions paid, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.title: 輸出品名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the value of exports to foreign countries by commodity group and item, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 輸入品名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the value of imports from foreign countries by commodity group and item, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 移出品名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the value of shipments to Japan proper and other parts of the Empire by commodity group and item, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (毎年中) 單位 圓 (總數の行に「円」と印刷)。右頁は港別 (昭和十二年)

metadata.title: 移入品名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the value of shipments received from Japan proper and other parts of the Empire by commodity group and item, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (毎年中) 單位 圓 (總數の行に「円」と印刷)。右頁は港別 (昭和十二年)

metadata.title: 酒類輸出入
metadata.title_en: Exports and Imports of Alcoholic Beverages
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity of sake, beer, shōchū, mirin, wine, whisky and other liquors exported and imported, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (毎年中)

metadata.title: 酒類移出
metadata.title_en: Shipments of Alcoholic Beverages to Japan
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity of sake, shōchū, sugar spirit, whisky, beer and wine shipped to Japan proper, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (毎年中)

metadata.title: 酒類移入
metadata.title_en: Shipments of Alcoholic Beverages from Japan
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity of sake, shōchū, mirin, shirozake, beer, wine, whisky, brandy and other liquors received from Japan proper, with their alcohol strength, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by port.
metadata.caption: (毎年中) 左頁に總數から ウキスキー まで、右頁に ブランデー から 其ノ他 まで。右頁の右端に年・港の別を繰り返して印刷。各酒類名の下の百分率 (16% 等) は見出しに印刷

metadata.caption: (毎年度中) 豫算は左頁 (年次は左端)、決算は右頁 (年次は右端)。「円」と各欄上端に印刷。金額は小數三位まで印刷

metadata.title: 南洋廳特別會計歲計決算
metadata.title_en: South Seas Government Special Account: Settled Accounts by Item
metadata.description_en: Gives the settled revenue (taxes such as the poll tax, government undertakings, property and other receipts) and expenditure of the South Seas Government special account by item, ordinary and extraordinary, for fiscal 1937.
metadata.caption: (昭和十二年度) 單位 圓 (最初の行に「円」と印刷)。科目の階層 (字下げ) は省略し、印刷順に全行を掲げる。

metadata.title: 非島民人頭稅
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of non-islanders assessed and the amount of poll tax by tax class (first class 50 yen, second class 40 yen, third class 30 yen and lower), by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中) 單位 圓 (最初の行に「円」と印刷)。左頁 年次・總數〜五等、右頁 六等〜十一等 (右端に年・支廳別が繰返し印刷)

metadata.title: 島民人頭稅
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of islanders assessed, the quantity of copra delivered in kind and the amount of poll tax by rate (40, 25 yen and lower), by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中) 單位 圓 (最初の行に「円」と印刷)。左頁 年次〜七圓の人員、右頁 七圓の稅額〜物納コプラ (右端に年・支廳別が繰返し印刷)

metadata.title: 出港稅
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity shipped out and the duty collected on sugar, molasses, alcohol and other dutiable goods, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中) 單位 圓・斤・石 (各欄上端の單位表示による)

metadata.title: 關稅
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of payers and the amount of customs duties collected, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中) 單位 圓 (最初の行に「円」と印刷)

metadata.title: 鑛區稅
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of payers and the amount of mining area tax collected, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度中) 單位 圓 (最初の行に「円」と印刷)。欄見出しは二つの欄に跨がる二字 (鑛區か、判讀不能) の下に人員 / 稅額

metadata.title: 郵便電信及電話收入
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts from postage, postage stamps, telegraphs and telephones, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 醫院收入
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts of the government hospitals, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by hospital.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 林業收入
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts from sales of copra from government plantations and miscellaneous forestry receipts, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 官有物貸下料
metadata.description_en: Gives the rents received for government land, buildings and goods leased, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 電燈收入
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts from electric lighting, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 印紙收入
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts from sales of revenue stamps, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by post office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 免許及手數料
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts from licence fees and from administrative charges, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 懲罰及沒收金
metadata.description_en: Gives the receipts from fines and minor fines and from confiscated money, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 雜入
metadata.description_en: Gives miscellaneous revenue, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 官有物拂下代
metadata.title_en: Proceeds from Sales of Government Property
metadata.description_en: Gives the proceeds from sales of government goods, vessels, buildings and land, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 豫備金支出
metadata.description_en: Gives the total expenditure from the reserve funds, with the chapter, section, item and amount of each disbursement, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 社會教育團體
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of youth associations and other social education organizations and their members by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, as of the end of April, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年四月末現在)

metadata.title: 恩賜財團慈惠會事業
metadata.title_en: Work of the Imperial Gift Foundation Jikeikai
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of leprosy patients cared for and their attendants, poor patients given free treatment and destitute persons relieved, with the expenditure on each, by fiscal year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年度中)

metadata.title: 島民內地觀光團員數
metadata.title_en: Members of Islander Sightseeing Parties to Japan
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of islanders who toured Japan proper in organized sightseeing parties, the length of the tours in days and the subsidies paid, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年中)

metadata.title: 度量衡比較表
metadata.title_en: Comparative Table of Weights and Measures
metadata.description_en: Gives the conversion factors and their reciprocals between metric and yard-pound units and the corresponding Japanese units of length, area, volume and weight.

metadata.title: 位置
metadata.description_en: Gives the longitude and latitude ranges of the South Seas Islands as a whole and of the Mariana, Caroline and Marshall groups.

metadata.title: 最端島位置
metadata.description_en: Gives the place names and the longitude and latitude of the easternmost, westernmost, southernmost and northernmost points of the South Seas Islands.

metadata.title: 島數及面積
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of islands, their area in square kilometres and the principal islands, for the South Seas Islands as a whole, for the Mariana, Caroline and Marshall groups and for each branch office.

metadata.title: 主要島面積
metadata.description_en: Gives the area in square kilometres of each principal island, such as Saipan, Tinian, Rota, Yap, Babelthuap (Palau main island) and Angaur.

metadata.title: 官有地貸下面積用途別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of leases and the area of government land leased, with the paid leases and their rents shown separately, by use (agricultural land and others), by year from 1922 at each fiscal year end, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年度末現在) — printed 面積用途別 (續) on pp. 4-5

metadata.title: 觀測所
metadata.description_en: Gives, for the South Seas Government Observatory in Palau, its branch stations at Saipan and Ponape and the observing branch offices, the location, longitude and latitude, barometer height above sea level, the date observations began and the standard time used.

metadata.title: 氣象總覽
metadata.description_en: Gives, by year from 1922 for each station, the mean pressure, mean, extreme and departure-from-normal temperatures, humidity, sunshine percentage, and total precipitation with its departure from normal.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 平均氣壓
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean atmospheric pressure reduced to sea level, in millimetres, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: (海面ノ度)  — 單位 粍 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 平均氣溫
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean air temperature in degrees Celsius, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 攝氏度 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 氣溫毎日最高ノ平均
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean of the daily maximum temperatures in degrees Celsius, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 攝氏度 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 氣溫毎日最低ノ平均
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean of the daily minimum temperatures in degrees Celsius, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 攝氏度 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 氣溫較差平均
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean daily range of temperature in degrees Celsius, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 攝氏度 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 水蒸氣張力
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean water-vapour pressure in millimetres, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 耗 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 濕度平均
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean relative humidity in percent, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 % (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 雲量
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean cloud cover, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: (no unit printed)

metadata.title: 降水量
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of precipitation in millimetres, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 粍 (printed under the table)

metadata.title: 平均風速
metadata.description_en: Gives the mean wind velocity in metres per second, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 米/秒

metadata.title: 最強風速
metadata.description_en: Gives the highest wind velocity recorded in metres per second, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 米/秒

metadata.title: 日照時
metadata.description_en: Gives the duration of sunshine as a percentage of the possible daytime hours, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: (晝間時數ニ對スル%)

metadata.title: 快晴日數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of clear days, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.

metadata.title: 降水日數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of days with precipitation, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.

metadata.title: 蒸發量
metadata.description_en: Gives the amount of evaporation in millimetres, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.
metadata.caption: 單位 耗

metadata.title: 最多風向
metadata.description_en: Gives the most frequent wind direction, by month and year from 1922, for each meteorological station.

metadata.title: 現住戸數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of resident households, split between Japanese (from Japan proper and Koreans), islanders (Chamorro and Kanaka) and foreigners, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年十月一日現在但シ昭和二年以前ハ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 人口
metadata.description_en: Gives the resident population by sex, split between Japanese (from Japan proper and Koreans, with Taiwanese where shown), islanders (Chamorro and Kanaka) and foreigners, by year from 1922 and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年十月一日現在但シ昭和二年以前ニシテ大正十四年以外ハ總テ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 主要島別人口
metadata.description_en: Gives the resident population by sex, split between Japanese, islanders (Chamorro and Kanaka) and foreigners, by year from 1922 for each principal island, such as Saipan.
metadata.caption: (毎年十月一日現在但シ昭和二年以前ニシテ大正十四年以外ハ總テ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 邦人本籍別人口
metadata.title_en: Japanese Population by Prefecture of Registered Domicile
metadata.description_en: Gives the Japanese population by sex according to the prefecture (or Korea, Taiwan and other territory) of their registered domicile, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年十月一日現在但シ昭和二年以前ニシテ大正十四年以外ハ總テ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 外國人國籍別人口
metadata.description_en: Gives the foreign population by sex and nationality (Chinese, Spanish, French, German, American and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年十月一日現在但シ昭和二年以前ニテ大正十四年以外ハ總テ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 現住者年齡別
metadata.description_en: Gives the resident population by single year or group of age and by sex, separately for Japanese and foreigners and for islanders, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: 邦外人 — (毎年十月一日現在但シ昭和二年以前ニテ大正十四年以外ハ總テ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 現住者職業別
metadata.description_en: Gives the resident population by occupation (agriculture, livestock, sericulture, forestry, fishing, industry, commerce and others) and by sex, separately for Japanese and islanders, for 1930 to 1932, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年十月一日現在) — 邦人 / 島民、昭和 5-7年、支廳別

metadata.title: 出生、死產、死亡
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of births, stillbirths and deaths by sex, split between Japanese, islanders (Chamorro and Kanaka) and foreigners, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年中但シ自昭和三年至昭和五年ハ自前年十月至當年九月)

metadata.title: 島民婚姻、離婚
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of marriages and divorces among islanders, by age group of husband and of wife, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中但シ自昭和三年至昭和五年ハ自前年十月至當年九月)

metadata.title: 轉住
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons moving in and moving out by sex, split between Japanese, islanders and foreigners, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年中但シ昭和三—五年ハ自前年十月至當年九月)

metadata.title: 職員定員
metadata.description_en: Gives the authorised number of officials by rank (chokunin, sōnin, hannin, hannin-equivalent and employees), by year from 1922, for the South Seas Government as a whole and for its head office, branch offices, schools, courts, industrial experiment station, mining office, hospitals, post offices and observatory.
metadata.caption: (毎年六月末日現在但シ昭和元年以前ハ十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 文書收發通數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of documents received and dispatched, by year from 1922, for confidential correspondence and for each section of the head office, branch offices, hospitals, schools and other government agencies.
metadata.caption: (毎年中) — 收受 = receipt, 發送 = dispatch; each office has two columns (收受, 發送)

metadata.title: 島民村吏
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of islander village officials, Chamorro ward heads and assistants and Kanaka chief village heads, village heads and assistants, by year from 1924, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年六月末日現在)

metadata.title: 警察官吏現員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of police officials in service by rank (superintendent, inspector, assistant inspector, constable and islander policeman), by year from 1922 at year end, in total, by branch office and for the Police Section.
metadata.caption: (毎年十二月末日現在)

metadata.title: 警察文書口頭願屆件數
metadata.title_en: Written and Oral Applications and Notifications to the Police
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of written and oral applications and notifications handled by the police, carried over, received, disposed of and pending, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (毎年中)

metadata.title: 警察文書口頭願屆處分件數
metadata.title_en: Disposal of Written and Oral Applications and Notifications to the Police
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of police papers disposed of, by kind (correspondence with supervising offices, courts and procurators' offices, reports from subordinates, and applications and notifications from the public, Japanese and islander), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪檢擧件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of crimes known and of crimes cleared, under the Criminal Code by offence and under special laws, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪檢擧人員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons arrested, Japanese and islanders, under the Criminal Code by offence and under special laws, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪卽決事件取扱件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases handled under summary police jurisdiction, received (carried over and new), disposed of as guilty or not guilty and pending, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪卽決事件取扱人員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons handled under summary police jurisdiction, received (carried over and new) and found guilty or not guilty, split between Japanese and islanders, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪卽決處分件數刑名別
metadata.title_en: Summary Police Judgments: Cases by Penalty
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases summarily sentenced by penalty (fine, detention, minor fine and labour), under the Criminal Code and special laws, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪即決處分人員刑名別
metadata.title_en: Summary Police Judgments: Persons by Penalty
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons summarily sentenced by penalty (fine, detention, minor fine and labour) and by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, for all offences, Criminal Code offences and special-law offences, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中) — three sections 總數 / 刑法犯 / 特別法犯 (the 特別法犯 section continues after p0078)

metadata.title: 犯罪即決處分件數罪名別
metadata.title_en: Summary Police Judgments: Cases by Offence
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases summarily sentenced under the Criminal Code and under special laws by offence (liquor, livestock, residence, scriveners, forests, geisha and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 犯罪即決處分人員罪名別
metadata.title_en: Summary Police Judgments: Persons by Offence
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons summarily sentenced, Japanese and islanders, under the Criminal Code and under special laws by offence, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 檢視、檢證
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of inquests on bodies by cause (suicide, disaster, abandoned infant, unnatural death, accidental homicide and others) and by examining official, and of on-site inspections, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中) — printed with the 檢證 half on the right-hand pages

metadata.title: 執行及注意件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of warnings, demands, admonitions and accusations issued by the police, by field of police administration (public order and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 行政檢束
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons taken into administrative police custody by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, by reason (drunkenness and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 刑法犯被害財物
metadata.title_en: Property Stolen or Lost through Criminal Offences
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases and the value of property lost through Criminal Code offences, cash and by kind of article (securities, watches, precious metals and others) with the number of items, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 刑法犯被害財物發見
metadata.title_en: Recovery of Property Lost through Criminal Offences
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases and the value of property recovered after Criminal Code offences, cash and by kind of article with the number of items, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 風水害
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of storms and floods, wind damage and flood damage, the value of damage to buildings and other property, and persons and livestock killed or injured, by year from 1923, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 火災
metadata.description_en: Gives the total damage from fires and the number of fires, area burnt and value of damage for dwellings, other buildings, fields and other property, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 火災原因別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of fires and the value of damage by cause (accidental fires from lamps, tobacco or matches, electricity, ignition of alcohol or petrol and others, arson and unknown), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 變死傷
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons dead and of persons injured without death by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, by kind (suicide, homicide, accident and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中) — [title printed across the gutter: 變 ... 死 | 傷; the left page (p. 114) gives 死亡者, the right page (p. 115) 死亡ニ至ラザルモノ]

metadata.title: 自殺者原因別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of completed and attempted suicides, Japanese and islanders, by motive (insanity, illness, poverty or misfortune, love suicide and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中) — 旣遂 and 未遂, each as 總數 (全南洋廳) then 6 支廳 blocks (サイパン, ヤップ, パラオ, トラック, ポナペ, ヤルート); left pages (pp. 116, 118, 120) carry 總數 to 將來ヲ苦慮シテ, right pages (pp. 117, 119, 121) carry 商業等ノ損失 to 原因不詳 and the 年次 column

metadata.title: 自殺者手段別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of completed and attempted suicides, Japanese and islanders, by means (hanging, drowning, cutting the throat, firearms or explosives and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (旣遂) (每年中) [left page, p. 122]; (未遂) (續) [right page, p. 123]

metadata.title: 自殺者年齡別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of suicides by age group and by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, by year from 1928, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 被殺傷者原因別
metadata.title_en: Persons Killed or Injured by Others, by Motive
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons killed and injured by others, Japanese and islanders, by motive (robbery, grudge, quarrel or anger, gain and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 不慮死傷者原因別
metadata.title_en: Accidental Deaths and Injuries by Cause
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons accidentally killed and injured, Japanese and islanders, by cause (poisoning, animals, fish, birds and insects, earthquake and fire, lightning and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 銃砲現在數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of firearms held at year end, military and non-military (rifles, short guns and pistols), by year from 1924, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 銃砲輸移入
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of firearms imported from abroad and from Japan, military and non-military (rifles, short guns and pistols), by year from 1924, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 火藥類使用高
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantity of gunpowder used for hunting and construction, high explosives, fuses and cartridges, by year from 1923, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 麻藥輸移入
metadata.description_en: Gives the quantities of opium and its preparations and of morphine, its salts and derivatives, cocaine and other narcotics imported, by year from 1922, in total and by government hospital.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 拾得物及埋藏物
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and value of money and of articles found or unearthed, with clothing, watches and precious metals and other kinds shown separately, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 漂流物
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and value of articles found adrift or washed ashore, timber, vessels and others, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 遺失物
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and value of money and of articles reported lost, with clothing, watches and precious metals, grain, livestock and other kinds shown separately, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年中)

metadata.title: 警察取締營業其ノ他
metadata.title_en: Businesses and Other Establishments under Police Control
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of factories, fireworks works, printers, prime movers, electricity undertakings, civil-engineering contractors, places of entertainment and other establishments under police regulation at year end, by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
metadata.caption: (每年末現在)

metadata.title: 興行
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of performances, days and admissions for theatre, motion pictures and other entertainments, by year from 1923, in total and by branch office.

metadata.caption: (收入濟額) (每年度中)

metadata.caption: (每年度中)

metadata.caption: (朝鮮、臺灣、關東州)

metadata.title: 入學志願者及入學者
metadata.title_en: Applicants for Admission and Persons Admitted
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of applicants and persons admitted to middle schools, girls' high schools, colleges by field and other higher institutions, by year, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地) — The 音樂 column of the first block carries the printed note (豫科卒業者) in the heading band above the figures.

metadata.title: 學習院
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of teachers and of students and pupils in each department of the Gakushūin and the Peeresses' School, at year end, 1930 to 1934.

metadata.title: 實業補習學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of schools, teachers, pupils by sex and those completing courses of technical, agricultural and other vocational continuation schools, by year and by locality for fiscal 1932 (territories fiscal 1933).
metadata.caption: (昭和七年度但シ外地ハ同八年度) — printed above the 總數(內地) line of the regional block; the 地方別 block follows the year series.

metadata.title: 實業學校及職業學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of schools, teachers, pupils and graduates of class A and class B technical, agricultural, commercial and other vocational schools, by year and by locality for fiscal 1932 (territories fiscal 1933).
metadata.caption: (昭和七年度但シ外地ハ同八年度) — printed above the regional block, between the year series and 總數(內地)

metadata.title: 實業專門學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of technical colleges, teachers, students (regular, preparatory, elective and research) and graduates, by fiscal year.

metadata.title: 各種學校
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of schools, teachers and pupils of schools ranking with elementary schools, middle schools, girls' high schools and other miscellaneous schools, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 外國人教員及學生、生徒
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of foreign teachers and students in each type of school in Japan proper, fiscal 1928 to 1932.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 文部省在外研究員
metadata.title_en: Ministry of Education Research Fellows Abroad
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Ministry of Education research fellows abroad by country of residence (Britain, United States, France, Germany etc.), fiscal 1929 to 1933.

metadata.title: 博士
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of doctorates in law, medicine, pharmacy, engineering, letters, science, agriculture and other fields, with the number of persons, at fiscal year end, by year.
metadata.caption: 年度末

metadata.title: 生徒體格
metadata.description_en: Gives the results of medical examinations of pupils (numbers examined, development and nutrition grades in percentages and other findings) by sex, fiscal 1928 to 1932.

metadata.title: 青年團及青年訓練所
metadata.title_en: Youth Associations and Youth Training Centres
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of youth associations for men and women with their regular members, and of youth training centres with their directors and instructors, by year and by prefecture.

metadata.title: 小學校教員平均月俸
metadata.title_en: Average Monthly Salaries of Elementary School Teachers
metadata.description_en: Gives the average monthly salary (excluding supplements) of ordinary and higher elementary school teachers by grade of licence (regular, special-subject, assistant etc.) and sex, by fiscal year, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地) (單位圓) — 本表ニハ加俸額ヲ算入セズ。

metadata.title: 公學資產
metadata.description_en: Gives total assets, endowment property and reserve funds under the Local Education Regulations of prefectures, cities and towns and villages, by year, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地) (單位千圓)

metadata.title: 公學費
metadata.description_en: Gives the expenditure on education of prefectures, cities and towns and villages (salaries, teachers' housing and other costs), by fiscal year and by type, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地) (單位圓)

metadata.title: 公學收入
metadata.description_en: Gives the education revenue of prefectures, cities and towns and villages by source (fees, income from endowments, national subsidies, donations and miscellaneous), by fiscal year and by type, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地) (單位圓)

metadata.title: 公學收入及公學費地方別
metadata.title_en: Public Education Revenue and Expenditure by Locality
metadata.description_en: Gives the education revenue and expenditure of prefectures, cities and towns and villages, by prefecture for fiscal 1932.
metadata.caption: (昭和七年度) (單位圓)

metadata.title: 出版圖書
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of books published by subject (politics, law, economics, social problems, statistics etc.), 1930 to 1934.

metadata.title: 新聞雜誌
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newspapers and periodicals (excluding government publications), with and without security deposit, by frequency of issue, by year and by prefecture.
metadata.caption: (官版ノモノヲ含マズ)

metadata.title: 圖書館
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of public and private libraries, their holdings of Japanese and Chinese and Western books, and readers, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 神社及神官神職
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of shrines by rank (Ise, government and national shrines of each grade, special government shrines, prefectural and lower shrines) and of Shinto priests, by year.
metadata.caption: (國幣社以上ハ年末現在、府縣社以下ハ其年ノ六月末現在、神宮神職ハ年末現在)

metadata.title: 寺院及住職
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of temples and chief priests by sect (Tendai, Shingon, Jōdo, Rinzai, Sōtō, Ōbaku, Shin etc.), by year and by prefecture.

metadata.title: 佛道教會說教所
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Buddhist churches and preaching places by sect (Tendai, Shingon, Jōdo, Rinzai, Sōtō, Ōbaku, Shin, Nichiren etc.), by year, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 神道
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of Shinto sanctuaries, churches and preaching places by sect (Shintō, Kurozumikyō, Shūsei-ha, Taishakyō, Fusōkyō, Jikkōkyō, Taiseikyō, Shinshūkyō etc.), by year, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 基督教
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of churches and preaching places by denomination (Roman Catholic, Orthodox, Church of Christ in Japan, Kumiai, Nippon Seikōkai, Baptist, Japan Methodist, Methodist Protestant etc.), by year, for Japan proper.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 犯罪檢擧件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offences cleared by the police by type of crime under the Criminal Code (obstruction of officials, arson, forgery, indecency, gambling etc.) and special laws, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 盜難其ノ他被害人員
metadata.title_en: Victims of Theft and Other Crimes
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of victims of robbery, theft (pickpocketing and other), rape, fraud and extortion in Japan proper, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 被殺害者
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons murdered in Japan proper by motive or circumstance (robbery, grudge, quarrel or sudden anger, gambling disputes, greed, resisting arrest, insanity, violence or drunkenness etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 災害其他ノ事故ニテ死セシ人員
metadata.title_en: Deaths from Disasters and Other Accidents
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons killed in Japan proper by floods, tidal waves, shipwrecks, fires, earthquakes, snow and freezing, landslides, falling trees and collapsing houses and other accidents, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 醫藥業
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of physicians, dentists, pharmacists, midwives, government, public and private hospitals, druggists and drug manufacturers, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 種痘人員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons given first-period (infant) and second-period (age ten) public vaccinations, first and second attempts, by result (successful, unsuccessful, not yet examined), by year and by locality.
metadata.caption: 第一期 (第一期種痘トハ出生ヨリ翌年六月ニ至ル間ニ行フモノヲ謂フ)、第二期 (第二期種痘トハ數ヘ十歲ニ行フモノヲ謂フ)

metadata.title: 傳染病患者
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases and deaths from cholera, dysentery, typhoid, paratyphoid, epidemic cerebrospinal meningitis and other notifiable diseases, by year.

metadata.title: 精神病者
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of mentally ill persons by sex, by place of custody under the Mental Hospitals Law and the Mental Patients' Custody Law, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 水道
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of waterworks, taps by type (private, shared, street, metered, fire hydrants) and annual water supplied, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 墓地及埋火葬
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and area of cemeteries, crematoria, bodies cremated and buried, cremations per crematorium and the percentage cremated, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 水災、潮災及暴風雨被害
metadata.title_en: Damage from Floods, High Tides and Storms
metadata.description_en: Gives the municipalities affected, area flooded, fields and other land washed away or buried, buildings and ships damaged, persons killed and injured and losses by floods, high tides and storms, by year and by prefecture.

metadata.title: 火災
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of fires by cause (accident, arson, suspicious and other), buildings totally and partly burnt (dwellings and others) and floor area burnt, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 消防員及機械器具
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of fire stations, fire brigades, professional and volunteer firemen and motor, motorcycle and other petrol pumps, steam pumps and fire boats, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 貸座敷、料理屋及藝娼妓數
metadata.title_en: Licensed Quarters, Restaurants, Geisha and Prostitutes
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of licensed brothel districts, brothel keepers, introducing teahouses, licensed prostitutes, brothel employees by sex, annual brothel visitors, restaurants and assignation teahouses, with geisha, by year and by locality.

metadata.title: 區裁判所取扱件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of civil cases handled by local courts by type (conciliation, payment orders, first-instance suits, family register appeals, compulsory execution, bankruptcy, composition, land and house lease mediation), by year, for Japan proper (including Karafuto).
metadata.caption: (內地) (本科ノ内地ニハ凡テ樺太ヲ含ム)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所取扱件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of civil cases handled by district courts by type (first-instance suits, appeals, complaints, bankruptcy adjudications, non-contentious cases, tenancy conciliation, retrials), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 控訴院取扱件數
metadata.title_en: Cases Handled by Courts of Appeal
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of civil cases handled by the courts of appeal by type (appeals, final appeals, complaints and special suits such as election suits), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 大審院取扱件數
metadata.title_en: Cases Handled by the Great Court of Cassation
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new civil cases handled by the Great Court of Cassation, by type of final appeal (ordinary, documentary and bill, special, personal-status suits) and complaint, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所訴訟件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new suits in local courts by type (ordinary, provisional attachment and disposition, incompetency, disappearance, public summons, judicial assistance, other), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所訴訟事件金額別
metadata.title_en: Civil Suits in Local Courts by Amount Claimed
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of new suits in local courts by amount claimed (up to 20 yen to 10,000 yen and over) and the amounts claimed, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所訴訟新受件數
metadata.title_en: New Civil Suits in Local Courts by Subject
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of new suits in local courts by subject of the claim (land, buildings and ships, money, rice, goods, securities etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所非訟事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new non-contentious cases in local courts by type (juridical persons, administration of property, judicial subrogation, deposit, custody and appraisal, family matters etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所和解事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new compromise cases in local courts, their outcome (settled, not settled, withdrawn or dismissed) and concluded cases by subject (personal status, land and buildings etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所督促事件
metadata.title_en: Payment Order Cases in Local Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new payment order cases in local courts, their outcome (orders issued, dismissed or withdrawn), their subject (sums of money, fungibles, securities) and objections lodged, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所戸籍ニ關スル抗告件數
metadata.title_en: Family Register Appeals in Local Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new appeals concerning family registers in local courts and their outcome (dismissed, mayor ordered to take action, withdrawn, other), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所强制執行事件
metadata.title_en: Compulsory Execution Cases in Local Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the total, new and concluded compulsory execution cases, debtors, creditors and amounts of claims, with concluded cases by amount, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所取扱破產事件
metadata.title_en: Bankruptcy Cases Handled by Local Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new bankruptcy cases in local courts and their disposal (adjudication, dismissal, withdrawal, composition etc.) and results, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 區裁判所借地借家調停事件
metadata.title_en: Land and House Lease Mediation Cases in Local Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new land and house lease mediation cases and their outcome (settled or not, dismissed, transferred), with and without a conciliation committee, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所第一審訴訟件數
metadata.title_en: First-Instance Civil Suits in District Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new first-instance suits in district courts by type (ordinary, provisional attachment and disposition, special, personal-status, other) and their outcome, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所第一審訴訟事件金額別
metadata.title_en: First-Instance Civil Suits in District Courts by Amount Claimed
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of new suits in district courts by amount claimed (up to 100 yen to over 10,000 yen) and the amounts and estimated values claimed, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所第一審訴訟新受件數
metadata.title_en: New First-Instance Civil Suits in District Courts by Subject
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of new first-instance suits in district courts by subject (personal status, land, buildings and ships, money, rice, goods, securities etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所控訴件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new civil appeals in district courts by type (ordinary, documentary and bill suits) and their outcome (dismissed, reversed, withdrawn, settled), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所抗告件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new complaints (kōkoku) in district courts and their outcome (dismissed, earlier decision wholly or partly reversed, withdrawn, other), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 地方裁判所取扱破産事件
metadata.title_en: Bankruptcy Cases Handled by District Courts
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of bankruptcy adjudications under the old law, bankrupts by type (individuals, partnerships, limited partnerships, joint-stock companies) and concluded cases, by year.
metadata.caption: (舊法ニヨルモノ)(內地)

metadata.title: 小作調停事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new tenancy conciliation cases and their outcome, with and without a conciliation committee, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 控訴院控訴件數
metadata.title_en: Civil Appeals in Courts of Appeal
metadata.description_en: Gives the total and new civil appeals in the courts of appeal by type (ordinary, documentary and bill, personal-status) and outcome (dismissed, reversed, withdrawn etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 控訴院上告件數
metadata.title_en: Final Appeals in Courts of Appeal
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of final appeals (jōkoku) in the courts of appeal by type (ordinary, documentary and bill suits) and outcome (dismissed, quashed, withdrawn, settled), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 公證事務
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of notarial acts by type (juristic acts, other facts, protests, authentications, grants of execution, copies, inspections etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 供託事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the number and amount of money and the number, pieces and face value of securities deposited and paid out, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 執達吏事務
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of new and total acts of court bailiffs by type (execution under the Code of Civil Procedure, provisional attachment and disposition, auctions, service of documents, notices, protests etc.), by year.

metadata.title: 外國人ニ關スル訴訟件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of suits involving foreigners by nationality of the parties (Japanese plaintiff, foreign plaintiff, both foreign) and by subject (personal status, land, buildings and ships, money, goods etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 朝鮮、臺灣、關東州民事事件
metadata.title_en: Civil Cases in Korea, Taiwan and Kwantung
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of new and concluded civil conciliation cases and civil suits at first and second instance and on final appeal, by year, for Korea, Taiwan and Kwantung.
metadata.caption: (故障事件及再審事件ヲ含マズ)

metadata.title: 刑事事件取扱件數
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of criminal cases by stage (investigation, preliminary examination, first instance, appeal, final appeal, complaint, retrial, extraordinary appeal, private actions attached to prosecutions), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 犯罪搜查終局事件及豫審終局被告人
metadata.title_en: Concluded Criminal Investigations and Defendants in Preliminary Examination
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of investigations concluded by prosecution, non-prosecution (by reason), suspension or transfer, and defendants whose preliminary examination was concluded, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 刑事第一審事件
metadata.description_en: Gives cases received and new, concluded and pending, and defendants by sex and outcome (convicted, acquitted, discharged, other), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 刑事控訴事件
metadata.description_en: Gives cases received, new appeals by appellant (prosecutor, defendant, other) and cases concluded by outcome (sentence, acquittal, other), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 刑事上告事件
metadata.description_en: Gives cases received, new final appeals by appellant (prosecutor, defendant, other) and cases concluded by outcome (sentence, appeal dismissed, other), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 朝鮮、臺灣、關東州刑事事件
metadata.title_en: Criminal Cases in Korea, Taiwan and Kwantung
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of cases investigated by prosecutors (prosecuted, not prosecuted), in preliminary examination (committed for trial, discharged) and concluded at each instance, by year, for Korea, Taiwan and Kwantung.
metadata.caption: (故障事件及再審事件ヲ含マズ)

metadata.title: 第一審刑法犯罪名別
metadata.title_en: Persons Convicted at First Instance under the Criminal Code, by Offence
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offenders by offence (obstruction of officials, riot, arson, fire by negligence, trespass, forgery etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 第一審刑法犯原因別
metadata.title_en: Persons Convicted at First Instance under the Criminal Code, by Motive
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offenders by motive (greed, extravagance, vanity, temptation, idleness, gambling, carelessness, poverty etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 第一審刑法犯年齡別
metadata.title_en: Persons Convicted at First Instance under the Criminal Code, by Age
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offenders by age group (14 to under 16 years and older bands), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 第一審刑法犯罪名及刑名別
metadata.title_en: Persons Convicted at First Instance under the Criminal Code, by Offence and Penalty
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offenders by penalty (death, penal servitude and imprisonment for life or a term, fine, detention, minor fine), by year and by offence.

metadata.title: 第一審刑法犯受刑度數
metadata.title_en: Persons Convicted at First Instance under the Criminal Code, by Number of Previous Convictions
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offenders by sex and number of convictions (first, second, third to sixth and more), by year and by offence.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 刑法犯執行猶豫及取消
metadata.title_en: Suspended Sentences under the Criminal Code and Their Revocation
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of defendants given a suspended sentence, with or without previous convictions, by penalty and length of suspension, and the revocations, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 第一審刑法犯加重及減輕
metadata.title_en: Aggravation and Mitigation of Penalties for Criminal Code Offences at First Instance
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of first offenders and of recidivists given aggravated penalties (second, third, fourth and later offence) and of offenders given statutory or discretionary mitigation, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 第一審特別法犯罪名及刑名別
metadata.title_en: Persons Convicted at First Instance under Special Laws, by Offence and Penalty
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of offenders under special laws by penalty (death, penal servitude, imprisonment, fine, detention, minor fine), by year and by offence.

metadata.title: 特別法犯執行猶豫及取消
metadata.title_en: Suspended Sentences under Special Laws and Their Revocation
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of defendants under special laws given a suspended sentence, with or without previous convictions, by penalty and length of suspension, and the revocations, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 判決確定被告人
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of defendants (men, women and juridical persons) whose judgments became final, by instance and outcome (convicted, acquitted or discharged), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 刑事略式事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of defendants in summary proceedings, those punished by summary order (fine, minor fine) and those transferred to formal trial, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 違警罪即決事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of persons summarily sentenced by the police for police offences (detention, minor fine, exempted) and the results of formal trials requested against such judgments, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地) — right-hand page: 續

metadata.title: 外國人ニ關スル第一審刑事事件
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of foreign defendants by nationality (Britain, United States, Germany, Russia, China, others) and by outcome or penalty, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 登記
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of registrations of land, buildings and ships (taxable and non-taxable), factory and mining foundations and other matters, by year.

metadata.title: 在監人員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of inmates by sex and category (convicts, persons detained in workhouses, accused awaiting trial), by year.

metadata.title: 入監出監人員
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of inmates admitted and released, with convicts released by reason (expiry of sentence, death, parole, suspension of execution etc.), by year.

metadata.title: 在監受刑者罪名及刑名別
metadata.title_en: Convicts in Prison by Offence and Penalty
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of convicts in prison by offence under the Criminal Code (obstruction of officials, riot, arson, trespass, forgery, perjury etc.) and special laws, and by penalty, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 懲役在監受刑者刑期別
metadata.title_en: Convicts Serving Penal Servitude by Length of Sentence
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of convicts serving penal servitude by sex and length of sentence (life and terms of 15 years and over and shorter bands), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 新受刑者罪名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by offence under the Criminal Code (obstruction of officials, riot, arson, trespass, forgery, perjury etc.) and special laws, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 新受刑者犯數別
metadata.title_en: Newly Admitted Convicts by Number of Offences
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by sex, under and over 18, by first, second and third or later offence, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 新受刑者ノ年齡其他ノ關係
metadata.title_en: Newly Admitted Convicts by Age and Other Characteristics
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by sex and by age at admission and other characteristics, by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.title: 新受刑者刑名別
metadata.description_en: Gives the number of newly admitted convicts by sex and penalty (death, penal servitude for life or a term, imprisonment, detention etc.), by year.
metadata.caption: (內地)

metadata.caption: (十月一日現在但シ大正十二年ハ九月一日現在) 本推計人口ハ下記ノ方法ニ依リ推計シタルモノナリ。(1)大正十年乃至同十二年ハ大正九年十月一日國勢調査ニ據ル現在人口ヲ基礎トシテ明治四十一年乃至大正七年ノ一年平均男女別增加率ニヨリ郡市別ニ推計シ之ヲ合計シタルモノナリ。(2)大正十三年ハ各都市ニ於ケル男女各別ノ增加率ニヨリ算出シタル人口ノ全國積算數ト全國ニ於ケル男女別ノ增加率ニヨリ算出シタル數トノ差ヲ各道府縣人口ヨリ按分控除シ、尙大正十二年九月關東大震災ニヨル人口ノ減少ヲモ加味シテ作リタルモノナリ。(3)大正十五年乃至昭和四年ハ大正九年及大正十四年國勢調査ニ據ル現在人口ヲ基礎トシ全國人口ノ一年平均幾何增加率ヲ求メ之ニヨリ推計シタリ。(4)昭和六年乃至同九年ハ大正九年及昭和五年國勢調査ニ據ル現在人口ヲ基礎トシ(3)ト同樣ノ方法ニ依リ推計シタリ。(5)昭和十一年以降ハ人口動態調査ノ結果ヲ利用シ昭和十年國勢調査人口ニ各推計年次迄ノ出生死亡ノ差增ヲ加算シテ推計シタルモノナリ。
